verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Nepal tunnel rescuers hunt for survivors with rafts and drone
title.zh: 尼泊尔隧道救援人员乘筏和无人机搜寻幸存者

summary.en: Eight days after deadly flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border, rescuers are still searching for survivors believed to be trapped in tunnels along Nepal's Trishuli River. The floods, caused by a 'glacial collapse' in the Himalayas, have killed at least 1,200 people and left thousands missing, devastating roads and...
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏边境发生致命的洪水灾难八天后，救援人员仍在搜寻据信被困在尼泊尔特里苏里河沿岸隧道中的幸存者。这场由喜马拉雅山脉的“冰川崩塌”引发的洪水已造成至少1200人死亡，数千人失踪，摧毁了道路和村庄。

body.en:
Eight days on from the deadly flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border, rescuers were still looking for survivors who are thought to be trapped inside tunnels along Nepal's Trishuli River.

At least 1,200 people have died and thousands more are missing after a "glacial collapse" high in the Himalayas, led to floodwater and debris sweeping through roads and villages.

BBC South Asia correspondent Azadeh Moshiri travelled to one of the sites of one of the tunnels.
body.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏边境发生致命的山洪爆发八天后，救援人员仍在寻找据信被困在尼泊尔特里舒利河沿岸隧道内的幸存者。 喜马拉雅山高处发生“冰川崩塌”，导致洪水和废墟席卷道路和村庄，造成至少 1,200 人死亡，数千人失踪。乙 BBC 南亚记者阿扎德·莫希里 (Azadeh Moshiri) 前往其中一处隧道遗址之一。

reflection.en: In the aftermath of devastating floods, the urgent search for survivors trapped in tunnels underscores a profound human need: to be found and to have one's plight acknowledged. The efforts of rescuers, using rafts and drones, are a tangible expression of hope and a voice for those silenced by disaster. This echoes the ancient call to 'speak up for those who...
reflection.zh: 在毁灭性洪水灾难之后，在隧道中被困人员的紧急搜救凸显了一种深刻的人类需求：被找到并让他们的困境得到承认。救援人员使用筏子和无人机进行的搜救，是希望的有形表达，也是为那些被灾难压倒的人发出的声音。这呼应了古老的呼吁：“为不能自己说话的人说话”，确保在他们最需要的时候，没有人被遗忘。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Reform’s media presenter worked for Chinese state propaganda channel
title.zh: 改革派媒体主持人曾在中国国家宣传频道工作

summary.en: Reform UK's top media presenter, Ray Addison, who hosts the party's podcast and social media campaigns, has worked for a Chinese state propaganda channel within the past year. Addison presented films about Xinjiang province, where China faces accusations of genocide, for state media in September 2025.
summary.zh: 据《卫报》报道，英国改革党（Reform UK）的首席媒体主持人雷·阿迪森（Ray Addison）在过去一年中曾为中国国家宣传频道工作。阿迪森曾于2025年9月为中国官媒制作了关于新疆省的影片，而中国在该地区面临种族灭绝的指控。

body.en: Party podcast and social media host Ray Addison fronted films about province where China is accused of genocide Reform UK’s top media presenter has worked for a Chinese state propaganda channel within the past year, the Guardian can reveal. Ray Addison, who presents the political party’s in-house podcast and social media campaigns, fronted films about Xinjiang province – where the Chinese government is accused of committing genocide – for state media in September 2025. Continue reading...
body.zh: 据《卫报》透露，党播客和社交媒体主持人雷·艾迪生 (Ray Addison) 主持了有关中国被指控进行种族灭绝的省份的电影。 《改革英国》(Reform UK) 顶级媒体主持人去年曾在中国国家宣传频道工作。负责该政党内部播客和社交媒体活动的雷·艾迪生 (Ray Addison) 于 2025 年 9 月为官方媒体播放了有关新疆省（中国政府被指控实施种族灭绝）的电影。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news that a political party's media presenter has worked for a state propaganda channel raises questions about truthfulness and integrity in public communication. Ephesians 4:25 calls believers to "put off falsehood and speak truthfully to one another," a principle vital for maintaining trust in political discourse and media.
reflection.zh: 一名政党媒体主持人曾为国家宣传频道工作的消息，引发了关于公共传播中真实性和诚信的疑问。以弗所书4章25节呼吁信徒“各人与邻舍说实话”，这一原则对于在政治言论和媒体中维持信任至关重要。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Malaysia's middle path between China and US faces new tests
title.zh: 马来西亚在中国和美国之间走中间道路面临新考验

summary.en: Malaysia's Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim's recent comments on Taiwan and US-backed military facilities have raised questions about the sustainability of the nation's non-aligned foreign policy as US-China rivalry intensifies in Southeast Asia.
summary.zh: 马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣最近就台湾和美国支持的军事设施发表的言论，在美中竞争日益加剧的东南亚地区，引发了对该国不结盟外交政策可持续性的质疑。

body.en:
The prime minister's comments on Taiwan and US-backed military facilities near Sabah have revived questions over Malaysia's non-aligned foreign policy.

Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has spent much of his time in office insisting that Kuala Lumpur will not be forced to choose between the United States and China .

But two sets of comments last month have raised questions about how sustainable that position is as rivalry between the two superpowers increasingly spills into Southeast Asia.

"I see Taiwan as part of China, period," he said in an interview with news outlet Al Jazeera that aired on August 16.

Beijing considers democratically governed as  Taiwan part of its territory. While Chinese leaders say they favor "peaceful reunification," they have never ruled out using force to bring the island under Beijing's control.

More controversially, Anwar appeared to accept Beijing's argument that force could be necessary.

"If one province decides to break away. Do we use force? I think I will, [to] protect the sanctity and unity of the nation," he said.

The comments drew an enthusiastic response from Beijing, while Taiwan's Foreign Ministry accused Anwar of effectively legitimizing the use of force against the island and warned that his "one-sided support for China could negatively impact Taiwanese businesses' confidence in investing in Malaysia," including in the country's strategically important semiconductor sector.

Two days after his comments on Taiwan aired, Anwar argued that Malaysia  should strengthen its defenses in Sabah, citing the expansion of US-backed military facilities on the nearby Philippine island of Balabac.

The Philippines is upgrading facilities on Balabac, roughly 50 kilometers (31 miles) from the Malaysian islands of Banggi and Balambangan.

Balabac was one of four additional locations added in 2023 to the Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement, which allows US forces to access designated Philippine military facilities, construct infrastructure and pre-position equipment.

Taken together, Anwar's comments raised concerns that Malaysia is growing warmer toward Beijing while becoming more suspicious of Washington's military footprint in the region.

Kuala Lumpur has also been one of the region's strongest critics of Israel's actions in Gaza . Anwar has repeatedly accused the United States and European governments of hypocrisy and double standards for championing democracy and international law while failing, in his view, to hold Israel sufficiently accountable.

But Malaysia experts warn against interpreting Anwar's rhetoric as evidence of a fundamental strategic realignment.

"Malaysia still maintains very good relations with the US and other Western countries," Ngeow Chow Bing, director of the...
body.zh: 总理对台湾和沙巴附近美国支持的军事设施的评论再次引发了对马来西亚不结盟外交政策的质疑。 马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣(Anwar Ibrahim)在任期间大部分时间都坚称，吉隆坡不会被迫在美国和中国之间做出选择。 但上个月的两套评论引发了人们的疑问，随着两个超级大国之间的竞争日益蔓延到东南亚，这一立场的可持续性如何。 “我认为台湾是中国的一部分，就这样，”他在接受半岛电视台 8 月 16 日播出的采访时说道。 北京认为台湾是其领土的一部分，实行民主治理。尽管中国领导人表示支持“和平统一”，但他们从未排除使用武力将该岛置于北京的控制之下。 更具争议性的是，安瓦尔似乎接受了北京关于可能需要使用武力的论点。 “如果一个省决定脱离。我们会使用武力吗？我想我会，[以]保护国家的神圣和统一，”他说。 这些言论引起了北京的热烈回应，而台湾外交部则指责安瓦尔实际上使对台湾使用武力合法化，并警告说，他“对中国的片面支持可能会对台湾企业投资马来西亚的信心产生负面影响”，包括对该国具有重要战略意义的半导体行业的投资。 在发表有关台湾的言论两天后，安瓦尔认为马来西亚应该加强在沙巴的防御，并列举了美国支持的在附近的菲律宾巴拉巴克岛扩建军事设施的情况。 菲律宾正在升级巴拉巴克岛的设施，该岛距离马来西亚班吉岛和巴兰班安岛约 50 公里（31 英里）。 巴拉巴克是 2023 年《增强防务合作协议》新增的四个地点之一，该协议允许美军进入菲律宾指定军事设施、建设基础设施和预置设备。 总而言之，安瓦尔的言论引发了人们的担忧，即马来西亚对北京的态度越来越好，同时对华盛顿在该地区的军事足迹越来越怀疑。 吉隆坡也是该地区对以色列在加沙行动最强烈的批评者之一。安瓦尔一再指责美国和欧洲政府在倡导民主和国际法方面虚伪和双重标准，同时他认为，未能让以色列承担足够的责任。 但马来西亚专家警告不要将安瓦尔的言论解读为根本战略调整的证据。 “马来西亚仍然与美国和其他西方国家保持着非常良好的关系，”该中心主任Ngeow Chow Bing...

reflection.en: Malaysia's Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim seeks to navigate a delicate path between global powers, aiming to avoid choosing sides. This pursuit of balance reflects a desire for peace and stability in a complex geopolitical landscape. The challenge lies in upholding this 'middle path' when external pressures mount, testing the nation's resolve to foster good...
reflection.zh: 马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣试图在两大全球势力之间走一条微妙的道路，力求不选边站队。这种寻求平衡的努力，反映了在复杂的地缘政治格局中对和平与稳定的渴望。当外部压力增大时，如何坚持这条“中间道路”并促进与各方的良好关系，是对国家决心的考验。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Dozens of trapped hydropower tunnel workers in Nepal could still be alive, official says
title.zh: 尼泊尔水电隧道数十名被困工人仍有可能活着，官员称

summary.en: Approximately 46 workers are believed to be trapped in a 'room-like' structure within a hydropower plant tunnel on the Nepal-Tibet border following deadly flash floods. A Nepal electricity authority official expressed hope that many could still be found alive after a week.
summary.zh: 在致命的山洪暴发后，约有46名工人被认为被困在尼泊尔-西藏边境水电站隧道内的一个“房间状”结构中。尼泊尔电力局的一名官员表示，希望许多人在一周后仍能被发现活着。

body.en: About 46 people believed to be trapped in ‘room-like’ structure inside hydro plant tunnel on Nepal-Tibet border After the flood: human suffering on an unfathomable scale in Nepal’s worst-hit districts Nepal authorities have said they are “confident” that dozens of workers in Nepal’s Rasuwagadhi hydropower plant are still alive, more than a week after deadly flash floods left them trapped in an underground chamber. Authorities said that at least 639 workers were still missing from hydropower plants built along Nepal’s Bhote Koshi and Triushuli rivers. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尼泊尔与西藏边境的水电站隧道内约有 46 人被困在“类似房间”的结构中 洪水过后：尼泊尔受灾最严重的地区的人们遭受了难以估量的痛苦 一名尼泊尔电力局官员表示，在致命的山洪爆发后，数十名工人被困在尼泊尔拉苏瓦加迪水电站的地下密室中一周后，很可能会发现数十名工人还活着。尼泊尔电力局董事会成员阿姆苏·基兰·沙希 (Amhsu Kiran Shahi) 周三对路透社表示：“在拉苏瓦加迪，我们认为有 46 人被困在隧道内一个类似房间的结构中。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of disaster, the immediate concern is for the lives of those trapped. Amidst the uncertainty and fear, there is a flicker of hope that these 46 workers might still be found alive. This situation calls to mind Psalm 46:1, reminding us that even in overwhelming crises, God is our refuge and strength.
reflection.zh: 面对灾难，当务之急是那些被困者的生命。在不确定和恐惧之中，人们怀着一丝希望，希望这46名工人仍能被活着找到。这种情况让人想起诗篇46:1，提醒我们即使在压倒性的危机中，雅伟也是我们的避难所和力量。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: China’s demise was gleefully predicted by the west – meanwhile, it built an AI revolution | Larry Elliott
title.zh: 西方曾欢欣鼓舞地预言中国将衰落——与此同时，中国却掀起了一场人工智能革命

summary.en: Free AI models that rival expensive US versions are poised to disrupt global markets, offering a lesson for Britain. While Western predictions of China's economic demise have been frequent, focusing on issues like overinvestment, debt, property collapse, and political repression, China has quietly been building a...
summary.zh: 免费且媲美昂贵美国版本的人工智能模型将颠覆全球市场，并给英国带来启示。尽管西方对中国经济的衰落预测不绝于耳，聚焦于过度投资、债务、房地产崩溃和政治压迫等问题，中国却在悄然掀起一场人工智能革命。

body.en: Free AI models that are as good as the investment-hungry US versions will disrupt global markets, and offer Britain a lesson Almost from the moment it began, the end of the Chinese economic miracle has been much anticipated. Thick and fast, the books have come explaining how it will end badly. Overinvestment. A country wallowing in debt. The collapse of the property market . Political repression. The demand for democracy from a growing middle class. All have been put forward as reasons for the inevitable terminal crisis. Even those impressed by the country’s rapid growth took comfort from the notion that the west would continue to dominate advanced manufacturing while China would be stuck assembling TVs. And while the wait for its much-predicted demise has gone on and on, China has become the workshop of the world. Larry Elliott is a Guardian columnist Continue reading...
body.zh: 与渴望投资的美国版本一样好的免费人工智能模型将扰乱全球市场，并为英国提供一个教训。几乎从它开始的那一刻起，人们就一直在期待中国经济奇迹的结束。厚厚的书很快就来了，解释了它将会如何糟糕的结局。过度投资。一个深陷债务泥潭的国家。房地产市场崩溃。政治镇压。不断壮大的中产阶级对民主的需求。所有这些都被认为是不可避免的终极危机的原因。即使是那些对中国的快速增长印象深刻的人也因西方将继续主导先进制造业而中国将陷入电视机组装的困境而感到安慰。尽管人们对它的消亡的等待一直在持续，但中国已经成为世界工厂。拉里·埃利奥特是《卫报》专栏作家继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence in China, as described in the article, mirrors the prophetic vision of Daniel where knowledge would increase in the end times. This technological surge, while impressive, calls us to consider the wisdom and ethical frameworks guiding its development and application. May we seek to use these powerful tools for...
reflection.zh: 文章所描述的中国人工智能的飞速发展，与但以理书中关于末世知识增长的预言相呼应。这场技术浪潮虽然令人瞩目，却也促使我们反思指导其发展和应用的智慧与伦理框架。愿我们寻求以造物主的智慧与秩序为榜样，善用这些强大的工具。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: The shifting ties in Australia's backyard as 'deep pockets' beckon
title.zh: 澳大利亚后院的变动关系：‘深口袋’的诱惑

summary.en: While China stirs tensions over Taiwan in Palau, island leaders are urging Canberra to focus on climate and drug crime.
summary.zh: 在中国试图在帕劳挑起关于台湾的紧张局势之际，岛屿领导人正敦促堪培拉关注气候变化和毒品犯罪。

body.en:
China and Taiwan's diplomatic tug-of-war is casting a shadow over the ongoing Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) as a handful of national leaders declined to attend — however, experts on the ground caution that a geopolitical focus risks ignoring the core priorities of Australia's neighbours.

The annual 18-member gathering in the Taiwanese-allied nation of Palau opened on Monday with climate change, economic security, and the rising influence of the transnational drug trade top of the agenda.

China has said it has "serious concerns" that Taiwan was invited to attend in its own right, while questions have been raised about whether China has influenced five of 18 national leaders from the forum (those of Kiribati, Fiji, Vanuatu, Samoa and Solomon Island) not to attend.

The cornerstone regional political forum began this year with a pointed message from Palau's President Surangel Whipps Jr, who urged nations to adhere to this year's theme of unity and reminded outside partners that they "do not choose our destination".

This year's PIF takes place as Kiribati moves to constitutionally restrict diplomatic recognition to UN member states only — thus excluding Taiwan — while China actively seeks to strip Taiwan of its 'development partner' status in the forum. This comes nearly two months after a Chinese ballistic missile test in the Pacific Ocean .

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Taiwan, a self-governing democracy, broke away from mainland China in 1949. China views it as Chinese territory that must be brought under its control by force if necessary.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has made strengthening regional ties a key focus of his administration's foreign policy, signing multiple bilateral agreements with countries like Fiji, Vanuatu, and Tuvalu.

But despite the noise around China, "leaders have made it clear they're here to work" Tess Newton Cain, principal consultant at Asia-Pacific strategic firm Sustineo, told SBS News from Koror.

"The issue of the China-Taiwan tussle is largely a distraction, and one that they try to minimise."

On Wednesday, $600 million in Australian funding was announced to tackle transnational drug smuggling from South America that is increasingly causing harm across the Pacific.

China has made the PIF something of a battleground, maintaining that Taiwan ought to be sidelined during talks, as it is not technically a "dialogue partner" due to a difficult compromise that PIF members have reached over its status for the past three decades.

Palau, one of the few nations that maintains official diplomatic ties with Taiwan, has accused China of running a coercion campaign against it after travel...
body.zh: 由于少数国家领导人拒绝出席，中国和台湾的外交拉锯战给正在进行的太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）蒙上了阴影。然而，现场专家警告称，地缘政治焦点可能会忽视澳大利亚邻国的核心优先事项。 一年一度的 18 名成员聚会于周一在台湾盟友帕劳开幕，气候变化、经济安全和跨国毒品贸易影响力不断上升成为首要议题。 中国表示，它“严重关切”台湾本身受邀参加，同时也有人质疑中国是否影响论坛 18 个国家领导人中的 5 个（基里巴斯、斐济、瓦努阿图、萨摩亚和所罗门群岛）不参加。 这一基石区域政治论坛于今年拉开帷幕，帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯发出了尖锐的信息，他敦促各国坚持今年的团结主题，并提醒外部伙伴“我们的目的地不是他们选择的”。 今年的PIF召开之际，基里巴斯从宪法上采取行动，限制仅对联合国成员国进行外交承认，从而将台湾排除在外，而中国则积极寻求剥夺台湾在论坛中的“发展伙伴”地位。这是中国在太平洋进行弹道导弹试验近两个月后的事。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 台湾是一个自治民主国家，于 1949 年脱离中国大陆。中国将其视为中国领土，必要时必须使用武力将其置于其控制之下。 安东尼·阿尔巴内塞总理将加强区域关系作为其政府外交政策的重点，与斐济、瓦努阿图和图瓦卢等国签署了多项双边协议。 不过，尽管中国周围一片喧嚣，“领导人已经明确表示，他们来这里是为了工作”，亚太战略公司 Sustineo 的首席顾问泰丝·牛顿·凯恩 (Tess Newton Cain) 在科罗尔告诉 SBS 新闻。 “中国与台湾的争斗问题在很大程度上是一种干扰，他们试图将其最小化。” 周三，澳大利亚宣布提供 6 亿美元资金，用于打击来自南美洲的跨国毒品走私，这种走私在太平洋沿岸造成的危害日益严重。 中国已将太平洋岛礁论坛变成了一个战场，坚持认为台湾应该在谈判中靠边站，因为过去三十年来，太平洋岛礁论坛成员就其地位达成了艰难的妥协，因此从技术上讲，台湾并不是“对话伙伴”。 帕劳是少数几个与台湾保持正式外交关系的国家之一，该国指责中国在旅行后对其进行胁迫行动......

reflection.en: The leaders of Pacific island nations are navigating complex geopolitical currents, yet their urgent pleas to Australia highlight their immediate concerns: climate change and the drug trade. These are matters of justice and well-being for their people, echoing the prophet Micah's call to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh. Their focus on...
reflection.zh: 太平洋岛国领导人正驾驭复杂的地缘政治暗流，但他们向澳大利亚发出的紧急呼吁，凸显了他们眼前的关切：气候变化和毒品交易。这些关乎其人民的福祉和公义，呼应了先知弥迦的呼召，要行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行。他们关注切实的需要而非遥远的冲突，提醒我们真正的优先事项往往在哪里。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Can communities be proteced from melting glaciers?
title.zh: 社区能否免受冰川融化的影响？

summary.en: Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.
summary.zh: 日益升高的气温增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明，迫切需要解决方案以及可能有助于挽救生命的工具。

body.en:
Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.

High mountain glaciers formed in the ice age are retreating and becoming unstable as the burning of fossil fuels heats the climate and leads to a decline in snowfall.

The instability creates the conditions for large glacial sections to collapse, triggering ice and rock avalanches that can dam river valleys before tidal waves of water are released.

Following the glacier collapse that triggered what is known as a mountain tsunami in Nepal and Tibet on August 26 , thousands are still missing and feared dead. Unlike the 2025 glacier avalanche that destroyed the town of Blatten in Switzerland — where nearly all inhabitants were evacuated — a lack of early warning systems in the Himalayas left locals and tourists at the mercy of flash floods .

The causes of glacier collapse are part of a complex web of interrelated changes to high mountain landscapes due in part to rising global temperatures, say scientists.

Levan Tielidze, research fellow in glacial geomorphology at Australia's Monash University, said the Himalayas are not, as is often imagined, a "frozen and relatively stable environment," but "dynamic systems in which glaciers , snow, permafrost, rock slopes, rivers and monsoon processes interact." 

"As the climate warms, these components are changing simultaneously, meaning hazards can cascade from one process into another," he told DW. When rock, ice and water interact in more unpredictable ways on the world's highest peaks, the resulting debris flows "can transform into a catastrophic flood far downstream."

Almost 25 years ago, in what was then the biggest glacial collapse in history, one glacier crashed onto another in the Caucasus Mountains of North Ossetia in Russia. The event caused avalanches of ice and debris that slid more than 24 kilometers (15 miles) and killed around 125 people.

"The Kolka Glacier disaster was one of the early warnings of the increasing occurrence and potential severity of such glacier-related hazards," said Tielidze. 

Meanwhile, the UN says glaciers in Nepalese mountains have declined by one-third in 30 years, which has added to their instability. 

Some research suggests that even if emissions from burning fossil fuels were low enough to prevent the planet from heating by more than 2 degrees Celsius (3.6 Fahrenheit) compared to pre-industrial times, the wider Hindu Kush Himalayan region could lose up to half its glacier cover — compared to 2020 levels — by the end of the century.

For Dipesh Chapagain, senior scientist at...
body.zh: 气温上升增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明迫切需要解决方案以及可以帮助拯救生命的工具。 由于化石燃料的燃烧导致气候变暖并导致降雪量减少，冰河时代形成的高山冰川正在后退并变得不稳定。 这种不稳定性为大片冰川崩塌创造了条件，引发冰雪崩塌，在潮水释放之前可能会堵塞河谷。 8 月 26 日，冰川崩塌在尼泊尔和西藏引发了山地海啸，之后仍有数千人失踪并恐已死亡。与 2025 年摧毁瑞士布拉滕镇的冰川雪崩不同，那次冰川雪崩几乎所有居民都被疏散，喜马拉雅山缺乏预警系统，导致当地人和游客受到山洪暴发的影响。 科学家表示，冰川崩塌的原因是高山景观相互关联的复杂变化网络的一部分，部分原因是全球气温上升。 澳大利亚莫纳什大学冰川地貌学研究员莱万·蒂利泽 (Levan Tielidze) 表示，喜马拉雅山并不像人们通常想象的那样是一个“冰冻且相对稳定的环境”，而是“冰川、积雪、永久冻土、岩坡、河流和季风过程相互作用的动态系统”。 他告诉德国之声：“随着气候变暖，这些组成部分同时发生变化，这意味着危害可能从一个过程级联到另一个过程。” 当岩石、冰和水在世界最高峰上以更难以预测的方式相互作用时，由此产生的泥石流“可能会在下游转化为灾难性的洪水”。 大约 25 年前，俄罗斯北奥塞梯高加索山脉的一座冰川与另一座冰川相撞，发生了当时历史上最严重的冰川崩塌事件。该事件导致冰雪和碎片滑落超过 24 公里（15 英里），造成约 125 人死亡。 蒂利泽说：“科尔卡冰川灾难是此类冰川相关灾害日益频繁且潜在严重性的早期预警之一。” 与此同时，联合国表示，尼泊尔山区的冰川在 30 年内减少了三分之一，这加剧了冰川的不稳定。 一些研究表明，即使燃烧化石燃料的排放量足够低，足以防止地球升温超过工业化前时期 2 摄氏度（3.6 华氏度），到本世纪末，更广阔的兴都库什喜马拉雅地区的冰川覆盖率可能会比 2020 年的水平减少多达一半。 对于 Dipesh Chapagagain 来说，高级科学家......

reflection.en: The melting glaciers and subsequent disasters in Nepal and Tibet are a stark reminder that our planet groans under the weight of human activity. Romans 8:22 speaks of all creation groaning in travail, awaiting its redemption. This passage calls us to acknowledge the deep interconnectedness of our world and our responsibility to care for it.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏融化的冰川及随之而来的灾难，鲜明地提醒我们，我们的地球在人类活动的重压下呻吟。罗马书8:22说，万物一同叹息劳苦，等候得赎。这段经文呼吁我们认识到我们世界深层的相互联系，以及我们照顾它的责任。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Albanese responds after China warns of 'consequences' over Taiwan at Pacific summit
title.zh: 中国警告台湾出席太平洋岛国论坛将带来“后果”

summary.en: China's top diplomat for Pacific Island Countries, Qian Bo, has warned of 'consequences' regarding Taiwan's presence as a development partner at the annual Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) leaders' meeting in Palau. He expressed China's 'serious concerns' and called Taiwan's participation 'inappropriate,' though he denied...
summary.zh: 中国太平洋岛国事务特使钱波警告，台湾作为太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）年度领导人会议的发展伙伴出席将带来“后果”。他表达了中国“严重关切”，并称台湾的参与“不恰当”，但他否认其言论是威胁。

body.en:
Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has stopped short of criticising China over threats of "consequences" for Taiwan's attendance at an annual Pacific summit, saying the forum decides who takes part.

Albanese's comments follow a warning from China's top Pacific Islands diplomat, who said "there will always be consequences" for Taiwan's strong presence at the annual Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) leaders' meeting in Palau, with the highly charged three-day talks officially starting on Tuesday.

Albanese said he was "not distracted" when asked if Taiwan's presence was a distraction. Asked if he thought it was appropriate for China to make threats, the prime minister said: "The Pacific Islands Forum determines what happens here, not any other country."

Earlier, China's special envoy for Pacific Island affairs, Qian Bo, denied his comments were a threat, but said China has "serious concerns" about Taiwan's status as a development partner at the forum.

"There will always be consequences. You know, this is objected to by all, so this should not have happened. We think it's very inappropriate to do so," he told Australian reporters while leaving the forum's opening ceremony on Monday.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Taiwan, a self-governing democracy, broke away from mainland China in 1949. Beijing views it as Chinese territory that must be brought under its control by force if necessary .

Like the United States, Australia recognises and has formal ties with China, but maintains unofficial ties with Taiwan.

Neither China nor Taiwan are part of the 18-member group at the forum, but countries including the United States and China have traditionally been invited as dialogue partners. Taiwan has been categorised as a development partner since 1993 and is being represented this year by foreign minister Lin Chia-lung, along with a sizeable delegation.

Palau is one of only three Pacific nations to have diplomatic relations with Taiwan, which has created great friction between the hosts and China over the past decade. In 2017, China placed de facto "tourist bans" on the tiny Micronesian country, which received 40 per cent of its GDP from the tourism industry, in an apparent attempt to sway Palau's diplomatic position away from Taiwan.

Palau's president Surangel Whipps Jr said on Sunday he was aware there would be "threats" of retaliation if Taiwan attended this year's talks.

"Let's not use this as a place that we should be threatening or making people feel uncomfortable," he told reporters.

"China doesn't tell us that we cannot be a partner to Taiwan. That is our sovereign decision, not their decision."

Qian also claimed China has the "understanding and...
body.zh: 中国太平洋岛国最高外交官警告说，台湾在帕劳举行的太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）年度领导人会议上的强势参与“总会产生后果”，拉开了周二正式开始的为期三天的高度紧张的会谈。 北京太平洋岛国事务特使钱波否认他的言论构成威胁，但表示中国对台湾在论坛上作为发展伙伴的地位“严重关切”。 “总会有后果的。你知道，这是所有人都反对的，所以这不应该发生。我们认为这样做是非常不合适的，”他在周一离开开幕式时告诉澳大利亚记者。 中国和台湾都不属于该论坛的 18 个成员国，但美国和中国等国家历来被邀请作为对话伙伴。台湾自1993年起就被列为发展伙伴，今年由外交部长林家龙率领一个规模庞大的代表团出席。 帕劳是仅有的三个与台湾建交的太平洋国家之一，过去十年来，东道主与中国之间产生了巨大摩擦。 2017年，北京对这个密克罗尼西亚小国实施了事实上的“旅游禁令”，该国GDP的40%来自旅游业，显然是试图动摇帕劳的外交立场，使其远离台北。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯周日表示，他知道如果台湾参加今年的会谈，将会有“报复威胁”。 他对记者说：“我们不要把这里当作我们应该威胁或让人们感到不舒服的地方。” “中国没有告诉我们，我们不能成为台湾的合作伙伴。这是我们的主权决定，而不是他们的决定。” 钱其琛还声称，中国得到了PIF“大多数”成员国的“理解和支持”，并向帕劳“非常明确”地表明了自己的立场。 今年的PIF在正式开始前就陷入了争议，六位领导人被确认缺席，其中包括即将离任的论坛主席、所罗门群岛总理马修·韦尔，以及基里巴斯亲北京总统塔内蒂·马毛，后者特意派了前驻华大使大卫·蒂博代替。 他们缺席的原因包括国家议会职责和健康问题，威尔士已抵达科罗尔，并被迫在周末返回家乡，以应对可能的领导挑战。但缺席的关键领导人让人怀疑，在为期三天的活动中，是否可以就关键议程项目（包括气候行动）采取有意义的集体行动……

reflection.en: As leaders gather in Palau for the Pacific Islands Forum, diplomatic tensions simmer. China's envoy has voiced strong objections to Taiwan's participation, warning of 'consequences.' In such moments of heightened political friction, the call to pursue peace and seek diplomatic solutions, even amidst disagreement, remains paramount.
reflection.zh: 在太平洋岛国论坛领导人在帕劳举行会议之际，外交紧张局势悄然升温。中国特使对台湾的参与表达了强烈反对，并警告将有“后果”。在政治摩擦加剧的时刻，即使存在分歧，寻求和平与外交解决方案的呼吁仍然至关重要。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: How China buried Tibet flood images after Nepal disaster
title.zh: 中国如何掩埋了尼泊尔灾难后的西藏洪水图像

summary.en: In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.
summary.zh: 在西藏，一场致命的洪水摧毁了中国和尼泊尔边境的社区，随后出现了数字审查。审查人员删除了病毒式传播的画面，而中国官方媒体则用官方内容充斥了各大平台。

body.en:
In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.

When a catastrophic flash flood swept through the rugged China-Nepal border on August 26, the physical devastation was immediate.

In Nepal , a black torrent of mud and rock tore through communities, leaving hundreds dead and thousands more missing along the borderlands.

But across the frontier in Tibet, an autonomous region of China , the physical disaster was almost instantly followed by a digital one: the rapid, high-tech erasure of the catastrophe's visual evidence.

As survivors tried to upload raw footage of the deluge, China's state-backed information control apparatus swung into action, executing a sophisticated, precision operation to shape the public narrative and bury inconvenient truths.

The contrasting realities — a tragic humanitarian crisis in Nepal and a tightly sanitized, triumphant rescue narrative in China — reveal the evolving mechanics of Beijing's modern censorship machine.

Rather than imposing a blunt, blanket blackout, authorities deployed advanced image-recognition technology and "saturated information" tactics to drown out domestic scrutiny while deflecting diplomatic friction abroad.

In the immediate aftermath of the flood-triggered mudslide, local residents captured dramatic footage of the torrent engulfing Gyirong Port, a critical overland trade hub between China and Nepal.

The most striking video showed a black wall of water and debris crashing into and destroying the "national" border gate.

In an article titled "An Unrecorded Mudslide Rushes into Gyirong Port" on China's WeChat, a universal app that combines messaging with payment options and social media functions, local blogger "Matou Qingnian" described the chaotic scene.

"The most terrifying moment happened at the Gyirong Port," the author wrote, describing video footage of crowds, including children, fleeing in panic before a pitch-black torrent swallowed the camera's view.

Within hours, both the article and the raw video footage had vanished from Chinese social media .

According to  China Digital Times (CDT) , an independent watchdog that tracks Chinese internet censorship , the video of the collapsing border gate was systematically blocked from being shared on WeChat, even in private messages.

"The footage itself contained no graphic violence, no protests, and no political slogans," explained Mira, a CDT editor who specializes in tracking sensitive keywords and media. "The target of the censorship was the symbol itself: the National Gate."

Digital analysts note that this censorship highlights a significant upgrade...
body.zh: 在西藏，致命的洪水摧毁了中尼边境沿线的社区，随后进行了数字镇压。审查机构删除了病毒式传播的视频，而中国官方媒体则在平台上充斥着官方内容。 8 月 26 日，一场灾难性的山洪席卷崎岖的中尼边境，造成了立即的破坏。 在尼泊尔，一股黑色泥浆和岩石洪流席卷了边境地区的社区，造成数百人死亡、数千人失踪。 但在中国西藏自治区的边境地区，这场物理灾难几乎立刻就发生了一场数字灾难：灾难的视觉证据被迅速、高科技删除。 当幸存者试图上传洪水的原始镜头时，中国国家支持的信息控制机构立即采取行动，执行复杂而精确的操作，以塑造公众叙事并掩盖难以忽视的真相。 对比鲜明的现实——尼泊尔悲惨的人道主义危机和中国严密消毒、胜利的救援故事——揭示了北京现代审查机制不断演变的机制。 当局没有实施生硬、全面的封锁，而是采用了先进的图像识别技术和“饱和信息”策略来淹没国内审查，同时转移国外的外交摩擦。 洪水引发的泥石流发生后，当地居民拍下了洪流吞没吉隆港的戏剧性镜头，吉隆港是中国和尼泊尔之间重要的陆路贸易枢纽。 最引人注目的视频显示，黑色的水墙和碎片冲撞并摧毁了“国家”边境大门。 当地博主“马头青年”在中国微信（一款将消息传递、支付选项和社交媒体功能结合在一起的通用应用程序）上发表了一篇题为“一场未记录的泥石流冲进吉隆口岸”的文章，描述了当时的混乱场面。 “最可怕的时刻发生在吉隆口岸，”作者写道，并描述了包括儿童在内的人群在漆黑的洪流吞没摄像机视野之前惊慌失措的画面。 几个小时内，这篇文章和原始视频片段就从中国社交媒体上消失了。 据追踪中国互联网审查制度的独立监管机构中国数字时代（CDT）称，倒塌边境大门的视频被系统性地禁止在微信上分享，甚至在私人信息中也是如此。 专门跟踪敏感关键词和媒体的 CDT 编辑米拉解释说：“视频本身不包含暴力画面、抗议活动和政治口号。” “审查的目标是标志本身：国门。” 数字分析师指出，这次审查凸显了重大升级......

reflection.en: The story describes how visual evidence of a devastating flood in Tibet was systematically erased, replaced by official narratives. This act of censorship raises questions about truth and transparency, reminding us of the importance of speaking truthfully and avoiding deception, as Ephesians 4:25 urges.
reflection.zh: 故事描述了西藏一场毁灭性洪水的视觉证据如何被系统性地抹去，并被官方叙事所取代。这种审查行为引发了关于真相和透明度的疑问，提醒我们说实话和避免欺骗的重要性，正如以弗所书4:25所敦促的那样。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

Last weekend’s March for Australia rally drew significantly less media attention than the previous anti-immigration protests under its banner, when politicians including Pauline Hanson and Bob Katter were speakers.

Organisers pivoted from campaigning against “mass immigration” to arguments over “free speech” – including calling for the ban of the White Australia party , formerly the National Socialist Network (NSN), to be overturned. March for Australia’s ties to white nationalist ideas have been widely reported, including in an ABC investigation .

This time, organisers’ support for neo-Nazis was more blatant. The neo-Nazi activist Thomas Sewell was described on its social media page as a “political prisoner”, and dozens of NSN members were reportedly in attendance. News24, which last year ran columns describing the protests as a “show of defiance” from people with “genuine concerns” who “deserve to be heard” , fell mute.

One outlet that did give the protesters a run was the Daily Mail. Its report described “deplorable scenes” in Melbourne, but quoted in full an offensive mock Welcome to Country delivered by the controversial comedian Lisa Jane Spencer – and embedded a video of her speech, despite saying she “cruelly mocks Aboriginal culture”. The article was uploaded to the Daily Mail’s Facebook page, attracting hundreds of comments, many supportive of the protest, before the post was deleted.

Spencer, who received widespread criticism earlier this year for a satirical video in which she depicted a fictional Aboriginal character, “Aunty Lisa”, sniffing petrol, has only relatively recently made a name for herself as a darling of the right. Before becoming a comedian, she was a musician performing under the name Aeora, receiving a number of plays on Triple J unearthed , and had a stint attempting to make it as a Byron Bay content creator before pivoting to satire.

In 2017 she told oneofone , a charity championing women and non-binary people in music, that the industry still had a “heap” of privilege. “I acknowledge I’m a white cis straight female … But the industry is still not representative of trans people, queer people, people of colour,” she said. Interesting, given a month ago, she depicted herself in a joke video as a Muslim woman running an NDIS scam.

Has Kyle Sandilands finally gone too far even for his loyal fans? Monday’s episode of his new-ish program forced viewers to endure a 15-minute tirade in which he berated staff for technical issues with the show.

The bulk of his anger was...
body.zh: 《每日邮报》3 月份澳大利亚集会的报道全文引用了丽莎·简·斯宾塞无礼短剧的视频，并嵌入了视频。另外：人工智能带我们回到 1956 年 想每周五将其发送到您的收件箱吗？在此订阅《野兽周刊》媒体时事通讯 上周末的“为澳大利亚游行”集会引起的媒体关注明显少于之前以其旗帜下的反移民抗议活动，当时包括波林·汉森（Pauline Hanson）和鲍勃·卡特（Bob Katter）在内的政界人士发表了讲话。 组织者从反对“大规模移民”的运动转向“言论自由”的争论，包括呼吁推翻对白澳大利亚党（前身为国家社会主义网络（NSN））的禁令。澳大利亚游行与白人民族主义思想的联系已被广泛报道，包括美国广播公司的一项调查。 这一次，组织者对新纳粹的支持更加明目张胆。新纳粹活动家托马斯·休厄尔在其社交媒体页面上被描述为“政治犯”，据报道有数十名国家安全网络成员出席。 News24去年曾发表专栏，将抗议活动描述为那些“真正关心问题”、“值得被倾听”的人的“反抗表现”，但现在却陷入了沉默。 《每日邮报》确实给抗议者带来了挑战。该报告描述了墨尔本的“可悲场景”，但全文引用了备受争议的喜剧演员丽莎·简·斯宾塞发表的冒犯性模仿《欢迎来到乡村》，并嵌入了她的演讲视频，尽管称她“残酷地嘲笑了原住民文化”。这篇文章被上传到《每日邮报》的 Facebook 页面，吸引了数百条评论，其中许多人支持抗议，随后该帖子被删除。 斯宾塞今年早些时候因一段讽刺视频而受到广泛批评，视频中她描绘了一个虚构的原住民角色“丽莎阿姨”在嗅汽油，但直到最近，她才以右翼宠儿的身份而闻名。在成为喜剧演员之前，她是一名以 Aeora 为名的音乐家，在 Triple J 上演出了多部戏剧，并在转向讽刺之前曾尝试成为拜伦湾的内容创作者。 2017 年，她告诉 oneofone（一家支持音乐界女性和非二元性别人群的慈善机构），该行业仍然拥有“一大堆”特权。 “我承认我是一名白人顺性别女性……但这个行业仍然不能代表跨性别者、酷儿、有色人种，”她说。有趣的是，一个月前，她在一个笑话视频中将自己描绘成一名实施 NDIS 骗局的穆斯林妇女。 即使对于他的忠实粉丝来说，凯尔·桑迪兰兹最终是否也走得太远了？周一，他的新节目迫使观众忍受 15 分钟的长篇大论，他在节目中斥责工作人员的技术问题。 他的大部分愤怒是……

reflection.en: Words have immense power, capable of causing deep offense and harm, as seen in the comedian's skit amplified by the Daily Mail. Proverbs 18:21 reminds us that "the tongue has the power of life and death," urging us to consider the impact of our speech and to use it constructively rather than destructively.
reflection.zh: 言语拥有巨大的力量，能够造成深刻的冒犯和伤害，正如《每日邮报》所放大的喜剧演员的滑稽表演所见。箴言18:21提醒我们“生死在舌头下”，敦促我们考虑言语的影响，并以建设性而非破坏性的方式使用它们。

verse.textEn: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
verse.textZh: 生死在舌头的权下；喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。

title.en: Who are the Australians missing in the Nepal floods? What we know so far
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水失踪的澳大利亚人是谁？我们目前所知

summary.en: Thirty-six Australians are among thousands missing following deadly flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border. Rescue efforts are ongoing, with some previously unaccounted-for Australians confirmed safe this week, including a 25-year-old Sydney woman.
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏边境发生致命的洪水灾害后，有数千人失踪，其中包括36名澳大利亚人。救援工作仍在进行中，本周已有几名此前失踪的澳大利亚人被确认安全，其中包括一名25岁的悉尼女子。

body.en: There are 36 Australians among the thousands of people missing as rescue efforts continue after deadly flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The number of Australians missing in the Nepal-Tibet flash flooding disaster has fallen to 36, after two further people were confirmed safe on Friday. It comes after five previously unaccounted for Australians were confirmed safe earlier this week, with one found in Nepal, one in Tibet and three outside the crisis-hit area. A Sydney woman, Cara Severino , 25, was also safely located in Nepal more than two days after the 26 August floods. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏边境发生致命山洪后，救援工作仍在继续，数千人失踪，其中有 36 名澳大利亚人失踪 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 周五确认又有两人安全后，在尼泊尔-西藏山洪灾害中失踪的澳大利亚人人数已降至 36 人。本周早些时候，五名下落不明的澳大利亚人被确认安全，其中一名在尼泊尔，一名在西藏，三名在危机重灾区之外。 8 月 26 日洪水发生两天多后，一名 25 岁的悉尼妇女卡拉·塞韦里诺 (Cara Severino) 在尼泊尔也被安全找到。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of 36 Australians missing in the Nepal floods is a stark reminder of how quickly lives can be disrupted by natural forces. In times of crisis, the vulnerability of individuals, especially those far from home, comes into sharp focus. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves and to defend the rights of the poor...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔洪水导致36名澳大利亚人失踪的消息，令人警醒地提醒我们生命如何可能被自然力量瞬间颠覆。在危机时刻，个人的脆弱性，尤其是那些远离家乡的人，变得尤为突出。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们为那些不能为自己说话的人说话，并为贫穷和有需要的人辩护。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: The bond market is blowing up right now – should Australians be worried?
title.zh: 债券市场火爆！澳大利亚人应该担心吗？

summary.en: Bond yields in major advanced economies are at their highest levels since before the Global Financial Crisis. Australia's 10-year government debt interest rate has surpassed 5.2%, a level not seen in over 15 years. Experts attribute this rise to a confluence of factors impacting the global economy and financial...
summary.zh: 主要发达经济体的债券收益率已达到自全球金融危机前以来的最高水平。澳大利亚政府十年期债务的利率已超过5.2%，这是15多年来的最高点。专家认为，多种因素共同作用，推高了收益率，这不仅仅是近几周的现象。

body.en: Major bond sell-off across major advanced economies, with yield at highs not see since before the GFC Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Bonds are supposed to be safe and boring. Which means when bond markets are getting exciting , you can bet that something big is going down in the global economy and the world of finance. Continue reading...
body.zh: 这意味着当债券市场变得令人兴奋时，您可以打赌全球经济和金融界正在发生重大事件。 澳大利亚 10 年期政府债务利率已跃升至 5.2% 以上，为 15 年来的最高水平。 据彭博社报道，自全球金融危机之前以来，主要发达经济体的债券收益率从未达到过如此高的水平。 随着日本摆脱长达数十年的通缩恐慌，其 10 年期债券利率自 1996 年以来首次达到 3%。 专家表示，多种力量正在联合起来推动收益率走高，而且不仅仅是最近几周。 正如 CBA 利率研究主管 Adam Donaldson 所解释的那样：“债券是衡量其他资产的基准，也是未来增长、通胀、债务可持续性和现金利率前景的晴雨表。” 由于中东冲突没有结束的迹象，投资者正在考虑全球更持久的通胀压力。 这意味着央行更有可能要么进一步加息以控制价格压力，要么不太可能降息。 无论哪种方式，债券收益率都需要更高，以反映更高的通胀和更高的利率。 专家还表示，最近债券收益率的飙升反映出人们对发达国家，尤其是美国的巨额债务水平的担忧日益加剧。 美国政府用于偿还 40 万亿美元债务的资金比用于国防的资金还要多。事实上，每年 1.2 万亿美元的净利息支付使其成为美国预算中的第二大支出项目。 没有人认为美国人会拖欠债务，但发达国家的借贷负担正在削弱人们对政府管理预算能力的信任，而债券投资者则要求提高利率来解决这一问题。 “我们认为，在幕后，对资本的竞争是这里的驱动力，”他说。 投资和储蓄之间的平衡“在过去十年中发生了决定性的变化”，这不仅仅是因为各国对债务和支出的胃口不断扩大。 大型科技公司正在借入大量资金进行投资，以争夺未来人工智能行业（无论是数据中心还是半导体）的领先地位。 唐纳森表示：“现在，由于储蓄短缺来为全球所有这些支出提供资金，这给利率带来了压力。” “这意味着平均现金利率将必须比他们在新冠疫情之前和之后几年的预期高出很多。” 分析师表示，债券收益率的上升表明，未来的资金将比以往更加昂贵——是的，这确实……

reflection.en: The news of soaring bond yields, pushing Australia's 10-year rate above 5.2%, underscores a fundamental economic principle: the burden of debt. When borrowing costs rise significantly, it can feel like a tightening grip, reminding us of the ancient wisdom that 'the borrower is slave to the lender.' This economic reality affects national budgets and...
reflection.zh: 债券收益率飙升的消息，将澳大利亚十年期利率推至5.2%以上，凸显了一个基本的经济原则：债务的负担。当借贷成本显著上升时，会让人感到束缚收紧，这让人想起古老的智慧：“欠债的人是债主的仆人。”这种经济现实影响着国家预算，也可能影响家庭财务，突显了全球市场与个人福祉之间的相互关联。

verse.textEn: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.
verse.textZh: 富户管辖穷人；欠债的是债主的仆人。

Philippians 4:8 calls us to focus on whatever is true, noble, right, pure, lovely, admirable, excellent, or praiseworthy, even as we acknowledge the difficult realities around...
reflection.zh: 新闻周期带来了各种复杂的全球性挑战，从气候警告到经济不稳定。在这样的时代，将我们的思想锚定在良善和真实的事物上至关重要。腓立比书4:8呼吁我们专注于一切真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事，即使在承认我们周围的艰难现实的同时。

title.en: Pacific leaders voice concern over Chinese missile test but stop short of condemnation
title.zh: 太平洋领导人对中国导弹试验表示担忧，但未予谴责

summary.en: The Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) concluded with most member nations agreeing to "register concern" over China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test, which overflew several members without adequate notice. Leaders urged transparency and advance notification for such tests, with Nauru being the sole...
summary.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）闭幕，多数成员国同意就中国近期洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）试验“表示关切”，该试验在未获充分通知的情况下飞越了部分成员国领土。领导人敦促所有进行ICBM试验的国家确保透明度和保障，包括按照国际惯例至少提前24小时发出通知。18个成员国中，瑙鲁是唯一一个对此条款持异议的国家。

body.en:
The Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) has wrapped up with most nations agreeing to "register concern" on China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test, "which overflew a number of members without adequate notice".

"Leaders call on all states undertaking ICBM testing to ensure transparency and reassurance, including through the provision of advance notification of a test at least 24 hours in accordance with international practice," the communique says, as read out by Palau's President and PIF chair Surangel Whipps Junior, after the closing ceremony.

In a rare move for the usually consensus-based forum, Nauru was the only one of 18 PIF members to dissent from the clause.

Kiribati and Nauru were the only two Pacific nations that had previously blocked a draft PIF statement in the immediate aftermath of Beijing's test, a move that Prime Minister Anthony Albanese had been advocating for.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

However the statement went further than analysts and government sources had expected; the PIF foreign ministers' meeting statement in August was broader, discussing ballistic missile testing in the region, but had stopped short of singling out a particular ICBM or referencing a notice period for nations to undergo any testing.

Whipps also hit back against China's comments that Palau sensationalised its ballistic missile test, saying: "There's no sensationalism, it's just stating the facts."

"The Pacific Islands weren't informed [of the test]. The ones that were informed were informed late, and so I think the message from the forum is clear: that transparency needs to happen."

Intelligence shows the nuclear-capable intercontinental ballistic missile test in July flew over the Philippines, Palau and Micronesia's airspace before landing in the Pacific Ocean.

The response has become something of a litmus test for PIF and its members for their strategic positioning.

The communique's relevant clause includes a reference to the Fiji-led Ocean of Peace declaration made last year, which states the region should be free from coercion and militarisation.

However, it doesn't name China, nor does it use heftier diplomatic language than "concern".

While Australian officials were happy with the agreed statement, it fell short of some pre-retreat expectations, including those of the host, Palau.

"They sent a missile next to French Polynesia, another one next to Tuvalu, crossing over our airspace. They never bothered to tell us that's what's happening," he said.

body.zh: 太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）结束时，大多数国家同意对中国最近的洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）试验“表达关切”，“该试验在没有充分通知的情况下飞越了一些成员国”。 帕劳总统兼太平洋岛国论坛主席苏兰吉尔·惠普斯·儒尼奥尔在闭幕式后宣读的公报称，“领导人呼吁所有进行洲际弹道导弹测试的国家确保透明度和保证，包括根据国际惯例至少提前 24 小时提前通知测试情况”。 对于这个通常以共识为基础的论坛来说，这是一个罕见的举动，瑙鲁是 18 个 PIF 成员中唯一不同意该条款的国家。 基里巴斯和瑙鲁是此前在北京试验后立即阻止PIF声明草案的仅有的两个太平洋国家，此举是总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯一直倡导的。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 然而，该声明超出了分析师和政府消息人士的预期；太平洋岛国论坛外交部长八月份的会议声明范围更广，讨论了该地区的弹道导弹试验，但没有单独指出特定的洲际弹道导弹或提及各国进行任何试验的通知期。 惠普斯还反驳了中国关于帕劳炒作其弹道导弹试验的言论，他说：“没有煽情，只是陈述事实。” “太平洋岛屿没有被告知（这次测试）。那些被告知的人却很晚才被告知，所以我认为论坛传达的信息很明确：需要实现透明度。” 情报显示，7月份进行的具有核能力的洲际弹道导弹试验飞越了菲律宾、帕劳和密克罗尼西亚的领空，然后降落在太平洋上。 这一回应已成为 PIF 及其成员战略定位的试金石。 公报的相关条款包括提及斐济去年发表的《和平海洋宣言》，该宣言指出该地区不应受到胁迫和军事化。 然而，它没有点名中国，也没有使用比“关切”更重的外交语言。 虽然澳大利亚官员对商定的声明感到满意，但它没有达到一些退会前的预期，包括东道主帕劳的预期。 “他们向法属波利尼西亚发射了一枚导弹，又向图瓦卢发射了一枚导弹，飞越了我们的领空。他们从来没有费心告诉我们发生了什么，”他说。 “我说‘日本和关岛之间有很大的空间，你为什么不把它送到那里？为什么它必须来到太平洋中部，去年我们刚刚签署了一份……

Their call for transparency and advance notification echoes the ancient prophetic vision of a world where such instruments of potential conflict are managed with greater care and consideration for all nations....
reflection.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛的领导人对近期一次未获充分预警便飞越其领土的洲际弹道导弹试验表示关切。他们呼吁提高透明度和提前通知，这呼应了古代先知的异象——一个世界，在那里，潜在冲突的工具能够得到更谨慎的处理，并顾及所有国家。 这一时刻凸显了国家安全利益与地区稳定之间的微妙平衡，敦促在国际事务中走上更加开放和相互保证的道路。

title.en: 'Hard to continue': Harvey's future is in limbo as his sport faces an existential threat
title.zh: 这些澳大利亚人依赖狭窄的训练窗口。今年它几乎没有打开

summary.en: Australia has just experienced one of the warmest winters on record, causing panic among those who use its mountains. Professional snow athletes, like snowboarder Harvey Edmanson, are self-funded and struggle to find training opportunities in Australia, threatening their careers.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚刚刚经历了创纪录的温暖冬季，这让依赖其山脉的人们感到恐慌。像单板滑雪运动员哈维·埃德曼森这样的职业雪上运动员是自费训练的，他们在澳大利亚难以找到训练机会，这威胁着他们的职业生涯。

body.en:
Ski resorts across Australia have faced one of the hottest winters on record. For Australian snowboarder Harvey Edmanson, this is a threat to his future, and to the future of young snow athletes across Australia.

Speaking to SBS, the member of the Australian Alpine Snowboard National Team said: "If I don't have snow and training opportunities in Australia, it's going to make it really hard to continue."

Many professional snow athletes, including Edmanson, are self-funded. He has to fit his training around working as a façade designer in Melbourne.

The 27-year-old does most of his training at Mount Buller in Victoria but also ventures further north to the Perisher and Thredbo resorts in NSW.

Typically, he aims to train on the slopes from early July until late September. This year his start was delayed by three weeks and he was forced to stop in late August.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Additionally, to train at a high level, Edmanson and other athletes need a sectioned-off part of the slope where they can set up racing conditions.

Ski resorts are usually happy to accommodate this, but have found it harder this year due to having a smaller area with sufficient snow depth.

"When there's only limited snow and limited run hill space, then it's not possible," Edmanson said.

Australian snow athletes often compete overseas during the northern hemisphere’s winter before returning to train in Australia in the off-season.

As snow seasons get shorter, Edmanson said athletes are skipping Australia entirely and starting to look overseas for off-season training.

This is not something he can do given he needs to work, and he joked that he "can't commute to New Zealand".

Some in the snow sports community fear for future generations of Australian snow athletes if opportunities continue to dwindle for younger athletes seeking to develop.

Edmanson runs a futures program for developing athletes and says there's a lot of young athletes who are "looking to compete, looking to train, and they don't get enough time on snow in Australia".

Many younger athletes need to balance school and practice. Edmanson didn’t travel overseas to compete until he finished school.

"The most important part of my training and development all happened in Australia," he said. "It's really scary that there's a lot of young athletes that might not have that opportunity."

This year’s Milano Cortina Winter Olympics provided an injection of optimism into Australian snow sports after the Australian team won a national best three golds, two silvers and one bronze.

To continue this momentum, Edmanson says we need to give young athletes "that opportunity...
body.zh: 澳大利亚各地的滑雪胜地面临着有记录以来最热的冬天之一。对于澳大利亚单板滑雪运动员哈维·埃德曼森（Harvey Edmanson）来说，这对他的未来以及澳大利亚年轻滑雪运动员的未来构成了威胁。 澳大利亚高山滑雪国家队成员在接受 SBS 采访时表示：“如果我在澳大利亚没有雪和训练机会，我将很难继续下去。” 许多职业雪上运动员，包括埃德曼森，都是自筹资金的。他必须适应在墨尔本担任幕墙设计师的工作所接受的培训。 这位 27 岁的球员大部分训练都在维多利亚州的布勒山进行，但也会冒险前往更北的新南威尔士州的佩里舍 (Perisher) 和斯雷德博 (Thredbo) 度假村。 通常，他的目标是从七月初到九月底在斜坡上训练。今年他的出发时间推迟了三周，并在八月下旬被迫停止。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 此外，为了进行高水平训练，埃德曼森和其他运动员需要将斜坡划分出一部分，以便他们设置比赛条件。 滑雪场通常很乐意满足这一要求，但今年发现难度更大，因为面积较小，雪深足够。 埃德曼森说：“当雪量有限且滑坡空间有限时，这是不可能的。” 澳大利亚雪上运动员经常在北半球的冬季前往海外比赛，然后在淡季返回澳大利亚训练。 埃德曼森说，随着雪季变短，运动员们将完全跳过澳大利亚，开始到海外进行休赛期训练。 鉴于他需要工作，这不是他能做的事情，他开玩笑说他“无法通勤到新西兰”。 雪上运动界的一些人担心，如果寻求发展的年轻运动员的机会继续减少，澳大利亚未来几代的雪上运动员就会担心。 埃德曼森运营着一个培养运动员的未来计划，他说有很多年轻运动员“想要参加比赛，想要训练，但他们在澳大利亚没有足够的时间在雪上”。 许多年轻运动员需要平衡学业和训练。埃德曼森直到完成学业才出国参加比赛。 “我的训练和发展中最重要的部分都发生在澳大利亚，”他说。 “这真的很可怕，很多年轻运动员可能没有这样的机会。” 今年的米兰科尔蒂纳冬奥会，澳大利亚队夺得全国最好成绩三金两银一铜，为澳大利亚雪上运动注入了乐观的情绪。 埃德曼森说，为了保持这种势头，我们需要给年轻运动员“这个机会......

This situation evokes Habakkuk's lament, where even in the face of devastating crop failure and economic hardship, the prophet chooses to find joy in Yahweh. title.en: Antisemitism royal commission to report later than planned
title.zh: 反犹太主义皇家委员会报告推迟

summary.en: The Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion has extended its reporting deadline by four days to avoid coinciding with the first anniversary of the Bondi Massacre, a mass shooting that claimed 15 lives. Commissioner Virginia Bell stated the extension was requested to ensure the report does not overshadow...
summary.zh: 反犹太主义和社会凝聚力皇家委员会将其报告截止日期延长了四天，以避免与邦迪大屠杀一周年纪念日发生冲突，该屠杀事件造成 15 人死亡。委员会主席弗吉尼亚·贝尔表示，延长是为了确保报告不会盖过 12 月 14 日（袭击周年纪念日）的庄严悼念活动。

body.en:
The Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion has had its deadline extended by four days so that it does not clash with the anniversary of the Bondi Massacre.

The months-long royal commission was slated to hand down its final report on 14 December, the first anniversary of the mass shooting that left 15 people dead. The commission will now report on 18 December.

In a statement, commissioner Virginia Bell AC SC said she requested the extension from the federal government so that her final report did "not overshadow the first anniversary of the Bondi Chanukah attack".

"The 14th of December will be a solemn occasion marked by memorials," the statement said.

"I am aware of concern within the Jewish community that delivery of the report on the anniversary would be a distraction. I welcome this short extension."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Established on 9 January, the royal commission heard evidence from 348 witnesses over 62 days of hearings in Sydney and Melbourne.

Bell is currently preparing her final report, which will examine this evidence alongside more than 20,000 public submissions.

On 26 August, the final day of public hearings, Bell told the commission her focus had been on the lives of ordinary Jewish Australians.

"The Bondi Chanukah attack came after more than two years of a marked increase in antisemitism throughout Australia," she said.

"Laying out the picture of the lived experience of antisemitism is a critical part of any steps to combat that phenomenon."

An interim report was released on 30 April and made 14 recommendations to strengthen counterterrorism responses.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .

title.en: This toxic online world has an unstoppable pull. That may be about to change
title.zh: 孩子们正被拖入一个令人不安的“兔子洞”。如果我们关掉它会怎样？

summary.en: A proposal to fundamentally change how Australians experience social media is gaining traction. The idea is to require social media companies to offer users an option to disable algorithms, defaulting instead to a chronological feed of posts from friends and followed accounts. This aims to protect young people from...
summary.zh: 一项从根本上改变澳大利亚人体验社交媒体方式的提议正在获得关注。该想法是要求社交媒体公司向用户提供禁用算法的选项，默认情况下改为按时间顺序显示朋友和关注的账户的帖子。此举旨在保护年轻人免受有害的在线内容（如厌女内容）的侵害，研究人员发现，这些内容可能在几分钟内就被推送给未成年人。

body.en:
The manosphere wouldn't disappear from the internet. But what if we took away the rabbit hole?

That's one of the questions posed by consent advocate Chanel Contos to change the way Australians experience social media and protect young people from the harmful effects of misogynistic online content.

Her organisation, Teach Us Consent, has been campaigning for reforms that would require social media companies to offer Australians a feature that opts them out of algorithms, instead giving people the option to see posts from friends and accounts they follow by default.

International researchers posing as boys aged between 16 and 18 were likely to be fed misogynistic content within 23 minutes of signing up to certain social media accounts, highlighting the role recommendation algorithms can play in exposing young men to harmful ideas.

Contos, in a speech to the National Press Club on Wednesday, accused big tech companies of radicalising young men into harmful sexual acts and called for strict reforms.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

She cited research that suggested the manosphere — an online ecosystem of influencers and communities promoting hypermasculine tropes — should be understood as "a business with various actors who share the same commercial infrastructure who have identified male psychology as a market".

Members of the federal government have signalled support for the proposal amid a broader effort to address the rising rate of sexual violence among young people and a troubling spate of recent incidents.

Teachers have also raised concerns that attitudes from the manosphere are surfacing in Australian schools and driving gendered abuse towards them.

As proposed reforms gain increasing prominence, how much of the manosphere's power actually comes from the algorithm — and what could happen if we switched it off?

Experts note that the ideas driving the manosphere are far from new, but algorithms have transformed how widely and easily they reach young men.

"The manosphere was once used to describe fringe online communities. Men largely had to create an account, sign up, and actively participate in these online message and largely text-based forums," Krista Fisher, research fellow at the Movember Institute of Men's Health, told SBS News.

"The way that the manosphere functions and exists in 2026 is so deeply intertwined with recommender systems, and we've seen that in research," she said.

The rabbit hole can begin with seemingly innocuous content about fitness, dating or self-improvement, before recommendation algorithms begin serving them increasingly extreme material about masculinity and gender roles.

reflection.en: Chanel Contos's advocacy for young people, pushing social media companies to offer algorithmic choice, speaks to the ancient call to be a voice for the voiceless. Her organization, Teach Us Consent, is actively working to shield vulnerable youth from the damaging currents of online misogyny, demonstrating a practical application of defending the defenseless.
reflection.zh: 香奈尔·孔托斯（Chanel Contos）为年轻人发声，推动社交媒体公司提供算法选择，这呼应了古老的为无声者发声的呼召。她的组织“教我们同意”（Teach Us Consent）正积极努力保护弱势青少年免受网络厌女症的有害影响，这体现了保护无助者的实际行动。

title.en: 'Enormous interest': Coalition says exiled crown prince of Iran will visit Australia
title.zh: “浓厚兴趣”：联盟表示伊朗流亡王储将访问澳大利亚

summary.en: The Coalition says Reza Pahlavi has accepted the party's invitation.
summary.zh: 联盟表示，礼萨·帕拉维已接受该党邀请。

body.en:
Six months after United States President Donald Trump attacked Iran and called for regime change in the country, the Coalition says the exiled crown prince of Iran will visit Australia at their invitation.

Reza Pahlavi is the son of the shah of Iran, who was ousted by the Islamic Revolution. Pahlavi has lived outside Iran since 1979, and has long advocated for the fall of the current regime, positioning himself as an alternative leader for the country.

In a statement, Opposition foreign affairs spokesperson Ted O'Brien said the party's invitation to Pahlavi was not an endorsement of his leadership in Iran.

"Iran's future belongs to the Iranian people. It is not for Australia to determine who should lead Iran or what form its future government should take," O'Brien said.

The statement said the Coalition was "responding to Iranian-Australians who want their voices heard".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"We should be prepared to listen to credible voices advocating for a peaceful and democratic alternative to the regime in Tehran."

The statement said Pahlavi had accepted the Coalition's invitation to visit Australia for the first time since 1978, before his father's regime was overthrown.

The details of this visit are yet to be finalised, but the statement said Coalition MPs and senators would meet "virtually" with the former crown prince in the coming weeks "to discuss the situation in Iran, the aspirations of the Iranian people and his advocacy for a democratic transition to a secular Iran".

In its statement, the Coalition said the invitation had come off the back of "enormous interest from the Iranian-Australian community".

"Thousands of Persian Australians have signed our petition to bring Reza Pahlavi to Australia, Liberal MP Julian Leeser said.

O'Brien said engagement with Iranian-Australians formed part of the Coalition's broader engagement with diaspora communities.

"For decades, the Iranian people have suffered under a brutal terrorist regime that represses its own citizens, exports terror abroad and denies its people basic freedoms."

After entering exile alongside his father Mohammad Reza Pahlavi — the last shah of Iran — Reza Pahlavi has become an avid supporter of opponents to Iran's ayatollahs.

Now living in the US, he has positioned himself as a person who could lead a secular, democratic Iran. He has seen his support soar in Iran and throughout the Iranian diaspora.

In January, domestic demonstrations against the regime gripped Iran, as protesters took to the streets in the thousands to protest the country's economic problems and the regime itself.

The government responded with a communications blackout...
body.zh: 在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普攻击伊朗并呼吁该国政权更迭六个月后，该联盟表示，流亡的伊朗王储将应他们的邀请访问澳大利亚。 礼萨·巴列维（Reza Pahlavi）是被伊斯兰革命推翻的伊朗国王的儿子。巴列维自 1979 年以来一直居住在伊朗境外，长期以来一直主张推翻现政权，将自己定位为该国的替代领导人。 反对党外交事务发言人泰德·奥布莱恩在一份声明中表示，该党邀请巴列维并不意味着支持他在伊朗的领导地位。 奥布莱恩表示：“伊朗的未来属于伊朗人民。谁应该领导伊朗，或者未来的政府应该采取什么形式，这不是由澳大利亚来决定的。” 声明称，该联盟正在“回应那些希望自己的声音被听到的伊朗裔澳大利亚人”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “我们应该准备好倾听主张以和平、民主的方式取代德黑兰政权的可信声音。” 声明称，巴列维接受了联盟党的邀请，自1978年（其父政权被推翻之前）以来首次访问澳大利亚。 此次访问的细节尚未敲定，但声明称，联盟党议员和参议员将在未来几周内与前王储“虚拟”会面，“讨论伊朗局势、伊朗人民的愿望以及他对向世俗伊朗民主过渡的主张”。 该联盟在声明中表示，这一邀请是出于“伊朗-澳大利亚社区的巨大兴趣”。 自由党议员朱利安·利泽说：“数千名波斯裔澳大利亚人签署了我们的请愿书，将礼萨·巴列维带到澳大利亚。” 奥布莱恩表示，与伊朗裔澳大利亚人的接触是联盟与侨民社区更广泛接触的一部分。 “几十年来，伊朗人民一直遭受残酷的恐怖主义政权的迫害，该政权镇压本国公民，向国外输出恐怖，并剥夺其人民的基本自由。” 在与他的父亲穆罕默德·礼萨·巴列维（伊朗最后一位国王）一起流亡后，礼萨·巴列维已成为伊朗阿亚图拉反对者的狂热支持者。 现在居住在美国，他将自己定位为一个可以领导世俗、民主伊朗的人。他在伊朗和整个伊朗侨民中的支持率飙升。 一月份，伊朗国内爆发了针对该政权的示威活动，数千名抗议者走上街头，抗议该国的经济问题和该政权本身。 政府的回应是通讯中断……

reflection.en: Reza Pahlavi, the exiled heir to Iran's throne, has accepted an invitation to visit Australia. For decades, he has advocated for change in his homeland, positioning himself as a potential alternative leader. This visit brings attention to the ongoing struggles and aspirations of the Iranian people for self-determination.
reflection.zh: 伊朗流亡王储礼萨·帕拉维已接受澳大利亚的访问邀请。数十年来，他一直倡导祖国的变革，并将自己定位为潜在的替代领导人。此次访问将人们的目光引向伊朗人民持续的斗争和对自决的渴望。

title.en: 3 easy wins to modernise Hong Kong’s education system
title.zh: 香港教育系统现代化的三个简单方法

summary.en: The article argues that Hong Kong's primary and secondary education system requires a significant overhaul, not just its higher education sector. It emphasizes the need for a new blueprint to equip students with relational intelligence and other skills necessary to navigate a world increasingly shaped by AI,...
summary.zh: 文章认为，香港的初等和中等教育体系需要进行彻底的改革，而不仅仅是高等教育领域。它强调需要一个新蓝图，为学生配备在日益受人工智能、地缘政治变化和价值观冲突影响的世界中所需的交往智能和其他技能。

body.en: Much has been said about Hong Kong’s vitality as a higher education hub. Yet, a radical rethink of our primary and secondary school system is equally necessary. The need for a blueprint has never been clearer. Our world is increasingly defined by the powerful forces of automation enabled by artificial intelligence (AI), geopolitical tensions and flux, as well as conflicting values and perspectives. Workplaces and communities alike demand talent in possession of relational intelligence,...
body.zh: 关于香港作为高等教育中心的活力，人们已经谈了很多。然而，对我们的中小学系统进行彻底的反思同样必要。对蓝图的需求从未如此清晰。我们的世界日益被人工智能 (AI) 带来的强大自动化力量、地缘政治紧张局势和变化以及相互冲突的价值观和观点所定义。工作场所和社区都需要拥有关系智能的人才，...

reflection.en: The rapid pace of change, driven by AI and global flux, presents a profound challenge for education systems worldwide. Proverbs 22:6 reminds us that how we 'train up a child' has lasting consequences. Hong Kong's call for a 'radical rethink' highlights the urgent need to equip the next generation not just with knowledge, but with the wisdom and relational...
reflection.zh: 人工智能和全球变动所驱动的快速变革步伐，给世界各地的教育体系带来了严峻的挑战。《箴言》22:6提醒我们，我们如何“教养孩童”会产生长远的影响。香港呼吁对教育体系进行“彻底的改革”，凸显了为下一代装备知识以及应对复杂未来的智慧和人际交往能力的紧迫性。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.zh: 为什么香港人北上就医，更快更便宜

Sarah Tam, a 30-year-old social worker, spent a month at a Shenzhen post-partum care center after giving birth, appreciating the round-the-clock...
summary.zh: 香港居民越来越多地前往中国内地，特别是深圳，寻求医疗服务，包括产后护理，因为那里服务更快、成本更低。30岁的社工 Sarah Tam 在香港分娩后，在中国内地的深圳一家产后护理中心度过了一个月，她赞赏那里为新生儿提供的全天候护理，让她得以休息和恢复。

body.en: Soon after becoming a mother, Hong Kong resident Sarah Tam enjoyed eight hours of sleep a night and yoga sessions at a post-partum care centre in neighbouring Shenzhen, where carers looked after her newborn around the clock. Tam, a 30-year-old social worker who gave birth in mid-July, spent a month at the facility in mainland China, recovering from delivery with total peace of mind. She said she felt completely at ease leaving her baby in their care, which allowed “mothers to truly focus on...
body.zh: 成为母亲后不久，香港居民谭莎拉 (Sarah Tam) 每晚享受八小时的睡眠，并在邻近深圳的产后护理中心参加瑜伽课程，那里的护理人员全天候照顾她的新生儿。谭（Tam）是一位 30 岁的社会工作者，于 7 月中旬生下孩子，在中国大陆的该机构待了一个月，完全安心地产后恢复。她说，把孩子交给他们照顾，她感到完全放心，这让“母亲们能够真正专注于......

reflection.en: The story of Sarah Tam finding peace of mind and dedicated care for her newborn in Shenzhen speaks to the deep human desire for well-being and security for one's children. This echoes the ancient wisdom that children are a gift from Yahweh, a blessing to be cherished and nurtured.
reflection.zh: Sarah Tam 在深圳找到安心并为新生儿获得悉心照料的故事，反映了人类对自身福祉和子女安全的深切渴望。这与古老的智慧相呼应：孩子是雅伟所赐的恩典，是值得珍惜和培育的祝福。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: Tai Po fire: 13 Wang Fuk Court owners refuse gov’t buyout as 99% agree to sell
title.zh: 大埔火災：13戶王福樓業主拒絕政府回購協議，99%同意出售

summary.en: Thirteen homeowners at the fire-damaged Wang Fuk Court have failed to meet the government's deadline for its buyout scheme, according to housing authorities. The scheme offered cash or a new flat in exchange for selling their homes. The estate, which housed 1,984 households, was devastated by a fire last November that...
summary.zh: 據房屋當局稱，在火災中受損的王福樓有十三戶業主錯過了政府的強制拍賣計劃截止日期。該計劃提供現金或新的政府資助房屋以換取業主出售其單位。該屋邨在去年十一月的一場致命火災中被毀，造成168人死亡，原住有1,984戶。截至周四，已有1,971戶同意了該計劃的條款。

body.en: Thirteen homeowners at fire-hit Wang Fuk Court have missed the government’s deadline to participate in an official buyout scheme, according to city housing authorities. Wang Fuk Court after deadly fire, April 23, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Owners had until 5pm on Monday to sign and return a letter of acceptance agreeing to sell their flats to the government in return for a cash payment or a new flat in another government-subsidised estate. The government-subsidised residential estate in Tai Po accommodated 1,984 households in eight buildings before a deadly fire hit the estate, claiming 168 lives in November last year. The government said on Thursday that 1,971 households had submitted the acceptance letter before this deadline, signalling their intention to sell their titles to the government. That represents 99.3 per cent of all Wang Fuk Court households. Of these, 1,595 owners – 80.9 per cent of the total – took the next step in the process, signing a formal sale and purchase agreement with government-appointed estate administrators. “The government will continue to follow up on procedures for acquiring the remaining titles at full speed,” authorities said in a statement on Thursday. No extensions Officials previously said that the Monday deadline would not be extended, and the government had not ruled out using “legislative means” to acquire the remaining unsold units in the future. Betty Ho, a Wang Fuk Court homeowner, refused to sell her flat to Hong Kong government. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Betty Ho, a Wang Fuk Court homeowner who refuses to sell her flat to the government , told HKFP earlier this month that it would be “robbing” residents of their private property if the government tried to acquire unsold titles by law. “I am interested to see how [the government] could make such a law. It would completely ruin Hong Kong,” Ho said in Cantonese. Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong, who heads the government task force arranging long-term accommodation for residents, earlier said that the government could start the legislative process for acquiring unsold titles as early as next year. Wong added that if the government were to handle unsold titles by law, compensation would be “substantially lower” than the buyout offer that expired on Monday. Wang Fuk Court on fire in late November 2025. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The government announced a buyout scheme in February, with the prices set at HK$8,000 or HK$10,500 per square foot, depending on whether the homeowner had paid land premiums. Under the buyout scheme, homeowners were offered either a cash payout or a unit in another subsidised estate through a flat-exchange exercise.
body.zh: 据市住房部门称，遭受火灾的宏福苑的 13 名房主错过了政府参与官方买断计划的最后期限。致命火灾后的宏福苑，2026 年 4 月 23 日。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。业主必须在周一下午 5 点之前签署并返回一份同意书，同意将其公寓出售给政府，以换取现金付款或在另一个政府补贴的房产中购买新公寓。位于大埔的政府资助住宅小区共有八栋楼宇，共容纳了 1,984 户家庭，去年 11 月发生致命火灾，造成 168 人死亡。政府周四表示，已有 1,971 户家庭在截止日期前提交了录取通知书，表明他们打算将所有权出售给政府。这占宏福苑所有家庭的 99.3%。其中，1,595 名业主（占总数的 80.9%）采取了下一步行动，与政府指定的房地产管理人员签署了正式的买卖协议。当局在周四的一份声明中表示：“政府将继续全速跟进获取剩余产权的程序。”不延期 官员此前表示，周一的最后期限不会延长，政府也不排除未来使用“立法手段”收购剩余的未售单位。宏福苑房主何贝蒂 (Betty Ho) 拒绝将她的公寓出售给香港政府。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。宏福苑的房主Betty Ho拒绝将自己的公寓出售给政府，她本月早些时候告诉《香港新闻社》，如果政府试图通过法律收购未售出的产权，那将是“掠夺”居民的私人财产。 “我很想知道（政府）如何制定这样的法律。这将彻底毁掉香港，”何先生用粤语说道。负责为居民安排长期住宿的政府特别工作组负责人的副财政司长黄伟纶早些时候表示，政府最早可以在明年启动收购未售出产权的立法程序。黄补充说，如果政府依法处理未售出的产权，赔偿将“大大低于”周一到期的买断要约。宏福苑于 2025 年 11 月下旬起火。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。政府在2月份宣布了一项买断计划，价格定为每平方英尺8,000港元或10,500港元，视乎业主是否缴付地价而定。根据买断计划，房主要么获得现金支付，要么通过统一交换活动获得另一个补贴房产的单位。

reflection.en: In the aftermath of the devastating fire at Wang Fuk Court, the government offered a buyout scheme to help residents rebuild their lives. While the vast majority accepted, thirteen homeowners chose not to participate. This situation underscores the complex needs and decisions faced by those affected by tragedy, and the government's responsibility to provide...
reflection.zh: 在王福樓災難性火災之後，政府提供了一項回購計劃，以幫助居民重建生活。儘管絕大多數人接受了該計劃，但仍有十三戶業主選擇不參與。這一情況凸顯了受災難影響的居民所面臨的複雜需求和抉擇，以及政府對其公民的責任。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Hong Kong poised to top New York, London in finance-hub ranking: GFCI creator
title.zh: 香港有望超越纽约伦敦，成为金融中心：GFCI创作者

summary.en: Hong Kong is well-positioned to become the world's leading financial center, potentially surpassing New York and London, according to Michael Mainelli, creator of the Global Financial Centres Index. He cited Hong Kong's legal predictability and low tax rates as key advantages contributing to its strong performance in...
summary.zh: 根据全球金融中心指数（GFCI）的创作者迈克尔·梅内利（Michael Mainelli）的说法，香港有潜力超越纽约和伦敦，成为全球领先的金融中心。他指出，香港的法律可预测性和低税率是其在排名中表现强劲的关键优势。

body.en: An Asian city will eventually overtake London and New York as the world’s leading financial centre, with Hong Kong well placed to compete for the top spot given its legal predictability and low tax burden, according to the creator of a closely watched ranking of financial hubs. “It’s going to happen because it’s so tight,” said Michael Mainelli, chairman of London-based think tank Z/Yen Group, in an interview with the South China Morning Post on Tuesday, referring to the narrowing gap between...
body.zh: 一项备受关注的金融中心排名的创建者表示，亚洲城市最终将超越伦敦和纽约，成为世界领先的金融中心，而香港凭借其法律可预测性和较低的税收负担，在争夺头把交椅方面处于有利地位。总部位于伦敦的智库 Z/Yen Group 董事长迈克尔·梅内利 (Michael Mainelli) 周二在接受《南华早报》采访时表示：“这种情况将会发生，因为它是如此紧张。”他指的是……之间的差距正在缩小。

reflection.en: The prospect of Hong Kong rising to the top of global financial rankings is a testament to strategic planning and favorable economic conditions. As leaders and institutions pursue such ambitious goals, the ancient wisdom of committing their endeavors to divine guidance offers a foundation for true and lasting success. May their work be blessed and their...
reflection.zh: 香港有望在国际金融排名中跃居榜首，这证明了战略规划和有利的经济条件的重要性。当领导者和机构追求如此宏伟的目标时，将他们的努力托付于神圣指引的古老智慧，为真正而持久的成功奠定了基础。愿他们的工作得到祝福，他们的努力结出硕果，造福大众。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。
