reflection.en: In Hong Kong, news of raids and arrests connected to a purported cancer vaccine highlights the ongoing tension between innovation and integrity in healthcare. This situation calls us to reflect on the principles of justice and mercy, urging those in positions of authority and influence to act with fairness and compassion, ensuring that the pursuit of health...
reflection.zh: 在香港，与所谓癌症疫苗相关的搜查和逮捕新闻，凸显了医疗保健领域创新与诚信之间持续存在的紧张关系。这一情况促使我们反思公义与怜悯的原则，敦促当权者和有影响力的人以公平和同情心行事，确保追求健康解决方案的根基在于道德实践和对人民福祉的真诚关怀。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Festival seeks tourism bonanza in finer things in life
title.zh: 盛宴寻求生活中的精致事物以吸引游客

summary.en: Hong Kong is launching its first 'Festival of Connoisseurs' from November 4-6 at AsiaWorld-Expo, featuring luxury items like private jets, supercars, yachts, jewelry, fine art, rare wines, and haute cuisine. This high-end exhibition, utilizing a new 'citywide exhibition' model, is the first project funded by the...
summary.zh: 香港将于11月4日至6日在亚洲国际博览馆举办首届“鉴赏家节”，展出私人飞机、超级跑车、游艇、珠宝、艺术品、名酒和美食等奢侈品。这个高端展览采用创新的“全城展览”模式，是政府一项旨在吸引具有新概念的大型国际展览的1亿港元计划资助的首个项目。

body.en: Hong Kong will host its inaugural "Festival of Connoisseurs" from November 4 to 6 at AsiaWorld-Expo, showcasing an array of luxury goods such as private jets, supercars, yachts, jewellery, fine art, rare wines and haute cuisine. The high-end exhibition features Asia’s first "citywide exhibition" model and will extend beyond AsiaWorld-Expo to landmark venues across Hong Kong when it expands to a full-scale format next year. Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau said the event is the first to be funded by the government's HK$100 million initiative – outlined in this year's Budget – aimed at attracting large-scale international exhibitions with new concepts. “It showcases to the world that Hong Kong is a good place, a platform, for the branded goods, either from the mainland or from overseas,” he said. “So the impact and [economic] effect has to be evaluated later on after the event is introduced after November this year. “But, for a normal exhibition, the spending power of an individual is around HK$9,300. I believe this kind of mega, high-profile event, with super yachts, super cars, the visitors will spend more in Hong Kong and will bring benefits to the Hong Kong economic development.” Dan Ye, vice president at event organiser Informa Markets, said the event is expected to attract 3,000 high-end visitors during its soft launch in November, with that figure doubling for the full-scale launch next year. He noted that while the airport area will serve as the main exhibition site, several iconic local landmarks are also set to host events in the future. “We will choose different types of locations for the events, ranging from, for example, M+ Museum in the West Kowloon District, to the waterfront in Wan Chai and Central.” “Also, we are exploring [having] yacht tours towards some of the islands on the Hong Kong coastline.” The long-term vision, he stressed, is to create a yacht show at Skytopia – a new waterfront entertainment and commercial landmark under development near the airport – that will end up being Asia’s largest. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 香港将于11月4日至6日在亚洲国际博览馆举办首届“鉴赏家节”，展示私人飞机、超级跑车、游艇、珠宝、精美艺术品、名酒和高级美食等一系列奢侈品。该高端展览采用亚洲首个“全城展览”模式，明年全面扩展后，将超越亚洲国际博览馆，延伸至香港各地的地标场馆。商务及经济发展局局长邱腾华表示，该活动是政府今年预算案中首个拨款一亿港元的计划，旨在吸引具有新概念的大型国际展览。 “它向世界展示了香港是一个好地方，一个平台，无论是来自内地还是海外的品牌商品，”他说。 “因此，影响和（经济）效果必须在今年11月之后推出后才能评估。“但是，对于一个正常的展览，个人的消费能力约为9,300港元。我相信这种大型、高规格的活动，有超级游艇、超级汽车，游客会在香港消费更多，也会为香港经济发展带来好处。”活动主办方 Informa Markets 副总裁 Dan Ye 表示，该活动预计在 11 月试运营期间将吸引 3,000 名高端参观者，明年全面启动时这一数字将增加一倍。他指出，虽然机场地区将作为主要展览场地，但当地的几个标志性地标也将在未来举办活动。 “我们会选择不同类型的地点举办活动，例如西九龙区的M+博物馆，到湾仔和中环的海滨。” “此外，我们正在探索前往香港海岸线上的一些岛屿的游艇之旅。”他强调，长期愿景是在 Skytopia（机场附近正在开发的新海滨娱乐和商业地标）举办游艇展，最终将成为亚洲最大的游艇展。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: The Hong Kong government is investing significantly in a new 'Festival of Connoisseurs,' aiming to attract international attention and economic activity through luxury goods. This initiative reflects a strategic plan to boost tourism and establish the city as a hub for high-end exhibitions. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh,...
reflection.zh: 香港政府正投入巨资举办新的“鉴赏家节”，旨在通过奢侈品吸引国际关注和经济活动。这项举措体现了提振旅游业、将香港打造成高端展览中心的战略规划。箴言16:3提醒我们，要将我们的工作和计划交托给雅伟，相信当我们的计划与祂的旨意一致，并以智慧和诚信去执行时，它们必得以建立。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Language requirement change from Cantonese to Chinese not targeting specific students – HKU med school
title.zh: 港大医学院：语言要求从粤语改为中文并非针对特定学生

summary.en: The University of Hong Kong (HKU) medical school has stated that changing its admission prerequisites from Cantonese to Chinese proficiency was not intended to target students from any specific background. The Li Ka Shing Faculty of Medicine explained that the alteration aims to 'comprehensively assess the overall...
summary.zh: 香港大学（港大）医学院表示，将其入学先决条件从粤语能力改为中文能力并非针对任何特定背景的学生。李嘉诚医学院解释说，此举旨在“全面评估来自不同背景的申请人的整体能力”，并不构成“降低”录取标准。

body.en: The University of Hong Kong (HKU)’s medical school has said that revising its admission prerequisites from Cantonese to Chinese proficiency was not meant to target students from any particular background. The University of Hong Kong’s Li Ka Shing Faculty of Medicine. Photo: Peter Lee/HKFP. The Li Ka Shing Faculty of Medicine’s statement, emailed to HKFP on Wednesday, said the changes do not constitute a “lowering” of admission standards, and are intended to ensure the admissions policy can “comprehensively assess the overall capabilities of applicants from diverse backgrounds.” Earlier this week, local media reported that the medical school had updated its website to reflect revised language requirements for its six-year Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery programmes. While enrolment in the programmes used to require “a good working knowledge” of Cantonese, that description has now been changed to Chinese. In an FAQ page, the faculty states that candidates must be fluent in either Cantonese or Mandarin, but that students must develop “effective Cantonese skills” once enrolled. Cantonese proficiency an ‘essential foundation’ In the email, the faculty said the updated requirements did not imply that students were allowed to use Mandarin instead of Cantonese at public hospitals while undertaking clinical work. The University of Hong Kong’s Li Ka Shing Faculty of Medicine. File photo: HKUMed. “Because graduates will serve Hong Kong residents in the future, strong Cantonese proficiency forms an essential foundation for clinical training and medical services,” the statement read. “All students are required to possess the necessary Cantonese skills to communicate effectively with local patients,” it said, adding that the faculty would provide language support for those whose Cantonese is not proficient when admitted. The English language requirement remains unchanged. Classes in the faculty are mainly taught in English. HKU is one of two universities in Hong Kong to house a medical school. The Chinese University of Hong Kong also offers a medical programme, and the government has approved the establishment of a third medical school at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, which is expected to begin taking students in 2028.
body.zh: 香港大学（HKU）医学院表示，将其入学要求从粤语改为中文水平并不是为了针对任何特定背景的学生。香港大学李嘉诚医学院。照片：Peter Lee/HKFP。李嘉诚医学院周三通过电子邮件发给HKFP的声明称，这些变化并不构成“降低”录取标准，旨在确保招生政策能够“全面评估来自不同背景的申请者的整体能力”。本周早些时候，当地媒体报道称，医学院更新了其网站，以反映其六年制医学学士和外科学士课程的修订后的语言要求。虽然这些项目的入学要求过去需要“良好的粤语工作知识”，但现在这一描述已改为中文。在常见问题解答页面中，教师们指出，候选人必须精通粤语或普通话，但学生在入学后必须培养“有效的粤语技能”。粤语水平是“必备基础” 在电子邮件中，教师们表示，更新的要求并不意味着学生可以在公立医院进行临床工作时使用普通话而不是粤语。香港大学李嘉诚医学院。资料图：香港大学医学院。声明称：“由于毕业生将来将为香港居民服务，因此较强的粤语能力是临床培训和医疗服务的重要基础。”声明称：“所有学生都必须具备必要的粤语技能，以便与当地患者进行有效沟通。”并补充说，学院将为那些粤语不流利的学生在入学时提供语言支持。英语语言要求保持不变。学院的课程主要以英语授课。香港大学是香港设有医学院的两所大学之一。香港中文大学亦开设医学课程，政府已批准在香港科技大学设立第三所医学院，预计于2028年开始招生。

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge and understanding is a core human endeavor, and educational institutions play a vital role in this process. When institutions like HKU's medical school adjust their admissions criteria, the stated intention is often to better evaluate the diverse capabilities of applicants. This reflects a commitment to seeking the best ways to...
reflection.zh: 追求知识和理解是人类的核心追求，教育机构在此过程中扮演着至关重要的角色。当港大医学院这样的机构调整其招生标准时，其声明的意图通常是为了更好地评估申请人的多元能力。这反映了其致力于寻求最佳方式来促进学习和培养未来的专业人士的承诺。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Schools, ferry routes suspended as Typhoon Saudel lashes east China
title.zh: 台风“灿都”袭击华东，学校和渡轮航线停运

summary.en: Authorities in China's Fujian province closed schools and suspended ferry services on Thursday as Typhoon Saudel approached, bringing warnings of heavy rain. This follows a pattern of extreme weather events in China over recent months, which have included torrential rainfall and mass evacuations.
summary.zh: 周四，中国福建省当局关闭学校并暂停渡轮服务，因为台风“灿都”来袭并带来强降雨预警。这与近几个月来中国极端天气事件频发的模式一致，包括暴雨和大规模疏散。

body.en: Authorities closed schools and suspended ferry routes in eastern China’s Fujian province on Thursday, after forecasters warned of heavy rain brought about by Typhoon Saudel. A satellite view of Typhoon Saudel making landfall on China’s eastern coast on August 28, 2026. Photo: CSU/CIRA & JMA/JAXA. Extreme weather has wreaked havoc in parts of China during the past few months, with a slew of typhoons bringing torrential rainfall and triggering the evacuation of hundreds of thousands of people. Typhoon Saudel made its third landfall in China on Fujian’s coast on Thursday morning, according to local authorities, after earlier lashing neighbouring Zhejiang province twice. Schools in the cities of Fuzhou and Quanzhou halted in-person activities, while some tourist attractions including theme parks were also temporarily closed in Fuzhou, local media outlets reported. A total of 24 passenger ferry routes along the coast of Fujian were suspended on Thursday, state broadcaster CCTV reported. The province’s emergency management authority warned of rainstorms and secondary disasters including flash floods and landslides. “The province is currently experiencing a period of persistent, heavy rainfall,” it said in a WeChat statement. Around 247,700 people in high-risk areas in neighbouring Fujian had been evacuated last week, after authorities had warned of heavy rain, Xinhua news agency reported. At least 159 people were killed in southern China’s Guangxi region in July after Typhoon Maysak triggered devastating floods. Scientists warn the intensity and frequency of extreme weather events will increase as the planet continues to heat up because of fossil fuel emissions. China is the world’s biggest emitter of greenhouse gases, but it is also a global renewable energy powerhouse that aims to make its massive economy carbon-neutral by 2060. A catastrophic flood sliced through the border area between Nepal and China’s Tibet region last week, killing more than 1,200 people and leaving more than 4,750 missing as of Thursday, heightening concerns globally over the growing risks of climate change.
body.zh: 在预报员警告台风“萨德尔”带来大雨后，中国东部福建省周四关闭了学校并暂停了轮渡航线。 2026 年 8 月 28 日台风“萨德尔”登陆中国东部沿海的卫星图。照片：CSU/CIRA & JMA/JAXA。过去几个月，极端天气给中国部分地区造成严重破坏，一系列台风带来暴雨，导致数十万人撤离。据地方当局称，台风“萨德尔”周四上午在中国福建沿海第三次登陆，此前该台风曾两次袭击邻近的浙江省。据当地媒体报道，福州和泉州两市的学校停止了线下活动，福州主题公园等一些旅游景点也暂时关闭。据中央电视台报道，周四福建沿海共有 24 条客运轮渡航线暂停。该省应急管理部门警告称，可能会出现暴雨和山洪、山体滑坡等次生灾害。该省在微信声明中表示：“目前，我省正经历持续强降雨时期。”据新华社报道，上周当局发出大雨警告后，邻国福建高风险地区约 247,700 人被疏散。 7 月，台风美莎克引发特大洪水，造成中国南部广西地区至少 159 人死亡。科学家警告说，随着化石燃料排放导致地球持续升温，极端天气事件的强度和频率将会增加。中国是世界上最大的温室气体排放国，但它也是全球可再生能源大国，目标是到2060年使其庞大的经济实现碳中和。上周，一场灾难性洪水席卷了尼泊尔和中国西藏地区之间的边境地区，截至周四，造成1,200多人死亡，4,750多人失踪，加剧了全球对日益增长的气候变化风险的担忧。

reflection.en: Typhoon Saudel's approach forced the closure of schools and suspension of ferry routes in Fujian province, disrupting daily life. In times of natural disaster, when familiar routines are overturned and safety is uncertain, we can remember that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a present help in times of trouble. Even amidst the chaos of storms, there is a...
reflection.zh: 台风“灿都”的逼近迫使福建省关闭学校并暂停渡轮服务，扰乱了日常生活。在自然灾害时期，当熟悉的日常被打乱，安全变得不确定时，我们可以铭记雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是患难中随时的帮助。即使在风暴的混乱中，也存在着坚定的盼望。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Shein shares slide on fast-fashion retailer’s stock market debut
title.zh: Shein股票上市首日下跌，快时尚零售商估值缩水

summary.en: Shares of the fast-fashion brand Shein fell as much as 10% on their debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The company, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, was valued at just over $26 billion, a significant drop from its previous valuation of nearly $100 billion.
summary.zh: 快时尚品牌Shein在香港证券交易所上市首日股价下跌高达10%。这家中国创立、现总部设在新加坡的公司，估值略高于260亿美元，远低于其此前近1000亿美元的估值。

body.en: Hong Kong flotation at $26bn by firm once valued at $100bn follows failure to list in US and UK Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein slumped by as much as 10% as the China-founded company made its long-anticipated trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The Singapore-headquartered company, once valued at almost $100bn (£74bn), went public on Tuesday pricing shares at HK$48.56, valuing the business at just over $26bn. Continue reading...
body.zh: 曾估值 1000 亿美元的公司在香港发行 260 亿美元，此前该公司未能在美国和英国上市。快时尚品牌 Shein 在香港证券交易所首次上市后，其股价下跌了 10%。这家总部位于新加坡的公司一度估值近 1000 亿美元（740 亿英镑），周二上市，股价为 48.56 港元，业务估值略高于 260 亿美元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic drop in Shein's valuation on its Hong Kong stock market debut, from nearly $100 billion to just over $26 billion, serves as a potent reminder of the volatile nature of commerce. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans, a wisdom that transcends market highs and lows.
reflection.zh: Shein在香港股市上市首日估值从近1000亿美元暴跌至略高于260亿美元，这有力地提醒我们商业的波动性。箴言16:3鼓励我们将所做的事交托给雅伟，信靠祂必成就我们的计划，这智慧超越了市场的起伏。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: France recorded 'hottest summer ever': Environment minister
title.zh: 法国创下“有记录以来最热夏天”：环境部长

summary.en: France recorded its hottest summer ever in 2026, characterized by heat waves, drought, and extensive wildfires, according to the environment minister. This record-breaking heat follows similar trends in Belgium and Britain, indicating a broader European and global warming pattern.
summary.zh: 法国环境部长表示，2026年法国经历了创纪录的最热夏季，其特点是热浪、干旱和大规模野火。这一创纪录的高温紧随比利时和英国的类似趋势，表明了更广泛的欧洲和全球变暖模式。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

France experienced its hottest summer on record in 2026, marked by heat waves, drought and massive wildfires, the environment minister said Thursday.

"We have just lived through the hottest summer ever recorded since measurements began in 1900," Monique Barbut said at a presentation of the summer climate report, which for meteorologists covers June through August.

France joins Belgium and Britain in recording their hottest summers on record after a season that scorched Europe, the globe's fastest-warming continent.

Scientists say human-made climate change has made extreme weather events more intense and more frequent.

France endured multiple severe heat waves, including one in late June that set a new intensity record.

Another, stretching from late July into August, matched the record for the country's longest heat wave, lasting 23 days, a mark previously set in 1983.

"By the end of August, forest fires had already burned six times more area than the average of the past 20 years," Barbut said.

The weather service Météo-France said Thursday that the country saw 53 days of heat wave conditions over the summer, a "completely unprecedented number."

"The question we must now ask ourselves is how it will be remembered: As the first in a long series of summers that continue to break records, or as a moment when we rose to the challenge of adaptation and mitigation by reducing greenhouse gas emissions," she added.

Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu tasked Barbut in late July with presenting new measures to speed up implementation of France's national climate change adaptation plan.

On Thursday, she promised conclusions "by the end of September," including a five-year funding plan.

The heat waves were deadly across Europe, with French authorities recording thousands of excess deaths .

Across the French capital, where few homes have air conditioning, some locals taped foil survival blankets over their windows, trying to keep out the sun.

Schools were shuttered, and there were rushes on fans and air-conditioning units.

"We will not have renovated all schools by next summer, but at the very least we can have shutters and air circulators installed," Barbut said, acknowledging some "situations for which we could have been better prepared."

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 法国环境部长周四表示，2026 年法国经历了有记录以来最热的夏季，出现热浪、干旱和大规模野火。 “我们刚刚经历了自 1900 年开始测量以来有记录以来最热的夏季，”莫妮克·巴布特在夏季气候报告的演示会上说道，该报告对气象学家来说涵盖了六月到八月。 法国与比利时和英国一起迎来了有记录以来最热的夏季，此前欧洲是全球变暖最快的大陆，经历了一个炎热的季节。 科学家表示，人为造成的气候变化使极端天气事件变得更加强烈和频繁。 法国经历了多次严重的热浪，其中六月下旬的热浪创下了新的强度记录。 另一场从 7 月下旬持续到 8 月的热浪，追平了该国持续 23 天的最长热浪记录，这一记录是 1983 年创下的。 巴布特说：“截至 8 月底，森林火灾烧毁面积已是过去 20 年平均面积的六倍。” 法国气象局周四表示，该国今年夏天出现了 53 天的热浪天气，这是“前所未有的数字”。 “我们现在必须问自己的问题是，它将如何被人们记住：作为一系列持续打破记录的夏季中的第一个，或者作为我们通过减少温室气体排放来迎接适应和缓解挑战的时刻，”她补充道。 七月下旬，法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努责成巴布提出新措施，以加快实施法国国家气候变化适应计划。 周四，她承诺“在九月底”得出结论，其中包括五年资助计划。 热浪在整个欧洲造成了致命的后果，法国当局记录了数千人的死亡人数。 在法国首都，很少有家庭有空调，一些当地人在窗户上贴上铝箔救生毯，试图遮挡阳光。 学校停课，人们争先恐后地购买风扇和空调。 巴布特说：“到明年夏天，我们不会翻修所有学校，但至少我们可以安装百叶窗和空气循环器。”他承认，有些“情况我们本可以做好更好的准备”。 物理学硕士，具有研究经验。长期科学新闻爱好者。在 Science X 的编辑成功中发挥着关键作用。完整档案 →

reflection.en: The news from France paints a stark picture of our planet's changing climate, with 2026 marking the hottest summer on record. This extreme weather serves as a potent reminder that the Earth, in all its beauty and power, belongs to Yahweh. As stewards of this creation, we are called to care for it with wisdom and responsibility.
reflection.zh: 法国传来的消息描绘了我们星球气候变化的严峻景象，2026年创下了有记录以来最热夏季的纪录。这种极端天气有力地提醒我们，这片美丽而强大的大地属于雅伟。作为这创造的管家，我们被呼召以智慧和责任来照管它。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: 'Miracle' eagle with broken wing spotted back above Scottish coast
title.zh: “奇迹”老鹰断翼后重现苏格兰海岸上空

summary.en: A sea eagle, nicknamed the 'miracle eagle' by the RSPB, has been spotted flying above Scotland's west coast a year after it was presumed unlikely to survive falling from its nest with a broken wing. Experts are amazed by its recovery and return to flight.
summary.zh: 一只被英国皇家鸟类保护协会（RSPB）称为“奇迹老鹰”的海雕，在从巢中坠落并摔断翅膀一年后，被发现在苏格兰西海岸上空飞翔。专家们对其康复并重返天空感到惊讶。

body.en:
A sea eagle that confounded experts by surviving into adulthood with a badly broken wing has been spotted back in the skies above Scotland's west coast.

The bird was dubbed the Isle of Mull's "miracle eagle" by charity the RSPB after it fell from its nest as a chick during a storm in 2023.

Experts that monitor the island's sea eagle population did not expect the male chick to survive, but it has now been spotted three years on - soaring above the island with the distinctive kink in its wing clearly visible.

Retired RSPB officer Dave Sexton, whose has worked with the island's sea eagles for more than 20 years, described the sighting as "incredible".

The bird, affectionately nicknamed Kinky because of the kink in its broken wing, was nursed back to health by its two, unusually caring parents.

In an unprecedented display of extended parenting, the two white-tailed parents skipped a year's breeding season to continue to tend for their year-old offspring.

This latest sighting, though, reveals that the bird survived his first winter alone.

The bird was photographed flying over Loch Spelve, a sea loch on the south-east coast of Mull.

But the next phase of its life - which he described as a "sub-adult" could be dangerous.

"He'll no longer be tolerated as an immature by established adult pairs and might well come in for some 'you're not welcome here' behaviour, which can be pretty severe sometimes.

Sea eagles, also known as white tailed eagles, were hunted to extinction in the UK and the UK's last native white-tailed eagle was shot in Shetland back in 1918, according to the charity.

A reintroduction project was started in Scotland in 1975 and the birds have now become established as a self-sustaining population. They returned to the Isle of Mull in the 1980s.
body.zh: 一只翅膀严重折断的海鹰在苏格兰西海岸上空被发现，这让专家们感到困惑。 2023 年，这只小鸟在一场暴风雨中从巢中坠落，之后，皇家鸟类保护协会 (RSPB) 慈善机构将这只鸟称为马尔岛的“奇迹鹰”。 监测岛上海雕数量的专家并没有预料到这只雄性雏鸟能活下来，但三年前它被发现在岛上空翱翔，翅膀上独特的扭结清晰可见。 皇家鸟类保护协会退休官员戴夫·塞克斯顿 (Dave Sexton) 与岛上的海雕一起工作了 20 多年，他形容这一景象“令人难以置信”。 这只鸟因其折断的翅膀扭结而被亲切地称为“扭结”，在它的两个异常关爱的父母的精心照料下恢复了健康。 在史无前例的长期养育行为中，两只白尾父母跳过了一年的繁殖季节，继续照顾一岁的后代。 不过，最新的目击事件表明，这只鸟独自度过了第一个冬天。 这只鸟被拍到飞越斯佩尔夫湖，这是马尔东南海岸的一个海湾。 但它生命的下一阶段——他将其描述为“亚成年期”可能会很危险。 “已经建立的成年伴侣将不再容忍他作为一个不成熟的人，并且很可能会出现一些‘这里不欢迎你’的行为，有时这种行为可能相当严重。 据该慈善机构称，海雕（也称为白尾海雕）在英国因猎杀而灭绝，英国最后一只本土白尾海雕于 1918 年在设得兰群岛被射杀。 1975 年，苏格兰启动了一项放归计划，这些鸟类现已成为一个能够自我维持的种群。他们于 20 世纪 80 年代回到马尔岛。

reflection.en: The sea eagle's remarkable recovery, defying expectations after a devastating injury, offers a powerful image of resilience. It reminds us that even after falling from our nests and suffering brokenness, there is hope for renewed strength and the ability to soar again.
reflection.zh: 这只海雕在遭受重创后，不顾人们的预期而奇迹般地康复，为我们提供了坚韧不拔的有力画面。它提醒我们，即使我们从巢中坠落、身心破碎，仍有重获力量、再次翱翔的希望。

verse.textEn: Those who hope in Yahweh will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary.
verse.textZh: 但那等候雅伟的，必从新得力。他们必如鹰展翅上腾。

title.en: How El Nino is choking the Panama Canal
title.zh: 厄尔尼诺如何扼住巴拿马运河

summary.en: The Panama Canal will restrict the number of vessels transiting the crucial waterway from Friday for only the second time because of drought caused by the El Niño climate phenomenon. Five percent of global trade passes through the canal, which connects the Pacific Ocean with the Atlantic. The waterway is set to reduce...
summary.zh: 受厄尔尼诺气候现象引发的干旱影响，巴拿马运河将从周五起限制通过该重要水道的船只数量，这是第二次出现这种情况。全球五分之一的贸易通过连接太平洋和大西洋的巴拿马运河。为节约用水，该水道的日均通行量将从36艘减少到32艘，而严重的干旱预计将持续到2027年中期。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The Panama Canal will restrict the number of vessels transiting the crucial waterway from Friday for only the second time because of drought caused by the El Niño climate phenomenon.

Five percent of global trade passes through the canal, which connects the Pacific Ocean with the Atlantic.

The waterway is set to reduce daily traffic from 36 to 32 ships in an effort to conserve water amid a severe drought likely to last until mid-2027.

Canal authorities are also reducing the permitted draft of vessels—how deep they sit in the water—from 15.24 to 14.63 meters (48 feet).

Panama has declared an emergency over El Niño , which raises surface temperatures in the central and eastern equatorial Pacific Ocean and causes global changes in winds and rainfall, as well as erratic weather conditions.

The canal's incoming administrator, Ilya Espino de Marotta, has acknowledged the current "challenging" conditions.

The 80-kilometer (50-mile) canal draws on freshwater that comes mainly from rainfall and is stored in artificial lakes.

Without water, its locks, which lift and lower ships at the beginning and end of the journey, would not function.

Each transiting ship requires about 200 million liters of water, which is then discharged into the sea.

Water "is the most important resource for operations," but "between April and August the accumulated rainfall deficit was 35.8% below the historical average," the canal's water manager, Erick Cordoba, told AFP.

Forecasts indicate that the 2027 dry season, normally between January and April, will start a little earlier than usual and extend into May.

In 2023 and 2024, El Niño forced a reduction in daily transits to 22 and the maximum draft to 13.41 meters.

That led to 20% fewer vessels and a 17% drop in tonnage, not to mention longer lines of ships queuing up.

"If we don't manage to fill the lakes in November, we're going to have to tighten our belts," former canal administrator Jorge Quijano told AFP.

Long-lasting restrictions will lead to "higher shipping costs and longer waiting times" and therefore higher prices for consumers, Rebecca Bill Chavez, president of the Inter-American Dialogue, told AFP.

A ship loses around 200 containers for every 30-centimeter draft decrease, according to Quijano.

That amounts to hundreds of units for large vessels that can carry up to 16,000.

"We're going to see a significant impact on the container sector," which is the canal's biggest source of revenue, he said.

But Danish shipping company Maersk believes it is still "too early" to "speculate" about the impact.

The route mainly connects...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 由于厄尔尼诺气候现象造成干旱，巴拿马运河将从周五开始第二次限制通过该重要水道的船只数量。 全球贸易的百分之五通过连接太平洋和大西洋的运河。 该水道计划将每日交通量从 36 艘船舶减少至 32 艘船舶，以在可能持续到 2027 年中期的严重干旱中节约用水。 运河当局还将船只允许的吃水深度（即船只在水中的深度）从 15.24 米降低至 14.63 米（48 英尺）。 巴拿马宣布厄尔尼诺现象进入紧急状态，厄尔尼诺现象导致赤道太平洋中部和东部海面温度升高，导致全球风雨变化以及不稳定的天气状况。 即将上任的运河管理员伊利亚·埃斯皮诺·德·马洛塔承认目前的状况“具有挑战性”。 这条 80 公里（50 英里）长的运河使用的淡水主要来自降雨，并储存在人工湖中。 如果没有水，在旅程开始和结束时升降船舶的船闸就无法发挥作用。 每艘过境船舶大约需要2亿升水，然后排入大海。 运河水务经理埃里克·科尔多巴 (Erick Cordoba) 告诉法新社，水“是运营中最重要的资源”，但“4 月至 8 月期间，累计降雨量赤字比历史平均水平低 35.8%”。 预测显示，2027 年旱季通常在 1 月至 4 月之间，将比平常提前一点开始，并持续到 5 月。 2023年和2024年，厄尔尼诺现象迫使每日过境次数减少至22次，最大吃水深度减少至13.41米。 这导致船只数量减少 20%，吨位下降 17%，更不用说排队的船只更长了。 前运河管理员豪尔赫·基哈诺 (Jorge Quijano) 告诉法新社：“如果我们无法在 11 月份填满湖泊，我们将不得不勒紧裤腰带。” 美洲对话主席丽贝卡·比尔·查韦斯告诉法新社，长期的限制将导致“更高的运输成本和更长的等待时间”，从而给消费者带来更高的价格。 Quijano 表示，吃水每减少 30 厘米，一艘船就会损失大约 200 个集装箱。 对于最多可运载 16,000 人的大型船舶来说，这相当于数百个单位。 他说，“我们将看到集装箱行业受到重大影响”，这是运河最大的收入来源。 但丹麦航运公司马士基认为，现在“推测”影响还“为时过早”。 该线路主要连接...

reflection.en: The Panama Canal, a vital artery for global trade, faces unprecedented restrictions due to drought caused by the El Niño phenomenon. This situation underscores our dependence on natural systems and the profound impact of climate change. As stewards of creation, we are reminded that the Earth and its resources are ultimately Yahweh's, calling us to...
reflection.zh: 巴拿马运河是全球贸易的重要通道，由于厄尔尼诺现象引发的干旱，正面临前所未有的限制。这一局面凸显了我们对自然系统的依赖以及气候变化带来的深远影响。作为受造界的管家，我们被提醒，大地及其资源最终属于雅伟，这呼唤我们负责任地关怀和预见未来。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Light-triggered interface lets adhesive peel cleanly and rebond through 15 cycles
title.zh: 光触发界面可实现粘合剂在15个周期内干净剥离和重新粘合

summary.en: Adhesives are crucial in many products but can complicate repair and recycling. Researchers at Osaka University have created a prototype light-responsive adhesive that detaches cleanly from illuminated surfaces without residue and can be reset for reuse after heating and exposure to a different UV wavelength.
summary.zh: 粘合剂在许多产品中至关重要，但会使维修和回收变得复杂。大阪大学的研究人员开发了一种原型光响应粘合剂，该粘合剂可以从被照亮的表面上干净地分离而无残留，并且在加热并暴露于另一种紫外线波长后可以重置重复使用。

body.en: Adhesives are essential in electronics, vehicles and other products, but they can hinder repair and recycling when bonded parts are difficult to separate cleanly. A research team led by The University of Osaka has developed a prototype light-responsive adhesive that can be selectively detached from an illuminated surface without leaving observable residue. The adhesive film can then be rebonded by heating and reused after a second ultraviolet wavelength helps reset its molecular interactions.
body.zh: 粘合剂在电子产品、汽车和其他产品中至关重要，但当粘合部件难以干净分离时，它们可能会阻碍修复和回收。由大阪大学领导的一个研究小组开发了一种原型光响应粘合剂，可以选择性地从照明表面上剥离，而不会留下明显的残留物。然后，在第二个紫外线波长帮助重置其分子相互作用后，粘合剂膜可以通过加热重新粘合并重新使用。

reflection.en: This research from Osaka University showcases the patient, detailed work of scientists striving to solve a practical problem. Their dedication to innovation, aiming for a product that aids repair and recycling, echoes the call to 'do everything for the glory of God.' May their efforts be blessed, and may such ingenuity serve humanity well.
reflection.zh: 来自大阪大学的这项研究展示了科学家们为解决实际问题而付出的耐心和细致的工作。他们致力于创新，旨在创造一种有助于维修和回收的产品，这呼应了‘凡所行的，都为荣耀神’的呼召。愿他们的努力得到祝福，愿这样的创造力能很好地服务于人类。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Soft nanoscale confinement prevents ice, exposing water's liquid-to-glass transition
title.zh: 软纳米限制可防止结冰，揭示水的液-固转变

summary.en: An international collaboration of researchers has used ANSTO's facilities to uncover new properties of one of the most fundamental everyday materials, water, and answer an important scientific question. The findings, published in Nature Communications, have practical implications for understanding water at very low...
summary.zh: 一个国际研究合作组织利用澳大利亚国家放射科学和核科学组织（ANSTO）的设施，揭示了最基本日常材料之一——水的特性，并回答了一个重要的科学问题。这项发表在《自然·通讯》上的研究成果，对于理解极低温度下的水具有实际意义。这些发现与生物材料的低温保存、食品冷冻技术以及对细胞内纳米尺度下水的理解有关。

body.en: An international collaboration of researchers has used ANSTO's facilities to uncover new properties of one of the most fundamental everyday materials, water, and answer an important scientific question. The findings, published in Nature Communications, have practical implications for understanding water at very low temperatures. The findings are relevant to cryopreservation of biological materials, food-freezing technologies and understanding water in living cells, where it is often confined at the nanoscale.
body.zh: 国际研究人员合作利用 ANSTO 的设施揭示了最基本的日常材料之一——水的新特性，并回答了一个重要的科学问题。该研究结果发表在《自然通讯》上，对于了解极低温度下的水具有实际意义。这些发现与生物材料的低温保存、食品冷冻技术和了解活细胞中的水有关，活细胞中的水通常被限制在纳米尺度。

reflection.en: The Psalmist asks, 'Who is like you, Yahweh?' and the answer is found in the wonders of creation. This research into water's behavior at the nanoscale is a testament to the intricate design of the world around us. Through careful observation and dedicated study, scientists reveal more of the Creator's wisdom embedded in the very fabric of existence.
reflection.zh: 诗人问道：“雅伟啊，谁能比你？”答案蕴藏在受造物的奇妙之中。这项关于水在纳米尺度下行为的研究，证明了我们周围世界精妙的设计。通过细致的观察和专注的研究，科学家们揭示了更多隐藏在存在之中的创造者的智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Tiny fossils reveal big insights about ant ancestors
title.zh: 微小化石揭示了蚂蚁祖先的重大信息

summary.en: Two small ant fossils found in southern Saskatchewan are aiding scientists in understanding the evolutionary past of modern ants. Fossils of ants from 72–56 million years ago are uncommon, and this discovery helps shed light on insect life, including ants, during a period of mass extinction that eliminated non-avian...
summary.zh: 在萨斯喀彻温省南部发现的两枚微小蚂蚁化石，正帮助科学家们更好地理解现代蚂蚁的进化历史。距今7200万至5600万年前的蚂蚁化石十分罕见，这一发现有助于揭示在导致非鸟恐龙灭绝并重塑生态系统的物种大灭绝时期，包括蚂蚁在内的昆虫的生活状况。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Two tiny ant fossils recovered in southern Saskatchewan are helping scientists better understand the evolutionary history of modern ants. Ant fossils dating from 72–56 million years ago are rare. What happened to insects such as ants during this period that saw a mass extinction wipe out all non-bird dinosaurs? How did that event reshape their world?

As part of her master's degree, Elyssa Loewen—in collaboration with researchers Caelan Libke (University of Regina) and Dr. Ryan McKellar (Royal Saskatchewan Museum)—used the Canadian Light Source (CLS) at the University of Saskatchewan to analyze two partial ant fossils. One fossil preserved part of an ant's head, while the other preserved a partial body.

Both came from the Big Muddy amber deposit, a site that preserves sticky tree resin from an ancient swamp forest that hardened over millions of years into amber, preserving remarkably detailed insects, plants and clues about the environment millions of years ago.

Before the fossils could be imaged, McKellar's team at the Royal Saskatchewan Museum embedded the amber in epoxy and polished it with rotary tools to expose the insects inside. The samples were scanned using ultrabright X-ray micro-tomography to build detailed 3D models of the ants' anatomy.

The research team compared the CLS-generated models with modern ant species. Although they were working with only partial fossils, they were able to identify them to specific ant subfamilies that still exist today. Once abundant in North America, these ant groups are now mostly found in the global south. The research was published in the journal Insect Systematics and Diversity .

Using a machine-learning model developed by Dr. Christine Sosiak (New Jersey Institute of Technology), another researcher on this project, Loewen and her colleagues also predicted how these ancient ants might have lived. They believe the partial ant head fossil belonged to a group that nested on the ground 67 million years ago, whereas ants from the same family that lived later (post-dinosaur extinction) lived in trees—as do their modern relatives. The finding may suggest that this group experienced an evolutionary shift over millions of years, from life on the forest floor to life in the vegetation canopy.

At the time, the Big Muddy region was a lush, swampy forest filled with metasequoia trees, ferns and flowering plants. These ants would have lived alongside a diverse community of insects just one million years before the end-Cretaceous mass extinction.

Ants are ecosystem engineers, Loewen says. "Understanding how they survived and adapted...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 在萨斯喀彻温省南部发现的两块微小蚂蚁化石正在帮助科学家更好地了解现代蚂蚁的进化历史。距今 72 至 5600 万年前的蚂蚁化石非常罕见。在这段经历了大规模灭绝并消灭了所有非鸟类恐龙的时期，蚂蚁等昆虫发生了什么？那次事件如何重塑了他们的世界？ 作为硕士学位的一部分，Elyssa Loewen 与研究人员 Caelan Libke（里贾纳大学）和 Ryan McKellar 博士（皇家萨斯喀彻温省博物馆）合作，使用萨斯喀彻温大学的加拿大光源 (CLS) 分析了两块部分蚂蚁化石。一块化石保存了蚂蚁头部的一部分，而另一块则保存了部分身体。 两者都来自大泥泞琥珀矿床，该地点保存了来自古老沼泽森林的粘性树树脂，经过数百万年硬化成琥珀，保存了非常详细的昆虫、植物和数百万年前有关环境的线索。 在对化石进行成像之前，萨斯喀彻温省皇家博物馆的麦凯勒团队将琥珀嵌入环氧树脂中，并用旋转工具对其进行抛光，以露出里面的昆虫。使用超亮 X 射线显微断层扫描技术扫描样本，以构建蚂蚁解剖结构的详细 3D 模型。 研究小组将 CLS 生成的模型与现代蚂蚁物种进行了比较。尽管他们只处理了部分化石，但他们能够将它们识别为至今仍然存在的特定蚂蚁亚科。这些蚂蚁群曾经在北美大量存在，现在主要分布在南半球。该研究发表在《昆虫系统学与多样性》杂志上。 Loewen 和她的同事利用该项目的另一位研究员 Christine Sosiak 博士（新泽西理工学院）开发的机器学习模型，预测了这些古代蚂蚁可能的生活方式。他们认为，部分蚂蚁头化石属于 6700 万年前在地面上筑巢的一个群体，而生活在较晚（恐龙灭绝后）的同一家族的蚂蚁则生活在树上，它们的现代亲戚也是如此。这一发现可能表明，这个群体经历了数百万年的进化转变，从森林地面的生活到植被冠层的生活。 当时，大马迪地区是一片郁郁葱葱的沼泽森林，长满了水杉树、蕨类植物和开花植物。就在白垩纪末期大规模灭绝发生前一百万年，这些蚂蚁可能与多样化的昆虫群落一起生活。 洛文说，蚂蚁是生态系统工程师。 “了解他们如何生存和适应......

reflection.en: The discovery of these ancient ant fossils in Saskatchewan is a testament to the intricate history embedded within creation. Job 12:7 reminds us that creation itself speaks, offering profound lessons to those who observe it. These tiny remnants from millions of years ago invite us to marvel at the complexity and resilience of life, a wisdom that Yahweh has...
reflection.zh: 在萨斯喀彻温省发现的这些古老蚂蚁化石，是创造中蕴含的复杂历史的明证。约伯记12:7提醒我们，创造本身会说话，为那些观察它的人提供深刻的教训。这些来自数百万年前的微小遗迹，邀请我们惊叹于生命的复杂性和韧性，这是雅伟编织进世界本身的智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.

title.en: From peas to potatoes, AI identifies nearly 800 promising plant proteins for food and cosmetics
title.zh: 从豌豆到土豆，人工智能识别出近800种有前途的食品和化妆品植物蛋白

summary.en: Scientists have developed an advanced AI process that can rapidly identify plant proteins with emulsifying properties from millions of candidates, identifying nearly 800 to date. This discovery is expected to significantly reduce research time and costs, accelerating the development of new plant-based food and...
summary.zh: 科学家们开发了一种先进的人工智能流程，能够从数百万个候选物中快速识别出具有乳化特性的植物蛋白，迄今已识别出近800种。这项发现有望大大缩短研究时间和成本，从而加速新型植物基食品和化妆品的开发。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Scientists from Leeds' School of Food Science and Nutrition have developed an advanced AI process that can rapidly identify plant proteins capable of acting as emulsifiers from tens of millions of initial candidates. To date, it has identified nearly 800. The discovery will cut years of costly trial-and-error research and bring the next generation of plant-based foods and cosmetics closer.

Emulsifiers are essential for binding oil and water into stable, homogeneous mixtures in food, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals and industrial applications. Common uses include lotions, medicinal creams, sauces, ice cream, mayonnaise and paints. There is increasing interest in creating natural, sustainable alternatives to high-carbon-footprint synthetic or animal-derived emulsifiers.

The research, published in Communications Chemistry , was led by postdoctoral researcher Dr. Simha Sridharan and supervised by Professor Anwesha Sarkar, both of the university's Sarkar Lab. They worked alongside AI researchers at Leeds' School of Food Science and Nutrition and in close collaboration with Dr. Rik Sarkar, a machine learning expert at the University of Edinburgh.

Dr. Sridharan said, "As we want to shift toward more sustainable, plant-based ingredients, scientists face a major challenge: There are millions of potential plant proteins, but testing them all to identify the right emulsifier is expensive and involves a time-consuming trial-and-error approach. Until now, there has been no reliable way to predict which plant proteins are likely to behave as emulsifiers like animal proteins."

There is growing consumer interest in natural emulsifiers in place of commonly used animal-based emulsifiers, such as milk proteins like caseins or whey. This new tool could help identify new possibilities, reduce years of testing and accelerate the transition toward sustainable, plant-based food systems.

Dr. Sridharan and Sarkar used a simulation model to understand how proteins attach between oil and water mixtures, which is crucial for them to act as emulsifiers. In collaboration with Rik Sarkar, they applied machine learning to fingerprint specific segments of the protein that dictate their attachment behavior.

By combining machine learning and statistical physics, the team was able to screen plant proteins to identify those that would resemble the emulsification performance of animal proteins in a fraction of the time needed for conventional experiments.

Rik Sarkar said, "Emulsifiers often have a characteristic chemical structure called diblocks. We were able to model this structure mathematically for...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 利兹食品科学与营养学院的科学家开发了一种先进的人工智能流程，可以从数千万个初始候选蛋白中快速识别出能够充当乳化剂的植物蛋白。迄今为止，它已识别出近 800 种。这一发现将减少多年来成本高昂的试错研究，并使下一代植物性食品和化妆品更接近。 在食品、化妆品、药品和工业应用中，乳化剂对于将油和水结合成稳定、均匀的混合物至关重要。常见用途包括乳液、药膏、酱汁、冰淇淋、蛋黄酱和油漆。人们对创造高碳足迹合成或动物源乳化剂的天然、可持续替代品越来越感兴趣。 该研究发表在《通讯化学》上，由博士后研究员 Simha Sridharan 博士领导，并由该大学萨卡实验室的 Anwesha Sarkar 教授监督。他们与利兹食品科学与营养学院的人工智能研究人员一起工作，并与爱丁堡大学的机器学习专家 Rik Sarkar 博士密切合作。 Sridharan 博士说：“当我们想要转向更可持续的植物性成分时，科学家们面临着一个重大挑战：有数百万种潜在的植物蛋白，但对它们进行全部测试以确定正确的乳化剂成本高昂，并且需要耗时的试错方法。到目前为止，还没有可靠的方法来预测哪些植物蛋白可能像动物蛋白一样充当乳化剂。” 消费者对天然乳化剂的兴趣日益浓厚，以取代常用的动物乳化剂，例如酪蛋白或乳清等牛奶蛋白。这种新工具可以帮助发现新的可能性，减少测试时间并加速向可持续的植物性食品系统的过渡。 Sridharan 博士和 Sarkar 博士使用模拟模型来了解蛋白质如何附着在油和水混合物之间，这对于它们充当乳化剂至关重要。他们与 Rik Sarkar 合作，应用机器学习来识别决定其附着行为的蛋白质特定片段。 通过将机器学习和统计物理学相结合，该团队能够筛选植物蛋白，以识别那些与动物蛋白乳化性能相似的蛋白，而所需时间只是传统实验所需时间的一小部分。 Rik Sarkar 说：“乳化剂通常具有一种称为双嵌段的特有化学结构。我们能够对这种结构进行数学建模......

reflection.en: The relentless human drive to understand and utilize the intricate workings of creation is on full display here. Through advanced AI, scientists are uncovering the hidden potential within plants, a testament to the Creator's wisdom embedded in the natural world. May this pursuit of knowledge be guided by a deep respect for the resources entrusted to us.
reflection.zh: 人类不懈地探索和利用创造界复杂运作的驱动力在此得到了充分的体现。通过先进的人工智能，科学家们正在揭示植物中隐藏的潜力，这证明了创造者智慧的体现就蕴藏在自然世界之中。愿这种对知识的追求能以对我们所托付之资源的深深敬意为指引。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Genetically modified pig kidney keeps man alive for record nine months
title.zh: 基因改造的猪肾脏将一名男子维持生命创纪录九个月

summary.en: A genetically modified pig kidney has kept a 66-year-old man, Tim Andrews, alive for a record nine months, serving as a crucial 'bridge' while he awaited a human transplant in the US. Andrews, suffering from end-stage kidney disease due to type 2 diabetes, had a low chance of receiving a human kidney and a high risk...
summary.zh: 在美国，一个基因改造的猪肾脏已将一名患有终末期肾病的66岁男子Tim Andrews维持生命长达创纪录的九个月，并成功充当了等待人类移植的“桥梁”。Andrews患有因2型糖尿病引起的终末期肾病，在五年内获得人类肾脏移植的机会渺茫，而死亡或被移出等候名单的风险则超过40%。

body.en: Organ kept Tim Andrews off dialysis and acted as a ‘bridge’ while he waited for a human transplant in the US A genetically modified kidney from a pig called Wilma has kept a 66-year-old man with kidney failure alive for a record nine months and successfully acted as a “bridge” to a human transplant in a world first. Tim Andrews was seriously ill with end-stage kidney disease caused by type 2 diabetes and had only a 9% chance of receiving a human kidney within five years, against a more than 40% risk of dying or being removed from the waiting list. Continue reading...
body.zh: 器官使蒂姆·安德鲁斯(Tim Andrews)无需接受透析，并在美国等待人体移植时充当了“桥梁”。来自一头名叫威尔玛(Wilma)的猪的转基因肾脏使一名患有肾衰竭的66岁男子存活了创纪录的九个月，并成功充当了世界首例人体移植的“桥梁”。蒂姆·安德鲁斯 (Tim Andrews) 患有由 2 型糖尿病引起的终末期肾病，病情严重，五年内接受人类肾脏的机会只有 9%，而死亡或从等待名单中删除的风险超过 40%。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The successful use of a genetically modified pig kidney in Tim Andrews marks a significant milestone in xenotransplantation, offering hope where conventional options were scarce. This medical marvel reminds us of the intricate design of life, prompting awe at the complexity of biological systems, both animal and human, and the ingenuity applied to sustain...
reflection.zh: 基因改造的猪肾脏在Tim Andrews身上成功应用，标志着异种移植的一个重要里程碑，在常规选择有限的情况下带来了希望。这一医学奇迹提醒我们生命精妙的设计，引发了对动植物和人类生物系统复杂性以及为维持生命所展现的创造力的惊叹。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: BBC Inside Science
title.zh: BBC 科学内幕

summary.en: Researchers on the Lux-Zeplin (LZ) Dark Matter Experiment have reported a potential discovery of dark matter passing through an underground mine in South Dakota. Separately, a study found that probiotics may benefit corals, with tests conducted on Red Sea reefs.
summary.zh: 一个名为 Lux-Zeplin (LZ) 暗物质实验的国际研究项目报告称，他们可能在南达科他州的一个地下矿井中发现了暗物质穿过的痕迹。另外，一项研究发现益生菌可能对珊瑚有益，研究人员在红海的珊瑚礁上进行了测试。

body.en: The quest for Dark Matter just got interesting. Researchers on an international project called the Lux-Zeplin (LZ) Dark Matter Experiment reported they may have discovered the signature of a bit of Dark Matter passing through an underground mine in South Dakota. Kimberly Palladino, professor of physics at Oxford and a member of that LZ collaboration, speaks with Roland to explain how dark matter is being detected. Probiotics have long been all the rage in health advice, but this week we discovered they may also be good for corals. Microbiologist turned ecologist Erika Santoro has been testing a probiotic treatment on reefs in the Red Sea and joins us to divulge her findings. We’re continuing with a tone of optimism with this week’s shortlisted book for the Royal Society’s coveted Trivedi Science Book Prize. ‘Despite it All: A Handbook for Climate Hopefuls’ by veteran environmental journalist Fred Pearce, focuses on the progress humanity has made in protecting the planet. Plus, mathematician Kit Yates is back, bringing us some of the week’s most exciting science news, including how we might use the earth's magnetic field to authenticate artefacts and a puzzling ten-sided cloud structure on Saturn's south pole. Presenter: Roland Pease Producer: Alex Mansfield, Katie Tomsett, Keiran Manetta-Jones Editor: Martin Smith Production Co-ordinator: Jana Bennett-Holesworth
body.zh: 对暗物质的探索变得有趣起来。勒克斯-齐柏林 (LZ) 暗物质实验国际项目的研究人员报告说，他们可能发现了一点暗物质穿过南达科他州地下矿井的特征。牛津大学物理学教授、LZ 合作项目成员金伯利·帕拉迪诺 (Kimberly Palladino) 与罗兰交谈，解释了暗物质是如何被探测到的。益生菌长期以来一直在健康建议中风靡一时，但本周我们发现它们也可能对珊瑚有益。微生物学家兼生态学家埃里卡·桑托罗 (Erika Santoro) 一直在红海珊瑚礁上测试益生菌疗法，并与我们一起公布她的发现。我们将继续以乐观的态度对待本周英国皇家学会令人垂涎的特里维迪科学图书奖的入围书籍。资深环境记者弗雷德·皮尔斯（Fred Pearce）撰写的《尽管如此：气候希望者手册》重点关注人类在保护地球方面取得的进展。另外，数学家基特·耶茨回来了，为我们带来了本周最激动人心的科学新闻，包括如何利用地球磁场来验证文物以及土星南极上令人费解的十面云结构。主持人：罗兰·皮斯 制片人：亚历克斯·曼斯菲尔德、凯蒂·托姆塞特、凯兰·马内塔-琼斯 编辑：马丁·史密斯 制作协调员：贾娜·贝内特-霍尔斯沃斯

reflection.en: The universe holds profound mysteries, and human curiosity drives us to explore them. The potential detection of dark matter, a substance that makes up a significant portion of the cosmos yet remains largely unseen, speaks to our innate desire to understand the world around us. As we observe and study creation, we gain glimpses of the Creator's wisdom and...
reflection.zh: 宇宙充满了深邃的奥秘，人类的好奇心驱使我们去探索。暗物质的潜在发现，这种构成宇宙很大一部分却仍大部分不可见的物质，体现了我们理解周围世界的内在渴望。当我们观察和研究创造时，即使是最难以捉摸的形式，我们也能瞥见创造者的智慧和大能。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: ‘So scary’: massive hail and torrential rain causes chaos in Toronto
title.zh: 多伦多遭遇冰雹和暴雨袭击，造成混乱

summary.en: Torrential rain and massive hailstones caused chaos in Toronto and surrounding areas of southern Ontario, Canada. The severe thunderstorms led to flooding, downed trees, and widespread power outages, affecting thousands of people.
summary.zh: 加拿大安大略省南部和多伦多地区遭遇强雷暴袭击，带来倾盆大雨和巨大的冰雹，造成混乱。风暴引发了洪水，导致树木倒塌，并造成大范围停电，影响了数千人。

body.en: Toronto and parts of southern Ontario, Canada, were hit by powerful thunderstorms bringing torrential rain, large hail and damaging winds. The storms caused flooding, downed trees and widespread power outages across the Greater Toronto Area, with thousands of people affected. Videos shared from across the region showed streets overwhelmed by rain and hailstones falling heavily in a matter of minutes.
body.zh: 加拿大多伦多和安大略省南部部分地区遭受强烈雷暴袭击，带来暴雨、大冰雹和破坏性大风。暴风雨导致大多伦多地区发生洪水、树木倒塌和大范围停电，数千人受到影响。来自该地区各地分享的视频显示，街道在几分钟内就被大雨和冰雹淹没。

reflection.en: The sudden fury of the storm in Toronto, overwhelming streets and disrupting lives in minutes, reminds us of the unpredictable forces of nature. In such moments of chaos and vulnerability, Psalm 46:1 offers a profound truth: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble. May we find solace and stability in His presence, even when...
reflection.zh: 多伦多突如其来的风暴，在几分钟内就淹没了街道，扰乱了人们的生活，这提醒我们大自然不可预测的力量。在这些混乱和脆弱的时刻，《诗篇》46:1 提供了一个深刻的真理：雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是患难中随时的帮助。愿我们即使在周围的世界感到动荡不安时，也能在祂的同在中找到安慰和稳定。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Rich people more likely to steal children’s sweets, finds Ig Nobel prize-winning study
title.zh: 富人比穷人更可能偷孩子的糖果，诺贝尔奖得主研究发现

summary.en: A study that won an Ig Nobel prize, awarded for achievements that 'first make people laugh and then make them think,' found that wealthy individuals are more likely to steal children's sweets. The awards ceremony involved scientists receiving prizes and being showered with paper planes.
summary.zh: 一项获得搞笑诺贝尔奖的研究发现，富裕人士比穷人更可能偷孩子的糖果。搞笑诺贝尔奖旨在表彰那些“首先让人发笑，然后引人深思”的成就。颁奖典礼上，科学家们领取奖品并被纸飞机“淋”了一身。

body.en: We round up this year’s winners at awards for achievements that ‘first make people laugh and then make them think’ It’s that time of year again: a select group of scientists have been summoned to a ceremony to receive coveted prizes, be showered in paper planes, and leave with a 10tn dollar bill, albeit in the form of a phased-out note from Zimbabwe. It is, of course, the annual Ig Nobel awards. Not to be confused with the more prestigious and career-changing Nobel prizes that will be announced in Scandinavia next month, the satirical Ig Nobels are awarded for achievements that “first make people laugh and then make them think”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 我们将今年的获奖者聚集在一起，表彰他们“首先让人发笑，然后让他们思考”的成就。又到了一年中的这个时候：一群经过挑选的科学家被召集到一个仪式上，接受令人垂涎的奖品，被纸飞机洒满，并带着一张 10 万亿美元的钞票离开，尽管是以津巴布韦逐步淘汰的纸币的形式。当然是一年一度的搞笑诺贝尔奖。不要与下个月在斯堪的纳维亚半岛宣布的更具声望和改变职业生涯的诺贝尔奖相混淆，具有讽刺意味的搞笑诺贝尔奖颁发给“首先让人发笑，然后让他们思考”的成就。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Ig Nobel awards often highlight the absurdities and ironies of human behavior. This particular finding, that wealth correlates with a tendency to steal sweets from children, is both humorous and unsettling. It prompts us to consider the ethical implications of privilege and the moral compass that should guide us, regardless of our economic status. As...
reflection.zh: 搞笑诺贝尔奖常常揭示人类行为的荒谬和讽刺之处。这项关于财富与偷窃儿童糖果之间关联的发现，既令人发笑，又令人不安。它促使我们思考特权所带来的道德含义，以及无论经济状况如何，都应指引我们的道德准则。正如弥迦书6:8所提醒的，真正的公义在于行公义、好怜悯、以及谦卑地与我们的雅伟同行。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: How the brain of a fly may help explain human behaviour
title.zh: 苍蝇大脑如何帮助解释人类行为

summary.en: Comparing the brains of male and female flies may transform our understanding of how genes shape behaviour, including ours. Scientists mapped all 124 million connections of nerve cells in a male fly's brain, identifying differences that explain male aggression, courtship, and their singing of love songs. While not...
summary.zh: 比较雄性和雌性苍蝇的大脑可能彻底改变我们对基因如何塑造行为（包括我们自己的行为）的理解。科学家们绘制了雄性苍蝇大脑中所有1.24亿个神经元连接图，发现了能解释雄性攻击性、求偶行为和唱情歌的差异。虽然由于人类行为的复杂性，这项研究无法解释男女之间的差异，但它可能有助于科学家更好地理解人类行为以及影响大脑连接的遗传性疾病，...

body.en:
Scientists have managed to compare the fine detail of the brains of male and female flies for the first time, identifying differences they say explain male aggression, courtship and their singing of love songs.

The scientists in Cambridge mapped all 124 million connections of nerve cells in a male fly's brain, having done the same for a female fly two years ago.

The team are clear that the research won't explain differences between men and women because our behaviour is far more complex.

But the research could help scientists better understand human behaviour and conditions in which genetic differences affect brain wiring, such as autism and schizophrenia.

Prof Gregory Jefferis, of the Medical Research Council's Laboratory of Molecular Biology and University of Cambridge, who co-led the research, told BBC News that the breakthrough was "a really important new avenue in neuroscience", likening it to the invention of a powerful new telescope in increasing our understanding of the Universe.

"We have this amazing stuff in our heads that lets us do incredible things such as playing a sonata or solving a scientific problem. And this development could help our understanding of how those systems work".

The fly's brain is as beautiful as it is incredible. It is the size of a pin head yet in many ways more efficient than a supercomputer and able to outsmart the smartest AI.

Jefferis' team and collaborators painstakingly analysed every nerve cell, every wire and every connection in a male fruit fly. They put them together into a 3D map of the brain and nerve cord and compared them to the earlier, female mapping.

They found that around 95% of the cells are shared between the male and female fly brains. But the remaining 5% are enough to drive quite distinct behaviours, according to Dr Isabella Beckett, who is joint first author of the scientific research paper published today in the Journal Cell.

"We were expecting to find differences, and we found them, and we're excited by what we got," she said.

In courtship, for example, the male tracks the female as she moves. The researchers have identified the brain circuits associated with that trait and found key differences in the wiring. The males have extra bits that should enhance his visual tracking.

There is an even bigger difference in the circuits associated with aggression. Males fight more often and so there is much more wiring associated with that behaviour than in females.

Males woo females by producing a sound. They have wiring unique only to them to produce the sound. According to Dr Philipp Schlegel, co-author of the study, the circuit has to be just right, otherwise the consequences for the poor male could be dire.

"The courtship also includes singing to the female," he told me. "The sound...
body.zh: 科学家们首次成功地比较了雄性和雌性果蝇大脑的精细细节，找出了他们所说的解释雄性攻击性、求爱和唱情歌的差异。 剑桥的科学家们在两年前对雌性果蝇进行了同样的研究，绘制了雄性果蝇大脑中所有 1.24 亿个神经细胞连接的图谱。 研究小组明确表示，这项研究无法解释男性和女性之间的差异，因为我们的行为要复杂得多。 但这项研究可以帮助科学家更好地了解基因差异影响大脑线路的人类行为和状况，例如自闭症和精神分裂症。 这项研究的共同领导者、医学研究委员会分子生物学实验室和剑桥大学的格雷戈里·杰弗里斯教授告诉英国广播公司新闻，这一突破是“神经科学领域非常重要的新途径”，并将其比作强大的新望远镜的发明，以增加我们对宇宙的了解。 “我们脑子里有这种神奇的东西，可以让我们做一些不可思议的事情，比如演奏奏鸣曲或解决科学问题。这一发展可以帮助我们理解这些系统是如何工作的”。 苍蝇的大脑既美丽又令人难以置信。它只有针头大小，但在很多方面比超级计算机更高效，并且能够智胜最聪明的人工智能。 杰弗里斯的团队和合作者煞费苦心地分析了雄性果蝇的每一个神经细胞、每根电线和每一个连接。他们将它们组合成大脑和神经索的 3D 地图，并将其与早期的女性地图进行比较。 他们发现，雄性果蝇和雌性果蝇大脑中大约有 95% 的细胞是共享的。但今天发表在《细胞》杂志上的这篇科学研究论文的联合第一作者 Isabella Beckett 博士表示，剩下的 5% 足以驱动截然不同的行为。 “我们期待发现差异，我们也找到了它们，我们对所得到的结果感到兴奋，”她说。 例如，在求偶过程中，雄性会随着雌性的移动而追踪雌性。研究人员已经确定了与该特征相关的大脑回路，并发现了线路中的关键差异。雄性有额外的部分可以增强他的视觉追踪能力。 与攻击性相关的回路存在更大的差异。雄性打架的次数比雌性多，因此与这种行为相关的线路比雌性多得多。 雄性通过发出声音来吸引雌性。他们有自己独特的接线来发出声音。该研究的合著者菲利普·施莱格尔博士表示，电路必须恰到好处，否则对可怜的雄性来说后果可能是可怕的。 “求爱还包括向雌性唱歌，”他告诉我。 “这...

reflection.en: The intricate world of a fly's brain, with its 124 million connections, reveals the complexity of behavior. This research reminds us that even in the smallest creatures, Yahweh's wisdom is displayed, inviting us to learn from the natural world He created. As Job 12:7-9 says, 'Ask the animals, and they will teach you... For everything in creation will...
reflection.zh: 苍蝇大脑中包含1.24亿个连接的复杂世界，揭示了行为的精妙。这项研究提醒我们，即使在最小的生物中，也彰显着雅伟的智慧，邀请我们从祂所创造的自然界中学习。正如约伯书12:7-9所说：“但你且问走兽，它们必指教你……受造的众类，无一不在你掌握之中。”...

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: There’s a quick way to slow climate change. Why isn’t everyone doing it? - video
title.zh: 减缓气候变化有一个捷径。为什么不是每个人都在这样做？- 视频

summary.en: Methane is a potent greenhouse gas that traps more than 80 times as much heat than carbon dioxide over a 20-year period and causes 25% of global heating today. We definitely don’t want this gas spewing needlessly into the atmosphere, but in 2023 that’s exactly what environment editor Damian Carrington found was...
summary.zh: 甲烷是一种强效温室气体，在20年内吸收的热量是二氧化碳的80多倍，并导致了当今全球25%的升温。我们绝对不希望这种气体白白地排放到大气中，但环境编辑达米安·卡灵顿在2023年报道了全球1000个超级甲烷泄漏点时，发现情况正是如此。现在，特立尼达和多巴哥，这个超级泄漏最严重的国家，已经开始堵漏。达米安告诉玛德琳·芬利，为...

body.en: Methane is a potent greenhouse gas that traps more than 80 times as much heat than carbon dioxide over a 20-year period and causes 25% of global heating today. We definitely don’t want this gas spewing needlessly into the atmosphere, but in 2023 that’s exactly what environment editor Damian Carrington found was happening when he reported on 1,000 super-emitting methane leaks across the globe. Now Turkmenistan, the worst country for mega-leaks, has begun to plug them. Damian tells Madeleine Finlay why some experts call stopping leaks the climate ‘emergency brake’ and reveals which countries are still failing to act. Continue reading...
body.zh: 甲烷是一种强效温室气体，在 20 年内吸收的热量是二氧化碳的 80 多倍，导致当今全球变暖的 25%。我们绝对不希望这种气体不必要地喷入大气中，但 2023 年环境编辑达米安·卡林顿 (Damian Carrington) 在报告全球 1,000 起超排放甲烷泄漏事件时发现，这种情况正在发生。现在，土库曼斯坦这个超级泄漏最严重的国家已经开始堵住这些泄漏。达米安告诉玛德琳·芬利，为什么一些专家将阻止泄漏称为气候“紧急刹车”，并揭示了哪些国家仍未采取行动。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news highlights the significant, yet preventable, release of methane, a powerful greenhouse gas. This needless waste of a potent atmospheric pollutant underscores our responsibility to be good stewards of the Earth, as Genesis 2:15 instructs us to tend and keep the garden. Addressing these leaks is not just an environmental issue, but a moral imperative...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻揭示了甲烷这种强效温室气体的可预防却又大规模的排放。这种对一种强力大气污染物的无谓浪费，凸显了我们作为地球管家应尽的责任，正如《创世记》2章15节教导我们要照料和看守园子。解决这些泄漏问题，不仅是环境问题，更是我们关爱受托之地的道德责任。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: Will El Nino bring chaos to UK weather?
title.zh: 厄尔尼诺会给英国天气带来混乱吗？

summary.en: The article explores the potential impact of the El Nino weather phenomenon on the United Kingdom's climate, considering whether it could lead to chaotic or unusual weather patterns.
summary.zh: 文章探讨了厄尔尼诺现象对英国气候的潜在影响，并考虑它是否可能导致混乱或异常的天气模式。

reflection.en: El Nino, a powerful climate pattern, can bring significant disruptions to weather systems worldwide. As we anticipate potential 'chaos' in the UK's weather, we can remember that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a help readily available in times of trouble. Even when the natural world seems unpredictable, His presence offers stability and peace.
reflection.zh: 厄尔尼诺是一种强大的气候模式，可能在全球范围内扰乱天气系统。当我们预见到英国天气可能出现的“混乱”时，我们可以铭记雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是患难中随时可得的帮助。即使在自然界看似不可预测的时候，祂的同在也提供稳定与平安。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Ancient “living fossils” may reveal how complex life began
title.zh: 古代“活化石”或揭示复杂生命如何起源

summary.en: A newly discovered microbe living inside ancient stromatolite communities may offer a rare look at how complex life first emerged. Researchers captured the first direct images of an Asgard archaeon physically connected to a bacterium, with the two microbes appearing to exchange genetic material.
summary.zh: 一种生活在古代叠层石群落中的新发现的微生物，可能为了解复杂生命的起源提供了一个难得的视角。研究人员捕捉到了一个阿斯加德古菌与一个细菌物理连接的首批直接图像，两者似乎在交换遗传物质。

body.en:
At first glance, stromatolites and their close relatives, microbial mats, can look like little more than dark, ancient rocks. In reality, they are densely packed, layered communities built by microbes.

Billions of years ago, before animals and plants existed, stromatolites helped release some of the earliest oxygen into Earth's atmosphere. Now, a study published in Current Biology suggests these unusual formations may also preserve clues to another major event in Earth's history: the emergence of complex life.

Associate Professor Brendan Burns, an evolutionary microbiologist at UNSW Sydney, is part of a research team that discovered a previously unknown microbe living in close association with another organism inside these "living fossils." The project, co-led with researchers from the University of Technology Sydney and The University of Melbourne, could help scientists better understand a fundamental evolutionary mystery: how relatively simple cells began cooperating and eventually gave rise to much more complex forms of life.

"Stromatolites could be more than 'just' a cradle of life where early microbial life flourished," says A/Prof. Burns.

Stromatolites and microbial mats first appeared billions of years ago, but they have not disappeared. They still form today in Shark Bay, a World Heritage-listed site in Western Australia.

Samples collected there eventually led A/Prof. Burns and his colleagues to isolate a member of the Asgard archaea, an unusual group of microbes believed to be closely related to the ancestors of eukaryotes, which are the cells that make up all plants and animals, including humans.

One long-standing idea in biology proposes that the first eukaryotic cell developed through an intimate partnership between an ancient archaeon and a bacterium. According to this theory, one organism eventually engulfed the other, and that relationship ultimately produced mitochondria, the energy-producing structures found inside complex cells.

Scientists, however, have lacked direct evidence showing what such an early partnership might actually have looked like. The new research provides the first visual evidence of an Asgard archaeon physically interacting with a bacterium through extremely thin, tube-like connections called nanotubes.

"This could be a little model for how these kinds of partnerships started and ultimately formed eukaryotes," says A/Prof. Burns.

Genetic sequencing showed that the organisms' DNA was present in the samples, but getting the microbes to grow in the laboratory so researchers could study them directly proved far more difficult.

"It took four or five years in the lab," A/Prof. Burns says. "A lot of time, optimizing and chasing different shadows."

Asgard archaea are notoriously challenging to cultivate away...
body.zh: 乍一看，叠层石及其近亲微生物垫看起来只不过是黑暗的古老岩石。事实上，它们是由微生物构建的密集、分层的群落。 数十亿年前，在动物和植物出现之前，叠层石帮助将一些最早的氧气释放到地球大气中。现在，发表在《当代生物学》上的一项研究表明，这些不寻常的构造也可能保留了地球历史上另一重大事件的线索：复杂生命的出现。 悉尼新南威尔士大学的进化微生物学家布伦丹·伯恩斯副教授是一个研究小组的成员，该研究小组发现了一种以前未知的微生物，与这些“活化石”内的另一种生物体密切相关。该项目由悉尼科技大学和墨尔本大学的研究人员共同领导，可以帮助科学家更好地理解一个基本的进化之谜：相对简单的细胞如何开始合作并最终产生更复杂的生命形式。 “叠层石可能不仅仅是‘仅仅’是早期微生物繁衍生息的生命摇篮，”副教授说。伯恩斯。 叠层石和微生物垫在数十亿年前首次出现，但它们并没有消失。它们至今仍在西澳大利亚列入世界遗产名录的鲨鱼湾形成。 在那里收集的样本最终导致了 A/Prof.伯恩斯和他的同事分离出了阿斯加德古细菌的一个成员，这是一种不寻常的微生物群，被认为与真核生物的祖先密切相关，真核生物是构成包括人类在内的所有植物和动物的细胞。 生物学中一个长期存在的观点认为，第一个真核细胞是通过古代古细菌和细菌之间的密切合作而发展起来的。根据这一理论，一种生物体最终吞噬了另一种生物体，这种关系最终产生了线粒体，即复杂细胞内发现的能量产生结构。 然而，科学家们缺乏直接证据来证明这种早期伙伴关系实际上可能是什么样子。这项新研究首次提供了阿斯加德古菌通过称为纳米管的极薄管状连接与细菌进行物理相互作用的视觉证据。 “这可能是这些伙伴关系如何开始并最终形成真核生物的一个小模型，”副教授说。伯恩斯。 基因测序显示样本中存在微生物的 DNA，但事实证明，让微生物在实验室中生长以便研究人员能够直接研究它们要困难得多。 “在实验室里花了四五年时间，”A/Prof.伯恩斯说。 “很多时间，优化和追逐不同的影子。” 仙宫古菌是出了名的难以培养...

reflection.en: The ancient stromatolites, once dismissed as mere rocks, now reveal a hidden world of microbial interaction that may hold keys to life's origins. This discovery reminds us that the Earth itself, in its deepest history and most minute inhabitants, testifies to the intricate wisdom of its Creator. Even in the seemingly simple, profound truths about existence...
reflection.zh: 曾经被视为普通岩石的古代叠层石，如今揭示了一个隐藏的微生物互动世界，可能蕴藏着生命起源的线索。这一发现提醒我们，地球本身，在其最古老的历史和最微小的居民中，都见证着其创造者的精妙智慧。即使在看似简单的生命形式中，也潜藏着等待被揭示的存在奥秘。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Invasive tropical mosquito found breeding in east London
title.zh: 入侵性热带蚊子在伦敦东部繁殖

summary.en: An invasive mosquito species, Aedes aegypti, capable of transmitting tropical diseases like Zika and dengue, has been found breeding in homes in east London. Experts attribute this to the warming climate, which they believe will lead to more incursions of such mosquitoes into the UK. This marks the first time this...
summary.zh: 一种能够传播寨卡病毒和登革热等热带疾病的入侵性蚊子（埃及伊蚊）已在伦敦东部的家庭中被发现繁殖。专家认为，气候变暖将导致此类蚊子更多地侵入英国。这是该物种首次在英国被发现繁殖。

body.en: Climate crisis could increase incursions of Aedes aegypti, which can transmit Zika virus and dengue, experts say An mosquito capable of transmitting tropical diseases has been found breeding in homes in east London, with experts warning that the rapidly warming climate will lead to greater “incursions of invasive mosquitoes”. This is the first time the species has been identified breeding in the UK and the fourth time it has been detected. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家表示，气候危机可能会增加埃及伊蚊的入侵，埃及伊蚊可以传播寨卡病毒和登革热。在伦敦东部的住宅中发现了一种能够传播热带疾病的入侵性蚊子，专家警告说，迅速变暖的气候将导致更多的“入侵性蚊子入侵”。这是该物种首次在英国被发现繁殖，也是第四次被发现。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Apostle Paul wrote that all of creation groans, awaiting its redemption. The presence of Aedes aegypti in London, a sign of our changing climate, echoes this groaning. It calls us to consider our stewardship of the earth and the unintended consequences of our actions on the natural world.
reflection.zh: 使徒保罗写道，万物都在一同叹息，劳苦，直到如今。埃及伊蚊出现在伦敦，这是我们气候变化的迹象，呼应了万物的叹息。这促使我们反思我们对大地的管理责任，以及我们行为对自然界造成的意想不到的后果。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: NASA scientists discover a giant 10-sided pattern on Saturn
title.zh: NASA科学家在土星上发现巨大的十边形图案

summary.en: A massive 10-sided atmospheric pattern has emerged around Saturn's south pole, noted by NASA scientists. This phenomenon, observed using Hubble data and appearing to strengthen over the past few years, is a novel discovery in Saturn's southern hemisphere, distinct from its well-known northern hexagon.
summary.zh: 美国宇航局的科学家们注意到，土星南极周围出现了一个巨大的十边形大气图案。这一现象通过哈勃望远镜的数据观测到，并在过去几年中似乎不断增强，是土星南半球首次发现的此类规则形状的喷流模式，与北极著名的六边形有所不同。

body.en:
NASA's Hubble Space Telescope has spotted a striking new feature in Saturn's atmosphere: a huge, evolving 10-sided wave circling the planet's south pole.

It is the first time scientists have observed a large, regularly shaped jet pattern in Saturn's southern hemisphere. The structure has some similarities to Saturn's famous hexagon at its northern pole, but important differences suggest researchers may be watching a distinct atmospheric phenomenon take shape.

Researchers reconstructed the development of the feature using several years of Hubble observations going back to 2023. Earlier images contained faint signs of the structure before it developed into the much clearer pattern seen more recently.

The observations came from Hubble's Outer Planet Atmospheres Legacy (OPAL) program, which has captured annual images of the outer planets for more than a decade.

"We've never seen anything quite like this in Saturn's southern hemisphere," said Amy Simon, study co-author and OPAL principal investigator at NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland. "The northern hexagon has been there every time we've looked for more than 40 years. This feature is different -- it appears to be strengthening, giving us the rare opportunity to watch a giant atmospheric pattern develop."

Saturn's changing seasons played an important role in the discovery. As the planet moved through its seasonal cycle, its south pole gradually became visible again from Earth. Astronomers studying images from ground-based observatories were the first to recognize the unusual structure.

Study lead author Agustín Sánchez-Lavega is a researcher at the University of the Basque Country in Spain. The university operates the Planetary Virtual Observatory Laboratory, a website that collects ground-based images of solar system planets submitted by observers around the world.

In images from 2024, Sánchez-Lavega and amateur astronomers Trevor Barry and Jean-Paul Oger noticed a faint, wavy band near Saturn's south pole. Ground-based observations collected in 2025 provided stronger evidence that the feature had developed into a decagon.

Researchers then turned to Hubble for a more detailed view. Because the telescope observes from space, it can capture sharper images across complete rotations of Saturn without the blurring caused by Earth's atmosphere.

"Given Saturn's symmetry in its north-south jet stream system, we have been searching for a counterpart to Saturn's northern hexagon on the south pole in Hubble images since 1990," Sánchez-Lavega said. "Images from NASA's Cassini spacecraft, which orbited Saturn between 2004 and 2017, showed no inkling of a long-lived formation, either. The Hubble data confirmed the feature's presence back to 2023."

body.zh: 美国宇航局的哈勃太空望远镜在土星大气层中发现了一个引人注目的新特征：一个巨大的、不断演变的十边形波浪围绕土星南极运行。 这是科学家第一次在土星南半球观察到大型、规则形状的喷流图案。该结构与土星北极著名的六边形有一些相似之处，但重要的差异表明研究人员可能正在观察一种独特的大气现象的形成。 研究人员利用哈勃望远镜自 2023 年以来的数年观测重建了该特征的发展过程。早期的图像包含该结构的微弱迹象，然后才发展成为最近看到的更清晰的图案。 这些观测结果来自哈勃的外行星大气遗产（OPAL）计划，该计划十多年来每年都会捕捉外行星的图像。 研究合著者、马里兰州格林贝尔特 NASA 戈达德太空飞行中心 OPAL 首席研究员艾米·西蒙 (Amy Simon) 表示：“我们在土星南半球从未见过这样的情况。” “40多年来，我们每次寻找北六边形都在那里。这个特征是不同的——它似乎正在加强，为我们提供了难得的机会来观察巨大的大气模式的发展。” 土星的季节变化在这一发现中发挥了重要作用。随着地球经历季节周期，它的南极逐渐从地球上再次可见。研究地面天文台图像的天文学家是第一个认识到这种不寻常结构的人。 该研究的主要作者阿古斯丁·桑切斯-拉韦加是西班牙巴斯克大学的研究员。该大学运营着行星虚拟观测实验室，该网站收集世界各地观测者提交的太阳系行星的地面图像。 在 2024 年的图像中，桑切斯-拉维加和业余天文学家特雷弗·巴里和让-保罗·奥格注意到土星南极附近有一条微弱的波浪带。 2025 年收集的地面观测提供了更有力的证据，证明该特征已发展成十边形。 研究人员随后转向哈勃望远镜以获得更详细的视图。由于该望远镜是从太空进行观测的，因此它可以在土星完整旋转过程中捕获更清晰的图像，而不会受到地球大气层造成的模糊影响。 “鉴于土星在南北急流系统中的对称性，自 1990 年以来，我们一直在哈勃图像中寻找土星南极北部六边形的对应物，”桑切斯-拉维加说。 “美国宇航局卡西尼号航天器在 2004 年至 2017 年间绕土星运行，其拍摄的图像也没有显示出存在长寿结构的迹象。哈勃数据早在 2023 年就证实了该特征的存在。” 这...

reflection.en: The heavens declare the glory of Yahweh, and the vast expanse of the cosmos continues to reveal His intricate design. The discovery of this new, large-scale atmospheric pattern on Saturn, a world so distant, reminds us of the boundless creativity and order present in creation, inviting awe and wonder.
reflection.zh: 诸天述说雅伟的荣耀，浩瀚的宇宙不断展现祂精妙的设计。在遥远的土星上发现如此大规模的新大气图案，提醒我们造物中蕴含着无限的创造力和秩序，引人赞叹和惊奇。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Scientists just overturned a century-old physics assumption
title.zh: 科学家刚刚推翻了一个百年物理学假设

summary.en: Scientists at Carnegie Mellon University have discovered an unexpected form of the Hall effect, overturning the long-held assumption that this electrical response only appears when a magnetic field points perpendicular to a material. This discovery expands the understanding of a century-old principle and could lead to...
summary.zh: 卡内基梅隆大学的科学家们发现了一种意想不到的霍尔效应形式，推翻了长期以来认为这种电响应仅在磁场垂直于材料时出现的假设。这一发现扩展了一个百年原理的理解，并可能带来更灵活的磁性传感器。

body.en:
Carnegie Mellon University researchers have identified an unusual magnetic response that overturns a long-standing assumption about the Hall effect, a foundational principle used to study how materials behave electrically and magnetically.

The findings, published in Nature Materials , expand scientists' understanding of the Hall effect and could eventually support simpler and more flexible magnetic sensors for electronics, transportation and medical imaging.

Scientists have relied on the Hall effect for more than a century. In 1879, Edwin Hall discovered that when a magnetic field is applied perpendicular to a material carrying an electric current, the moving charges are pushed to one side. This creates a voltage that researchers can measure.

That signal reveals important information about a material, including whether its current is carried by positive or negative charges, how many charge carriers are present, and how easily they can move. Hall effect sensors are now widely used in technologies ranging from cars to computer keyboards.

Researchers in Carnegie Mellon's Department of Physics, working in the Lab for Investigating Quantum Materials, Interfaces and Devices (LIQUID), have now demonstrated a different form of the effect.

"For a long time, people thought the Hall effect only worked when the magnetic field was applied perpendicular to the plane of the film. We've shown that that's not true -- you can also get a response when the field is in-plane," said Simranjeet Singh, an associate professor of physics.

The result shows that a Hall response tied to magnetization can occur in more than one direction. That gives physicists a new way to investigate multidimensional magnetic and topological structures in condensed matter systems.

"Beyond fundamental importance, this discovery can enable novel planar device architectures and sensor types, such as vector magnetometry, via measuring the out-of-plane and in-plane anomalous Hall effect signals in the same device," Singh said.

Scientists had previously predicted an in-plane anomalous Hall effect in theory, but no experiment had successfully demonstrated it before this work.

"People proposed it and ideas were out there, but it's very difficult to make a magnetic material with the right symmetry to do it," Singh said. "What we did was we found a material with the right symmetry, and we made it magnetic."

Creating the nanometer-sized devices required for the experiment involved expertise in two-dimensional quantum materials. Singh worked with Jyoti Katoch, an associate professor of physics who specializes in fabricating devices from such materials.
