body.zh: 卡内基梅隆大学的研究人员发现了一种不寻常的磁响应，它推翻了长期以来关于霍尔效应的假设，霍尔效应是用于研究材料电学和磁学行为的基本原理。 发表在《自然材料》上的研究结果扩展了科学家对霍尔效应的理解，并最终可以支持用于电子、交通和医学成像的更简单、更灵活的磁传感器。 一个多世纪以来，科学家们一直依赖霍尔效应。 1879 年，埃德温·霍尔 (Edwin Hall) 发现，当垂直于载有电流的材料施加磁场时，移动的电荷会被推向一侧。这会产生研究人员可以测量的电压。 该信号揭示了有关材料的重要信息，包括其电流是由正电荷还是负电荷携带、存在多少电荷载流子以及它们移动的容易程度。霍尔效应传感器现已广泛应用于从汽车到计算机键盘的各种技术中。 卡内基梅隆大学物理系研究量子材料、界面和器件（LIQUID）实验室的研究人员现在已经展示了一种不同形式的效应。 “很长一段时间以来，人们认为霍尔效应只有在垂直于薄膜平面施加磁场时才起作用。我们已经证明事实并非如此——当磁场位于平面内时，你也可以得到响应，”物理学副教授西姆兰吉特·辛格（Simranjeet Singh）说。 结果表明，与磁化强度相关的霍尔响应可以在多个方向上发生。这为物理学家提供了一种研究凝聚态物质系统中多维磁性和拓扑结构的新方法。 辛格说：“除了基本重要性之外，这一发现还可以通过测量同一设备中的面外和面内异常霍尔效应信号来实现新颖的平面设备架构和传感器类型，例如矢量磁力测量。” 科学家此前曾在理论上预测过面内反常霍尔效应，但在此之前还没有实验成功证明这一点。 辛格说：“人们提出了这个想法，想法也已经存在，但是很难制造出具有正确对称性的磁性材料来实现这一目标。” “我们所做的是找到一种具有正确对称性的材料，并使其具有磁性。” 创建实验所需的纳米尺寸设备需要二维量子材料方面的专业知识。辛格与物理学副教授乔蒂·卡托奇（Jyoti Katoch）合作，乔蒂·卡托奇专门研究用此类材料制造设备。 该研究小组包括博士后研究员 I-Hsuan Kao 和 Ravi Kumar，从碲化钽铱 (TaIrTe4) 开始。它是...

reflection.en: The universe is a vast library, and every discovery, like this one regarding the Hall effect, is a page turned. As Job asks, 'But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the sky, and they will tell you,' we see that creation itself testifies to Yahweh's wisdom. These scientific endeavors, by revealing deeper truths about the physical...
reflection.zh: 宇宙是一座宏伟的图书馆，每一次发现，如同这次关于霍尔效应的突破，都是翻开的一页。正如约伯所问：“但你且问走兽，可也教你；问天空的飞鸟，可也告诉你。”我们看到，受造界本身就见证着雅伟的智慧。这些科学探索，通过揭示物质世界的更深层真理，呼应了那蕴含在存在之中的深邃知识。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Bats carry dangerous viruses without getting sick. This may be why
title.zh: 蝙蝠携带危险病毒而不生病。这可能是原因

summary.en: Scientists have discovered that over 500 species of vesper bats possess two separate sets of antibody genes, a unique immune arrangement previously unknown in mammals. This remarkable system may explain how bats can tolerate numerous viruses without succumbing to serious illness.
summary.zh: 科学家发现，超过500种翼手蝠拥有两套独立的抗体基因，这种免疫结构是哺乳动物前所未见的。这一非凡的系统可能解释了蝙蝠为何能携带多种病毒而不患重病。

body.en:
Scientists have long been intrigued by a question surrounding bats: how can these flying mammals carry viruses capable of causing severe disease while rarely becoming seriously ill themselves?

Researchers at Tulane University, working with collaborators at Stanford University and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, may now have identified part of the answer.

A study published in Science Advances found that the world's largest family of bats carries two distinct copies of the genes involved in producing antibodies. These specialized proteins help the immune system identify and fight infections. Every other known mammal has only one such set of genes.

The finding gives scientists a new way to think about how immune systems evolved and how different animals respond to disease.

"We've never seen anything like this in a mammal before," said Hannah Frank, associate professor of ecology and evolutionary biology at Tulane University School of Science and Engineering and corresponding author of the study. "This completely changes our understanding of how mammalian immune systems can be organized and raises exciting new questions about why bats have been so evolutionarily successful and how they respond to viruses."

The discovery was made in vesper bats, a group that includes more than 500 species living on every continent except Antarctica. Scientists have long been interested in the extraordinary evolutionary success of these bats, and their unusual antibody system may provide part of the explanation.

Antibodies are Y-shaped proteins built from two heavy protein chains and two light protein chains. In humans and all other known mammals, the heavy chains are produced using a single set of genes.

Frank and her colleagues found that vesper bats are different. They have two separate heavy-chain gene systems, potentially giving them another way to create a wider variety of antibodies.

Researchers studying bat immunity have traditionally paid more attention to the innate immune system. Frank said the new findings show why the adaptive immune system -- the part responsible for producing antibodies -- also deserves closer study.

"We think this discovery is an important piece of the puzzle," Frank said. "It doesn't fully explain why bats are such effective viral reservoirs, but it reveals a level of immune variety we didn't know existed and gives us an entirely new direction to explore."

Bats play important ecological roles as pollinators, seed dispersers and natural pest controllers. At the same time, they are natural hosts for many viruses, Frank said.

Learning how bats can live alongside those viruses without becoming ill could eventually help researchers better understand immune responses in other species. That knowledge may also...
body.zh: 长期以来，科学家们对有关蝙蝠的一个问题很感兴趣：这些飞行的哺乳动物如何携带能够引起严重疾病的病毒，而自己却很少患上严重疾病？ 杜兰大学的研究人员与斯坦福大学和疾病控制与预防中心的合作者合作，现在可能已经找到了部分答案。 发表在《科学进展》上的一项研究发现，世界上最大的蝙蝠家族携带两个不同的参与产生抗体的基因副本。这些特殊的蛋白质帮助免疫系统识别和抵抗感染。所有其他已知的哺乳动物都只有一组这样的基因。 这一发现为科学家们提供了一种新的方式来思考免疫系统如何进化以及不同动物如何应对疾病。 杜兰大学科学与工程学院生态学和进化生物学副教授、该研究的通讯作者汉娜·弗兰克（Hannah Frank）说：“我们以前从未在哺乳动物中见过这样的情况。” “这完全改变了我们对哺乳动物免疫系统如何组织的理解，并提出了令人兴奋的新问题，即为什么蝙蝠在进化上如此成功以及它们如何对病毒做出反应。” 这一发现是在晚霞蝠中发现的，该群体包括 500 多个物种，生活在除南极洲以外的各大洲。长期以来，科学家们一直对这些蝙蝠非凡的进化成功感兴趣，它们不寻常的抗体系统可能提供了部分解释。 抗体是由两条重蛋白链和两条轻蛋白链构建的 Y 形蛋白质。在人类和所有其他已知的哺乳动物中，重链是使用一组基因产生的。 弗兰克和她的同事发现晚祷蝙蝠与众不同。它们有两个独立的重链基因系统，这可能为它们提供另一种方法来产生更广泛的抗体。 研究蝙蝠免疫的研究人员传统上更关注先天免疫系统。弗兰克说，新发现表明为什么适应性免疫系统（负责产生抗体的部分）也值得进一步研究。 “我们认为这一发现是这个难题的重要组成部分，”弗兰克说。 “它并没有完全解释为什么蝙蝠是如此有效的病毒储存库，但它揭示了我们不知道存在的免疫多样性水平，并为我们提供了一个全新的探索方向。” 蝙蝠作为传粉者、种子传播者和天然害虫控制者，发挥着重要的生态作用。弗兰克说，与此同时，它们是许多病毒的天然宿主。 了解蝙蝠如何与这些病毒共存而不生病，最终可以帮助研究人员更好地了解其他物种的免疫反应。这些知识也可能...

reflection.en: The intricate design of bats' immune systems, allowing them to carry viruses without illness, is a testament to the profound wisdom embedded in Yahweh's creation. Observing such biological marvels can deepen our awe and understanding of the Creator's intricate handiwork, reminding us that creation itself speaks of His intelligence and power.
reflection.zh: 蝙蝠免疫系统的复杂设计，使它们能在携带病毒的同时保持健康，这证明了雅伟创造物中蕴含的深邃智慧。观察这样的生物奇迹，可以加深我们对造物主精妙工巧的敬畏和理解，并提醒我们，创造本身就彰显着祂的智慧与大能。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: One immune switch may help drive aging across the body
title.zh: 一个免疫开关可能有助于驱动全身衰老

summary.en: Aging may be partly fueled by immune cells losing their ability to clear away damaged, inflammation-promoting cells. Blocking a single receptor restored that cleanup process in mice, reducing inflammation and helping their organs, muscles, and memory remain remarkably youthful.
summary.zh: 衰老可能部分是由免疫细胞清除受损、促进炎症的细胞的能力下降所驱动的。在小鼠身上阻断一个单一的受体，恢复了这种清除过程，减少了炎症，并帮助它们器官、肌肉和记忆保持惊人的年轻状态。

body.en:
Aging happens at different speeds from one person to another, but it eventually affects everyone. New research from Stanford Medicine, conducted in mice and human cells, points to a particular failure in the immune system that may help explain why.

The researchers found that tissue-resident macrophages, a type of immune cell that lives permanently within organs, become less able with age to dispose of another class of immune cells. That decline appears to contribute to aging throughout the body.

When the scientists blocked a single receptor on these macrophages, multiple organs in mice retained more youthful characteristics. The effects were seen in the brain, heart, skeletal and heart muscle, liver, spleen, bone marrow, kidney, and colon. The receptor normally responds to a hormone involved in inflammation and pain in both mice and humans.

Disabling the receptor specifically in tissue-resident macrophages also protected mice from several problems associated with chronic inflammation and aging, including frailty, excess fat accumulation and heart trouble. Cognitive decline was substantially reduced as well, according to Katrin Andreasson, MD, the Edward F. and Irene Thiel Pimley Professor in Neurology and Neurological Sciences.

"We've been trying to figure out why we age," Andreasson said. "Now we know at least one big reason for it."

The findings are described in a paper published in Science . Andreasson is the senior author, and Jessy Tan, PhD, an instructor in neurology, is the lead author.

The results provide new insight into the important role that chronic, body-wide inflammation plays in aging and its associated health problems. They also point toward a potential drug strategy that could slow age-related deterioration in organs and possibly extend the number of years people remain healthy.

Neutrophils are the most abundant white blood cells in the immune system and serve as some of the body's most important first responders. They are produced in bone marrow and then enter the bloodstream, where they patrol for bacterial, viral, and fungal threats.

When neutrophils encounter pathogens, they can release toxic substances and even destroy themselves, spilling long strands of biological material that form web-like traps around invading microbes.

These cells do not live for long. A neutrophil may survive for as much as 24 hours, although 12 hours is more typical. Roughly 90% of circulating neutrophils eventually arrive in the liver, spleen, and bone marrow, where other immune cells remove them.

That disposal process is especially important as the body grows older. In aging animals, most neutrophils that never encounter a pathogen quickly enter senescence, a dysfunctional state in which they can release harmful chemicals that damage nearby...
body.zh: 衰老的速度因人而异，但最终会影响到每个人。斯坦福大学医学院在小鼠和人类细胞中进行的新研究指出了免疫系统的一种特殊失败，这可能有助于解释原因。 研究人员发现，组织驻留巨噬细胞是一种永久存在于器官内的免疫细胞，随着年龄的增长，其处理另一类免疫细胞的能力会逐渐减弱。这种下降似乎会导致整个身体的衰老。 当科学家们阻断这些巨噬细胞上的单个受体时，小鼠的多个器官保留了更年轻的特征。这些影响出现在大脑、心脏、骨骼和心肌、肝脏、脾脏、骨髓、肾脏和结肠中。该受体通常会对与小鼠和人类炎症和疼痛有关的激素做出反应。 使组织驻留巨噬细胞中的受体失活还可以保护小鼠免受与慢性炎症和衰老相关的多种问题，包括虚弱、脂肪堆积过多和心脏病。神经学和神经科学教授 Edward F. 和 Irene Thiel Pimley 教授 Katrin Andreasson 医学博士表示，认知能力下降也显着减少。 “我们一直在试图找出我们变老的原因，”安德烈亚森说。 “现在我们至少知道了其中一个重要原因。” 研究结果发表在《科学》杂志上的一篇论文中。 Andreasson 是资深作者，神经学讲师 Jessy Tan 博士是主要作者。 这些结果为了解慢性全身炎症在衰老及其相关健康问题中所起的重要作用提供了新的见解。他们还指出了一种潜在的药物策略，可以减缓与年龄相关的器官退化，并可能延长人们保持健康的年限。 中性粒细胞是免疫系统中最丰富的白细胞，是人体最重要的第一反应者。它们在骨髓中产生，然后进入血液，在那里巡逻细菌、病毒和真菌威胁。 当中性粒细胞遇到病原体时，它们会释放有毒物质，甚至自我毁灭，释放出长条的生物材料，在入侵的微生物周围形成网状陷阱。 这些细胞的寿命并不长。中性粒细胞可存活长达 24 小时，但更典型的是 12 小时。大约 90% 的循环中性粒细胞最终到达肝脏、脾脏和骨髓，在那里其他免疫细胞将其清除。 随着身体年龄的增长，这种处理过程尤其重要。在衰老的动物中，大多数从未遇到病原体的中性粒细胞会迅速进入衰老状态，这是一种功能失调的状态，在这种状态下，它们可以释放有害化学物质，损害附近......

reflection.en: This research into aging reveals the intricate design of our bodies, where a single cellular mechanism can have such widespread effects. It reminds us of the profound wonder in how we are made, a testament to the Creator's detailed craftsmanship. Even as science uncovers the complex biological processes of aging, we can marvel at the inherent design and...
reflection.zh: 这项关于衰老的研究揭示了我们身体的精密设计，其中一个单一的细胞机制就能产生如此广泛的影响。它提醒我们，我们被造的奇妙之处，以及创造者精湛工艺的证明。 即使科学揭示了衰老的复杂生物过程，我们仍然可以惊叹于我们内在固有的设计和韧性，这反映了诗篇作者对“我被造的奇妙”的敬畏之情。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: There’s a quick way to slow climate change. Why isn’t everyone doing it? – podcast
title.zh: 减缓气候变化的捷径。为什么不是每个人都在这样做？——播客

summary.en: Methane is a potent greenhouse gas that traps more than 80 times as much heat than carbon dioxide over a 20-year period and causes 25% of global heating today. We definitely don’t want this gas spewing needlessly into the atmosphere, but in 2023 that’s exactly what environment editor Damian Carrington found was...
summary.zh: 甲烷是一种强效温室气体，在20年内吸收的热量是二氧化碳的80多倍，并导致了当今25%的全球变暖。我们绝对不希望这种气体毫无必要地排放到大气中，但环境编辑达米安·卡灵顿在2023年报道全球1000个超级甲烷泄漏点时发现，情况正是如此。现在，漏气最多的国家土库曼斯坦已经开始堵漏。达米安告诉马德琳·芬利，为什么一些专家称阻止...

body.en: Methane is a potent greenhouse gas that traps more than 80 times as much heat than carbon dioxide over a 20-year period and causes 25% of global heating today. We definitely don’t want this gas spewing needlessly into the atmosphere, but in 2023 that’s exactly what environment editor Damian Carrington found was happening when he reported on 1,000 super-emitting methane leaks across the globe. Now Turkmenistan, the worst country for mega-leaks, has begun to plug them. Damian tells Madeleine Finlay why some experts call stopping leaks the climate ‘emergency brake’ and reveals which countries are still failing to act ‘Breakthrough’ as Turkmenistan starts fixing ‘mindboggling’ methane mega-leaks Support the Guardian: theguardian.com/sciencepod Continue reading...
body.zh: 甲烷是一种强效温室气体，在 20 年内吸收的热量是二氧化碳的 80 多倍，导致当今全球变暖的 25%。我们绝对不希望这种气体不必要地喷入大气中，但 2023 年环境编辑达米安·卡林顿 (Damian Carrington) 在报告全球 1,000 起超排放甲烷泄漏事件时发现，这种情况正在发生。现在，土库曼斯坦这个超级泄漏最严重的国家已经开始堵住这些泄漏。达米安告诉玛德琳·芬利，为什么一些专家将阻止泄漏称为气候“紧急刹车”，并揭示了当土库曼斯坦开始修复“令人难以置信的”甲烷特大泄漏时，哪些国家仍未采取“突破”行动支持卫报：theguardian.com/sciencepod 继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news that Turkmenistan is beginning to plug methane leaks offers a glimmer of hope in the fight against climate change. This action aligns with the biblical mandate to care for creation, recognizing our responsibility to steward the Earth and its resources wisely. May this be a catalyst for greater global cooperation in protecting our shared home.
reflection.zh: 土库曼斯坦开始堵漏的消息为应对气候变化带来了希望的曙光。这一行动符合圣经中关爱造物的吩咐，认识到我们有责任明智地管理地球及其资源。愿这成为全球加强合作、保护我们共同家园的催化剂。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: Ketone homologation via palladium-catalysed decarboxylative rearrangement
title.zh: 酮的钯催化脱羧重排同系化

summary.en: A new method for ketone homologation via palladium-catalyzed decarboxylative rearrangement has been published in Nature, representing a significant advancement in synthetic chemistry.
summary.zh: 一项关于通过钯催化脱羧重排进行酮同系化的新方法已在《自然》杂志上发表，这代表了合成化学领域的重大进展。

reflection.en: The intricate processes of chemistry, as detailed in this scientific report, reveal the profound wisdom embedded within creation. Observing how elements and molecules interact, rearrange, and form new compounds offers a glimpse into the masterful design of the universe, inviting us to ponder the Creator's ingenuity.
reflection.zh: 这项科学报告所详述的化学的复杂过程，揭示了创造中蕴含的深刻智慧。观察元素和分子如何相互作用、重排并形成新化合物，让我们得以一窥宇宙精妙的设计，并引发我们对造物主之巧思的沉思。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Immune therapy engineered inside the body eases multiple sclerosis
title.zh: 体内工程化免疫疗法可缓解多发性硬化症

summary.en: Results from a small trial suggest a modified virus can instruct the immune system to wipe out disease-causing cells.
summary.zh: 一项小型试验的结果表明，一种改良的病毒可以指示免疫系统清除致病细胞。

reflection.en: This breakthrough in treating multiple sclerosis highlights the intricate design of the human body and the potential for innovative therapies. It reminds us that much wisdom and understanding can be found by carefully observing and working with the natural systems Yahweh has created.
reflection.zh: 这项在治疗多发性硬化症方面取得的突破，凸显了人体精妙的设计以及创新疗法的潜力。它提醒我们，通过仔细观察和运用雅伟所创造的自然系统，可以获得许多智慧和理解。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Magic-mushroom compound blocks a severe side effect of chemotherapy, in mice
title.zh: 魔术蘑菇化合物可阻断化疗的严重副作用，在小鼠身上得到证实

summary.en: A study published in Nature shows that psilocybin, a compound found in magic mushrooms, can prevent peripheral neuropathy, a painful condition often caused by chemotherapy, in mice.
summary.zh: 发表在《自然》杂志上的一项研究表明，魔术蘑菇中的化合物裸盖菇素（psilocybin）在小鼠身上能够预防化疗引起的疼痛性疾病——周围神经病。

reflection.en: The discovery that a compound from psilocybin can alleviate chemotherapy's painful side effects in mice highlights how careful observation of creation can lead to unexpected healing. It reminds us that Yahweh's intricate design in nature holds potential remedies, waiting to be uncovered through diligent study.
reflection.zh: 发现裸盖菇素化合物能在小鼠身上缓解化疗的疼痛副作用，这表明对受造界的细致观察能带来意想不到的疗愈。它提醒我们，雅伟在自然界中精妙的设计蕴含着潜在的疗法，等待着通过勤奋的研究被发掘出来。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Buried underpants and a new definition of kissing win 2026 Ig Nobel prizes
title.zh: 埋藏的内裤和接吻的新定义赢得了 2026 年搞笑诺贝尔奖

summary.en: The Ig Nobel Prizes, published online by Nature, highlight research that is strange, humorous, and thought-provoking, celebrating the quirky side of scientific inquiry.
summary.zh: 搞笑诺贝尔奖在《自然》杂志在线发表，表彰那些奇怪、幽默且发人深省的研究，庆祝科学探索的古怪一面。

reflection.en: The Ig Nobel Prizes remind us that even the most unusual or seemingly trivial research can spark curiosity and lead to unexpected insights. The catalog of verses points to Job 12:7, which suggests that even the animal world and the earth itself can teach us wisdom. These quirky awards encourage us to look at the world with fresh eyes, finding wonder and...
reflection.zh: 搞笑诺贝尔奖提醒我们，即使是最不寻常或看似微不足道的研究也能激发好奇心并带来意想不到的见解。经文目录指向约伯记 12:7，其中提到即使是动物界和大地本身也能教导我们智慧。这些古怪的奖项鼓励我们用全新的眼光看待世界，在意想不到之处发现奇迹和知识。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Nations expanding their research programmes impose sweeping penalties for malpractice
title.zh: 各国扩大研究项目，对不端行为施加严厉处罚

summary.en: Nature, Published online: 03 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02517-1 India, Peru and Vietnam are rolling out policies that limit opportunities for scientists who fall foul of research-integrity guidelines.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志，在线发表：2026年9月3日；doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02517-1 印度、秘鲁和越南正在推行限制违反研究诚信准则的科学家的机会的政策。

reflection.en: As nations like India, Peru, and Vietnam establish stricter penalties for scientific misconduct, they are emphasizing the importance of integrity in research. This reflects a broader principle found in Micah 6:8, which calls for justice and ethical conduct. The pursuit of truth in science requires a foundation of honesty and accountability.
reflection.zh: 随着印度、秘鲁和越南等国为科研不端行为制定更严格的处罚措施，它们正在强调研究诚信的重要性。这呼应了弥迦书6:8中呼吁公正和道德行为的更广泛原则。科学真理的追求需要诚实和问责制作为基础。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: Could robots be the future of theme parks?
title.zh: 机器人会是主题公园的未来吗？

summary.en: Galaxy Robot Park is a 16,500-square-meter venue in South Korea, featuring attractions like humanoid robots dancing to K-pop music. The company behind it aims to integrate artificial intelligence and robotics into entertainment, posing the question of whether robots can sustain visitor interest.
summary.zh: 银河机器人公园是韩国一个占地16,500平方米的场馆，其景点包括跳着K-pop热曲的拟人机器人。公园的创办公司旨在将人工智能和机器人技术引入娱乐领域，并提出了机器人能否吸引游客持续到来的问题。

body.en: This is Galaxy Robot Park, a 16,500-square-meter venue that’s opened near Seoul in South Korea . The company behind the park says their aim is to bring artificial intelligence and robotics into the world of entertainment. The question is, can robots keep people coming back?
body.zh: 这就是银河机器人公园，一个占地 16,500 平方米的场地，在韩国首尔附近开业。该公园背后的公司表示，他们的目标是将人工智能和机器人技术带入娱乐世界。问题是，机器人能让人们回来吗？

reflection.en: The opening of the Galaxy Robot Park in South Korea, with its dancing humanoid robots, highlights humanity's relentless pursuit of innovation and knowledge. This drive, as described in Daniel 12:4, is leading to an explosion of technological advancement, particularly in AI and robotics, reshaping how we experience entertainment and interact with the world.
reflection.zh: 韩国银河机器人公园的开业，展示了载歌载舞的拟人机器人，这突显了人类对创新和知识的不懈追求。正如但以理书12:4所描述的，这种驱动力正引领着人工智能和机器人技术的爆炸性发展，并重塑着我们体验娱乐和与世界互动的方式。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Reports: RFK Jr. ordered measles deaths deletion; CDC still secretly counts them
title.zh: 报道：小肯尼迪下令删除麻疹死亡病例；疾控中心仍在秘密统计

summary.en: CDC staff had already accepted the measles death reports when RFK Jr. interfered, ordering their deletion from public records despite their initial characterization as measles-related.
summary.zh: 在小肯尼迪干预之前，疾控中心的工作人员已经接受了麻疹死亡报告，他下令将其从公开记录中删除，尽管这些死亡最初被定性为与麻疹有关。

body.en: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention is still secretly counting two measles deaths that were deleted from the agency's public measles data—a deletion that occurred at the direct request of anti-vaccine Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., according to two reports released today. Early today, Reuters reported that Kennedy instructed new CDC director Erica Schwartz to delete the two deaths from the agency's website. CDC staff had reportedly already reviewed information about the deaths and accepted the characterization that they were measles-related. Still, Schwartz deleted the deaths without objection, insiders told Reuters. According to previous reporting , the two deaths were added and then removed from the CDC's website within hours on August 30. The deaths were of a newborn and a child, and they were reported last week by health officials in Pennsylvania. The state's ongoing measles outbreak has sickened 540 so far, including 119 just in the last week . Read full article Comments
body.zh: 根据今天发布的两份报告，美国疾病控制与预防中心仍在秘密统计两例麻疹死亡人数，这些死亡人数已从该机构的公共麻疹数据中删除——这一删除是应反疫苗卫生部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪的直接要求而进行的。今天早些时候，路透社报道称，肯尼迪指示新任疾病预防控制中心主任埃丽卡·施瓦茨从该机构的网站上删除这两起死亡事件。据报道，疾病预防控制中心工作人员已经审查了有关死亡的信息，并接受了死亡与麻疹相关的定性。知情人士告诉路透社，施瓦茨毫无异议地删除了死亡事件。根据之前的报道，8 月 30 日，两例死亡病例被添加，然后在几小时内从 CDC 网站上删除。死亡病例是一名新生儿和一名儿童，宾夕法尼亚州卫生官员上周报告了这一情况。该州持续爆发的麻疹疫情迄今已导致 540 人患病，其中上周就有 119 人患病。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The news reports that Robert F. Kennedy Jr. ordered the deletion of two measles deaths from public CDC records, even after staff had accepted them as measles-related. This raises questions about the integrity of public health data and the ethical responsibilities of leaders in such sensitive areas. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk...
reflection.zh: 新闻报道称，罗伯特·肯尼迪二世下令从疾控中心的公开记录中删除两例麻疹死亡病例，尽管工作人员已将其认定为与麻疹相关。这引发了对公共卫生数据完整性以及领导人在这些敏感领域所承担的道德责任的质疑。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与神同行，这些原则应指导所有公共服务。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Xbox imposes harsh new time limits for Game Pass game streaming
title.zh: Xbox 对游戏通行证游戏流媒体施加严厉的新时间限制

summary.en: Over 1 million Game Pass subscribers will face increased costs due to new, stricter monthly limits on game streaming time, with additional hours available for purchase.
summary.zh: 超过一百万 Game Pass 用户将因新的、更严格的游戏流媒体月度限制而面临更高的成本，额外的小时数可供购买。

body.en: In 2020, Microsoft announced that Game Pass Ultimate subscriptions would include unlimited access to its new Xbox Cloud Gaming service (then still known as Project xCloud ). Now, that kind of streaming buffet service is coming to an end, as Microsoft announced strict new limits on how much streaming is included in its various Game Pass subscriptions. Starting in November, Game Pass subscriptions will include the following monthly limits on game streaming time: Game Pass Ultimate ($23/month): 15 hours Game Pass Premium ($15/month): 10 hours Game Pass Essential ($10/month): 5 hours Subscribers who use up their monthly streaming allotment will be able to buy additional time, Microsoft said, without sharing specific pricing or availability for that streaming time. Access to downloadable versions of games included in a Game Pass subscription remains unaffected. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 2020 年，微软宣布 Game Pass Ultimate 订阅将包括无限制地访问其新的 Xbox 云游戏服务（当时仍称为 Project xCloud）。现在，随着微软宣布对其各种 Game Pass 订阅中包含的流媒体数量进行严格的新限制，这种流媒体自助餐服务即将结束。从11月开始，Game Pass订阅将包括以下游戏流媒体时间的每月限制： Game Pass Ultimate（23美元/月）：15小时 Game Pass Premium（15美元/月）：10小时 Game Pass Essential（10美元/月）：5小时 微软表示，用完每月流媒体配额的订阅者将能够购买额外的时间，而无需透露该流媒体时间的具体价格或可用性。对 Game Pass 订阅中包含的游戏的可下载版本的访问不受影响。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: Microsoft's decision to limit game streaming time for Game Pass subscribers highlights how technological advancements, while offering convenience, can also introduce new restrictions and costs. The principle that 'not everything is beneficial' reminds us to discern the true value and impact of such changes, considering both the provider's business model and...
reflection.zh: 微软决定限制 Game Pass 用户的游戏流媒体时间，这表明技术进步在提供便利的同时，也可能带来新的限制和成本。《凡事都可行，但不都有益》的原则提醒我们，要辨别这些变化的真正价值和影响，既要考虑提供商的商业模式，也要考虑用户的体验和福祉。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: 150 research primates got diarrhea, flooding lab with priceless vaccine data
title.zh: 150只研究用灵长类动物腹泻，为珍贵疫苗数据带来实验室洪水

summary.en: Researchers have identified new targets and gained insights for developing a Shigella vaccine following an outbreak of diarrhea in over 150 non-human primates, which provided a wealth of immunological data.
summary.zh: 在超过150只非人类灵长类动物爆发腹泻疫情后，研究人员获得了开发志贺氏菌疫苗的新靶点和见解，这次疫情提供了大量的免疫学数据。

body.en: Having more than 150 non-human primates at a research center fall ill with diarrhea in a stomach-churning outbreak that flowed for over two years doesn't sound much like good fortune. But for some scientists, it kind of was, providing a heaping pile of valuable data on how they might finally defeat a foul foe. In a study published in the latest issue of Science Translational Medicine , scientist sifted through the dump of immunological data from the infections, logging new ways to train immune cells to defeat the bacteria behind the outbreak, a type of Shigella . Researchers were able to pluck out specific bits of the bacteria that the immune system could most effectively attack, linking specific target molecules to specific types of germ-busting immune responses. The researchers even precisely homed in on some of the tiny notches within those craggy target molecules where the most potent antibodies attached. In all, the study "revealed unexpected features of the anti-Shigella antibody response in naturally infected [non-human primates] and represents a step toward the rational design of Shigella vaccine candidates," the authors write. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 一个研究中心有超过 150 只非人类灵长类动物在一场持续两年多的令人反胃的疫情中患上腹泻，这听起来不太像是一件好事。但对于一些科学家来说，这可以提供大量有价值的数据，告诉他们如何最终击败邪恶的敌人。在最新一期《科学转化医学》杂志上发表的一项研究中，科学家筛选了感染的免疫学数据，记录了训练免疫细胞击败疫情背后的细菌（志贺氏菌的一种）的新方法。研究人员能够找出免疫系统最有效攻击的细菌的特定部分，将特定的目标分子与特定类型的杀菌免疫反应联系起来。研究人员甚至精确地瞄准了那些崎岖不平的目标分子内的一些微小凹口，这些凹口上附着着最有效的抗体。总而言之，该研究“揭示了自然感染的[非人类灵长类动物]抗志贺氏菌抗体反应的意想不到的特征，并且代表着朝着理性设计候选志贺氏菌疫苗迈出了一步，”作者写道。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: Sometimes, what appears to be a setback can unexpectedly yield profound insights. The unexpected illness among these primates, while unfortunate, has provided scientists with crucial data, reminding us that wisdom can be found even in difficult circumstances. As Job teaches, we can learn from the natural world around us, even when it presents challenges.
reflection.zh: 有时，看似是挫折的事情却能意外地带来深刻的见解。这些灵长类动物的意外疾病虽然不幸，却为科学家提供了关键数据，提醒我们即使在困难的环境中也能找到智慧。正如约伯所教导的，我们可以从周围的自然界中学习，即使它带来了挑战。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Confused about which VPN is right, US senator asks the NSA for guidance
title.zh: 美国参议员呼吁国家安全局就VPN使用提供指导

summary.en: A US senator has asked the National Security Agency (NSA) to provide public guidance on the best practices for using virtual private networks (VPNs) to protect communications from foreign adversaries. The senator noted the complexity and variety of VPN options available, and the NSA's previous recommendations lacked...
summary.zh: 一位美国参议员已要求国家安全局（NSA）就使用虚拟专用网络（VPN）的最佳实践向公众提供指导，以保护通信免受外国敌对势力的侵害。参议员指出，可用的VPN选项复杂且种类繁多，而NSA此前的建议缺乏关于哪些VPN能提供足够保护的具体指导。

body.en: A prominent US senator is asking the National Security Agency to provide guidance to the general public on best practices for using virtual private networks to secure their communications from spying by foreign adversaries. VPNs funnel all of a user’s Internet traffic through an encrypted connection to a remote server. The design provides strong assurances that no one between the user and the server can read the encrypted contents. VPNs also allow users to hide their IP addresses from the destination servers they communicate with. While US agencies have previously recommended use of VPNs, none have given recommendations on which ones provide adequate protection. It's all in the nuances There are a host of limitations that can undo many of the protections users may think their VPN provides them. For instance, the encrypted tunnel often terminates once a single server decrypts the traffic and sends it on to its final destination. That means the decrypted traffic or the sending and destination IP addresses may be available for snooping by rogue employees or attackers who hack the server. VPNs also don’t encrypt certain types of metadata, such as time stamps, allowing nation-states to build profiles that can be useful in intelligence gathering. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 一位著名的美国参议员要求国家安全局向公众提供有关使用虚拟专用网络保护其通信免受外国对手间谍活动的最佳实践的指导。 VPN 通过加密连接将用户的所有互联网流量汇集到远程服务器。这一设计提供了强有力的保证，即用户和服务器之间的任何人都无法读取加密内容。 VPN 还允许用户向与其通信的目标服务器隐藏其 IP 地址。虽然美国机构此前建议使用 VPN，但没有一个机构就哪些 VPN 提供足够的保护给出建议。一切都在细微差别中 有许多限制可能会抵消用户认为 VPN 为他们提供的许多保护。例如，一旦单个服务器解密流量并将其发送到最终目的地，加密隧道通常就会终止。这意味着解密的流量或发送和目标 IP 地址可能会被黑客攻击服务器的流氓员工或攻击者窥探。 VPN 也不加密某些类型的元数据，例如时间戳，从而允许民族国家构建可用于情报收集的配置文件。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In an age of complex digital tools, discerning the best path forward can be overwhelming. This senator's request for clear guidance on VPNs reflects a need for wisdom in navigating technological choices. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that 'where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.' May we seek and offer wise...
reflection.zh: 在一个充斥着复杂数字工具的时代，辨别最佳的前进道路可能会让人不知所措。这位参议员呼吁就VPN提供明确指导，反映了在技术选择中寻求智慧的必要性。《箴言》11:14提醒我们：“在无谋划之处，人民就败落；谋士众多，便得安稳。”愿我们在生活的各个领域，尤其是在缺乏理解的地方，都能寻求并提供明智的建议。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Supreme Court urged to let states regulate sports bets on prediction markets
title.zh: 新泽西州敦促最高法院裁定 Kalshi 体育投注为赌博，而非“掉期”

summary.en: A legal dispute between New Jersey and the prediction market Kalshi, concerning whether its sports-betting-like contracts are gambling or financial "swaps," has escalated to the Supreme Court. New Jersey argues Kalshi bypasses state gambling laws, while a lower court sided with Kalshi, granting jurisdiction to the...
summary.zh: 新泽西州与预测市场 Kalshi 之间的一场法律纠纷，围绕其类似体育投注的合约是赌博还是金融“掉期”展开，已升级至最高法院。新泽西州认为 Kalshi 绕过了州赌博法，而下级法院则支持 Kalshi，将管辖权授予了商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）。

body.en: New Jersey yesterday asked the Supreme Court to rule on whether states can regulate sports betting on prediction markets such as Kalshi. “Companies like Kalshi claim to offer legal sports betting in all 50 states, but they refuse to follow the gambling laws of any state," New Jersey Attorney General Jennifer Davenport said in a press release announcing the lawsuit. In April, the US Court of Appeals for the 3rd Circuit ruled that New Jersey cannot regulate sports bets on prediction markets. The court determined that sports-related event contracts meet the legal definition of "swaps," giving the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) exclusive jurisdiction. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 新泽西州昨天要求最高法院就各州是否可以监管卡尔希等预测市场上的体育博彩做出裁决。 “像 Kalshi 这样的公司声称在所有 50 个州提供合法的体育博彩，但他们拒绝遵守任何州的博彩法，”新泽西州总检察长 Jennifer Davenport 在宣布诉讼的新闻稿中表示。今年四月，美国第三巡回上诉法院裁定新泽西州不能监管预测市场上的体育博彩。法院认定，与体育赛事相关的合约符合“掉期”的法律定义，并赋予美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）专属管辖权。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: This legal battle over how to classify financial contracts—whether as gambling or regulated "swaps"—raises questions about fairness and accountability in commerce. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh, principles that should guide how we regulate markets and protect citizens.
reflection.zh: 这场关于如何界定金融合约性质的法律斗争——是赌博还是受监管的“掉期”——引发了关于商业公平和问责制的疑问。弥迦书 6:8 提醒我们，真正的公义在于行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行，这些原则应指导我们如何监管市场和保护公民。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: VMware migration reduces Tottenham Hotspur's licensing fees by 85 percent
title.zh: VMware迁移使托特纳姆热刺的许可费减少85%

summary.en: Tottenham Hotspur, a Premier League soccer team, has significantly reduced its licensing fees by switching from VMware to HPE's virtualization software. This move was reportedly influenced by concerns related to the Broadcom takeover of VMware, prompting the team's CTO to seek alternative solutions for their stadium's...
summary.zh: 英格兰足球超级联赛球队托特纳姆热刺队通过将VMware的虚拟化软件更换为HPE的解决方案，大幅削减了许可费用。据报道，此举受到了VMware被博通公司收购的影响，促使该队首席技术官为其体育场的IT基础设施寻求替代方案。

body.en: Tottenham Hotspur, a professional soccer team that’s part of the Premier League, has saved over 85 percent in licensing fees by replacing its stadium's VMware instance with Hewlett-Packard Enterprise’s (HPE’s) Morpheus VM Essentials (VME) virtualization software. Tottenham hasn’t disclosed which VMware products it used or how much it previously paid the Broadcom firm. The soccer organization confirmed this week to The Register that it has moved its stadium's server, storage, and networking infrastructure to HPE solutions delivered through HPE's hybrid cloud management platform, GreenLake. That is all “underpinned by" VME and HPE's OpsRamp software for hybrid and multi-cloud environments, Rob Pickering, Tottenham's CTO, told the publication, with HPE in charge of the hybrid cloud-managed service. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 托特纳姆热刺队是英超联赛的一支职业足球队，通过使用惠普企业 (HPE) 的 Morpheus VM Essentials (VME) 虚拟化软件替换其体育场的 VMware 实例，节省了超过 85% 的许可费用。托特纳姆热刺队没有透露它使用了哪些VMware产品，也没有透露它之前向博通公司支付了多少钱。该足球组织本周向 The Register 证实，已将其体育场的服务器、存储和网络基础设施迁移到通过 HPE 混合云管理平台 GreenLake 提供的 HPE 解决方案。托特纳姆热刺队首席技术官 Rob Pickering 表示，这一切都是由 VME 和 HPE 针对混合云和多云环境的 OpsRamp 软件“支撑”的，而 HPE 则负责混合云托管服务。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In the complex world of corporate mergers and technological shifts, leaders face decisions that impact their organizations' resources and operations. The CTO of Tottenham Hotspur navigated these changes by seeking a more stable and cost-effective solution, demonstrating integrity in managing the team's assets. This echoes the wisdom of Proverbs 16:12, which...
reflection.zh: 在企业合并和技术变革的复杂世界中，领导者面临着影响其组织资源和运营的决策。托特纳姆热刺队的首席技术官通过寻求更稳定、更具成本效益的解决方案来应对这些变化，这体现了其在管理球队资产方面的诚信。这呼应了《箴言》16章12节的智慧：“王因公义得治国，倚靠正直可以长久”，这表明健全、合乎道德的领导力能够带来稳定和繁荣。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: AI data centres are booming in Australia - but at what cost?
title.zh: 澳大利亚数据中心蓬勃发展——但代价是什么？

summary.en: Proponents argue that data centers will create jobs, while others express concern that they will consume significant resources with limited overall benefit.
summary.zh: 支持者认为数据中心将创造就业机会，而其他人则担心它们将消耗大量资源而整体效益有限。

body.en:
The sheer size and noise of data centres are what people tend to notice first. Some say they sound like a jet plane about to take off, others complain of a high-pitched whine.

When Lucy* puts her child to bed, she hears a constant humming. "I'll hear it and think, 'What is that? What is going on?'," she says.

And then she'll remember that the noise is a data centre just 350m (0.2 miles) from her front door in the desirable suburb of Lane Cove, in Sydney's lower north-shore. Another four are in the pipeline at the local industrial park.

Australia has quickly become a global destination for data centres, with investors attracted to the country's abundance of clean energy, natural gas reserves, and land to power and house their technologies.

Earlier this year, OpenAI's CEO Sam Altman said Australia could become a data centre capital of the world, if it wanted to.

Australia is already headed in the direction of big tech's wishes. There are 162 data centres across the country, with plans for 90 more, and an estimated more than A$155bn (£80bn) of investment money lined up.

If approved, one of the world's biggest data centres will be built in western Sydney. At one gigawatt, it is expected to be Australia's largest single energy user.

And in Marsden Park, also in western Sydney, the biggest data centre in the Southern Hemisphere is already under construction only 100m away from a local community.

But as more Australians find themselves living next door to data centres - triggering concerns about water supplies, energy use and the environment - many are asking whether joining the artificial intelligence (AI) race is worth it.

Data centres have been essential to the digital economy since the arrival of the internet.

They were originally built to process and store data for things like emails, online banking and cloud services. But everything changed after 2022 when ChatGPT launched and AI exploded in popularity. This prompted a sudden race to build more data centres to power the technology.

The location of these large, windowless buildings filled with beeping servers and cables also became important to latency – the time it takes for data to travel from its source to its destination.

Delays for things like air traffic control, robotic surgery or even Netflix would not be tolerated today, Belinda Dennett, CEO of Data Centres Australia, says.

Australia has roughly 13.6 million users of AI every month, making them the sixth most active users of the tech globally.

And experts say having data centres in Australia will lower the barrier to building more of its own AI companies.

"If we think about it in reverse, what happens if we don't build infrastructure here", Dennett says. "We get none of the value chain, we are just importing tools from someone...
body.zh: 人们往往首先注意到的是数据中心的庞大规模和噪音。有人说它们听起来像一架即将起飞的喷气式飞机，另一些人则抱怨是尖锐的哀鸣声。 当露西*让她的孩子上床睡觉时，她听到持续不断的嗡嗡声。 “我会听到它并想，‘那是什么？发生了什么事？’”她说。 然后她会记得，噪音来自距离她前门仅 350m（0.2 英里）的数据中心，该数据中心位于悉尼下北岸理想的 Lane Cove 郊区。另外四个正在当地工业园区筹备中。 澳大利亚已迅速成为全球数据中心目的地，投资者被该国丰富的清洁能源、天然气储量以及用于供电和容纳其技术的土地所吸引。 今年早些时候，OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 表示，如果澳大利亚愿意，它可以成为世界数据中心之都。 澳大利亚已经朝着大型科技公司愿望的方向前进。全国有 162 个数据中心，计划再建设 90 个，预计投资资金将超过 1,550 亿澳元（800 亿英镑）。 如果获得批准，世界上最大的数据中心之一将建在悉尼西部。预计将成为澳大利亚最大的单一能源用户，达到一吉瓦。 而在同样位于悉尼西部的马斯登公园，南半球最大的数据中心已经在建设中，距离当地社区仅 100m。 但随着越来越多的澳大利亚人发现自己住在数据中心旁边，引发了人们对供水、能源使用和环境的担忧，许多人开始质疑加入人工智能 (AI) 竞赛是否值得。 自互联网出现以来，数据中心对于数字经济至关重要。 它们最初是为了处理和存储电子邮件、网上银行和云服务等数据而构建的。但 2022 年 ChatGPT 推出、人工智能爆发式普及后，一切都发生了变化。这促使人们突然竞相建造更多数据中心来支持该技术。 这些大型、无窗的建筑物中充满了发出蜂鸣声的服务器和电缆，其位置对于延迟（数据从源传输到目的地所需的时间）也变得很重要。 澳大利亚数据中心首席执行官贝琳达·丹尼特 (Belinda Dennett) 表示，如今空中交通管制、机器人手术甚至 Netflix 等服务的延误都是不能容忍的。 澳大利亚每月约有 1360 万人工智能用户，使其成为全球第六大最活跃的技术用户。 专家表示，在澳大利亚拥有数据中心将降低建立更多自己的人工智能公司的障碍。 “如果我们反过来思考，如果我们不在这里建设基础设施，会发生什么”，丹尼特说。 “我们没有获得任何价值链，我们只是从某人那里进口工具......

reflection.en: The rapid growth of data centers in Australia presents a complex challenge, balancing potential economic gains with environmental and resource concerns. This situation calls for careful consideration, as Proverbs 18:15 reminds us that the human heart seeks knowledge and understanding, but this pursuit must be tempered with wisdom and foresight to ensure...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚数据中心的快速增长带来了复杂的挑战，需要在潜在的经济收益与环境和资源问题之间取得平衡。这种情况需要仔细考虑，正如箴言 18:15 所提醒我们的，人心寻求知识和理解，但这种追求必须以智慧和远见为辅，以确保可持续的进步。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: OpenAI hails ‘new era of artificial general intelligence’ with Astra model release
title.zh: OpenAI 宣布 Astra 模型发布，开启“通用人工智能新时代”

summary.en: OpenAI has announced the release of its latest model, Astra, which it describes as the "world's most intelligent and aligned model." This announcement comes shortly after CEO Sam Altman had downplayed the term 'AGI' and follows a period of international concern over AI safety incidents involving other OpenAI models.
summary.zh: OpenAI 宣布发布其最新模型 Astra，并称其为“世界上最智能、最协调的模型”。此次发布正值该公司首席执行官萨姆·奥特曼此前淡化“通用人工智能”（AGI）一词，并且此前国际社会对 OpenAI 其他模型出现的 AI 安全事件表示担忧。

body.en: Astra’s arrival comes days after Sam Altman, OpenAI’s chief executive, described AGI as an ‘irrelevant marketing term’ The president of OpenAI, Greg Brockman, has claimed the world has entered a new era of artificial general intelligence after the release of his company’s latest model, Astra, which it described as the “world’s most intelligent and aligned model”. Brockman made the claim on Thursday as the San Francisco company released the model only weeks after a serious AI safety incident involving other models under its development caused international concern and a pause in Astra’s training. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The ambition to create 'artificial general intelligence' can be a powerful driver of innovation, as seen with OpenAI's Astra model. However, the Genesis account of Babel warns against unchecked human ambition that seeks to reach the heavens on its own terms, potentially leading to confusion and division. The challenge for developers and society is to pursue...

When systems prioritize rapid growth over ecological or community well-being, the prophetic voice calls for a halt, demanding that justice roll down like waters. May this moment of protest lead to a more balanced and...

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!

reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展和广泛应用，以英伟达收购Hugging Face为例，呼应了“知识将增长”（但以理书12:4）的预言。随着人工智能能力的扩展，我们被呼召以智慧和伦理考量来追求这些知识，确保它们服务于人类的福祉。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.

title.en: Nvidia strikes $12.9bn deal to buy AI platform Hugging Face
title.zh: 英伟达斥资129亿美元收购AI平台Hugging Face

summary.en: Nvidia has agreed to acquire Hugging Face, a prominent AI platform and developer community, for approximately $12.9 billion. This acquisition signifies Nvidia's expansion into software and its move to control a significant open-source AI ecosystem.
summary.zh: 英伟达已同意以约129亿美元的价格收购领先的人工智能平台和开发者社区Hugging Face。此次收购标志着英伟达向软件领域的扩张，并获得了对一个重要的开源人工智能生态系统的控制权。

body.en:
Nvidia has agreed to buy artificial intelligence platform Hugging Face in a deal valued at about $12.9bn (£9.5bn), one of the AI chipmaker's biggest acquisitions as it expands into software.

Hugging Face, founded in 2016, has become a popular online platform where developers and researchers can find, share and test AI models and tools.

It recently made headlines after rogue AI agents that escaped a testing environment hacked into it, raising questions about AI safety and oversight.

The deal would bring one of the world's largest AI developer communities into Nvidia and give it control of a leading open-source platform - an alternative to systems offered by OpenAI and Anthropic.

Nvidia is best known for making the advanced chips used to train and run AI systems. Demand for those chips has surged as companies race to build AI products.

The companies already work together to help developers use Nvidia's computing services through the platform.

According to the companies, Hugging Face is used by more than 18 million developers and hosts more than three million AI models. More than 200,000 companies use the platform, they said.

Nvidia said Hugging Face would remain open to developers and that users would not be required to use its chips or services.

Under the agreement, Nvidia will pay about $11.9bn to Hugging Face investors and offer up to $1bn in stock-based incentives to employees who join the company.

The deal could also help Nvidia expand its presence in AI software as some of its biggest customers, including Microsoft, Meta and OpenAI, develop their own chips.

Open-source AI models can be downloaded and adapted by users, unlike many AI systems that are controlled by a single company.

Supporters say the approach can make the technology more accessible to businesses, researchers and developers.

Yaël Ossowski, deputy director of advocacy group Consumer Choice Center, said the acquisition was "a vote of confidence in open AI" and suggested it could encourage competition by making AI tools more widely available to start ups and smaller companies.

The deal will be a "major victory for innovators and consumers worldwide" if Nvidia keeps Hugging Face open and accessible, he added.

The deal would also give Nvidia access to one of the world's largest AI developer communities as competition in the sector intensifies .

Founded by French entrepreneurs Clément Delangue, Julien Chaumond and Thomas Wolf, Hugging Face also provides datasets, software tools and cloud services used to build AI applications.
body.zh: 英伟达已同意收购人工智能平台 Hugging Face，交易价值约 129 亿美元（合 95 亿英镑），这是这家人工智能芯片制造商向软件领域扩张的最大收购案之一。 Hugging Face 成立于 2016 年，现已成为一个流行的在线平台，开发人员和研究人员可以在其中查找、共享和测试人工智能模型和工具。 最近，在其平台上出现了逃离测试环境的流氓人工智能代理后，该公司成为了头条新闻，引发了有关人工智能安全和监督的质疑。 这笔交易将把世界上最大的人工智能开发者社区之一引入英伟达，并使其控制领先的开源平台——这是 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 提供的系统的替代品。 Nvidia 以制造用于训练和运行人工智能系统的先进芯片而闻名。随着公司竞相开发人工智能产品，对这些芯片的需求激增。 两家公司已经合作，帮助开发人员通过该平台使用 Nvidia 的计算服务。 据两家公司称，Hugging Face 已被超过 1800 万开发者使用，并托管超过 300 万个人工智能模型。他们表示，超过 20 万家公司使用该平台。 英伟达表示，Hugging Face 将继续向开发者开放，并且不会要求用户使用其芯片或服务。 根据协议，英伟达将向 Hugging Face 投资者支付约 119 亿美元，并向加入该公司的员工提供高达 10 亿美元的股票激励。 这笔交易还可以帮助英伟达扩大其在人工智能软件领域的影响力，因为包括微软、Meta 和 OpenAI 在内的一些最大客户都在开发自己的芯片。 与许多由单个公司控制的人工智能系统不同，开源人工智能模型可以由用户下载和调整。 支持者表示，这种方法可以使企业、研究人员和开发人员更容易使用该技术。 倡导组织消费者选择中心副主任 Yaël Ossowski 表示，此次收购是“对开放人工智能的信任票”，并表示它可以通过让初创企业和小公司更广泛地使用人工智能工具来鼓励竞争。 他补充说，如果英伟达保持 Hugging Face 的开放性和可访问性，这笔交易将是“全球创新者和消费者的重大胜利”。 随着该行业竞争的加剧，这笔交易还将使英伟达能够进入世界上最大的人工智能开发者社区之一。 Hugging Face 由法国企业家 Clément Delangue、Julien Chaumond 和 Thomas Wolf 创立，还提供用于构建人工智能应用程序的数据集、软件工具和云服务。

reflection.en: The rapid acceleration of knowledge, particularly in artificial intelligence, is a hallmark of our time. This acquisition by Nvidia underscores the immense value and potential seen in AI platforms like Hugging Face, which serve as hubs for innovation and collaboration among developers. As we witness this explosion of knowledge, it calls us to consider its...
reflection.zh: 知识的快速发展，尤其是在人工智能领域，是我们这个时代的标志。英伟达的此次收购凸显了像Hugging Face这样的人工智能平台所蕴含的巨大价值和潜力，它们是开发者创新与协作的中心。当我们见证知识的爆炸式增长时，这促使我们思考其目的和伦理应用，在技术进步的同时寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

It reminds us that seeking wisdom and understanding, as Proverbs 18:15 encourages, is a...

Customers in London can now travel in the UK's first robotaxis as Uber launches its self-driving minicab on Thursday, becoming the first company to launch the service. Initially, it has 15 autonomous vehicles with...
summary.zh: BBC的佐伊·克莱因曼周四乘坐Uber的自动驾驶机器人出租车，该服务已在伦敦推出。伦敦的顾客现在可以乘坐英国首批机器人出租车，因为Uber于周四推出了其自动驾驶迷你出租车，成为首家推出此服务的公司。最初，该公司在伦敦只有15辆获得运营许可的自动驾驶汽车，每辆车都必须配备一名人类安全驾驶员。目前，机器人出租车的英国票价将...

body.en:
Customers in London can now travel in the UK's first robotaxis as Uber launches its self-driving minicab on Thursday - the company is the first to launch the service.

Initially, it only has 15 autonomous vehicles with a licence to operate in the city, and each one must have a human safety driver behind the wheel ready to take control if anything goes wrong.

At the moment, the UK fare for a robotaxi ride will be the same fare as a standard UberX, Uber Electric, or Uber Comfort journey, with upfront fares shown in the app.

The BBC's Zoe Kleinman was the first British journalist to hail a self-driving Uber in London - here's how the ride went.
body.zh: 优步周四推出了自动驾驶小型出租车，伦敦的顾客现在可以乘坐英国第一辆机器人出租车出行——该公司是第一家推出这项服务的公司。 最初，它只有 15 辆拥有在该市运营许可证的自动驾驶汽车，每辆汽车都必须配备一名人类安全驾驶员，随时准备在出现问题时接管控制。 目前，英国机器人出租车的票价将与标准 UberX、Uber Electric 或 Uber Comfort 旅程的票价相同，预付费用会显示在应用程序中。 BBC 的佐伊·克莱曼 (Zoe Kleinman) 是第一位在伦敦称赞自动驾驶 Uber 的英国记者 - 以下是乘坐过程。

reflection.en: The rollout of self-driving taxis in London marks a significant leap in technological advancement, bringing science fiction closer to reality. As Daniel prophesied, 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This innovation promises convenience and efficiency, yet it also prompts reflection on how we integrate such powerful tools into our...
reflection.zh: 自动驾驶出租车在伦敦的推出标志着技术进步的重大飞跃，使科幻小说更接近现实。正如但以理所预言的，“许多人来往奔走，知识就必增长。”这项创新带来了便利和效率，但它也促使我们反思如何将如此强大的工具融入我们的生活和社会。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Uber launches UK's first robotaxis with a driver - here's what it's like to ride in one
title.zh: 优步推出英国首款带司机的机器人出租车——乘坐体验如何

summary.en: The ride-hailing app has launched 15 self-driving taxis, but they will have safety drivers inside.
summary.zh: 网约车应用已推出15辆自动驾驶出租车，但车内配有安全员。

body.en:
Londoners are able to hail the UK's first robotaxis - as Uber today becomes the first company to launch a self-driving minicab.

Initially, it only has 15 autonomous vehicles with a licence to operate in the city, and each one must have a human safety driver behind the wheel ready to take control if anything goes wrong.

Uber said it surveyed London-based customers via the app and more than 100,000 said they would choose a self-driving taxi if one was available, despite incidents of driverless rides malfunctioning in US cities where they already operate.

As I found out when I became the first UK journalist to hail one, it was mostly smooth but the safety driver did intervene on one occasion.

At the moment the UK fare for a robotaxi ride will be the same fare as a standard UberX, Uber Electric, or Uber Comfort journey, with upfront fares shown in the app.

Taking a self-driving ride will only appear as an option in the app after the journey has been booked, and if one of its cars is available nearby.

Uber's global head of autonomous mobility and delivery Sarfraz Maredia said the plan was to phase them in over a period of several years.

"We always want consumers to be able to request a human ride or an autonomous vehicle, and because the market's growing, we expect that there will be human drivers on Uber London for a long time to come," he said.

The Ford Mustang electric vehicles which make up Uber's current small fleet are fitted with the UK tech firm Wayve's driverless car technology, which uses AI to analyse data about what is going on around it in real time, gathered by sensors in a bar on the roof of the vehicle and elsewhere.

The vehicles are not pre-programmed - their actions are determined on the spot depending on what is going on.

Google's autonomous car company Waymo and the Chinese tech giant Baidu are also vying to launch services in the UK, and the competition is fierce.

Wayve chief executive Alex Kendall described developing the technology as "the space race for our generation" but added there were some "really hard problems to solve" along the way.

"What we've done over time is pioneer a completely new approach to autonomous driving, making it possible to bring this to a busy and complex city like London and scale it globally," he said.

This week I became the first British journalist to travel as a customer in a self-driving Uber after hailing one via the app.

The safety driver gave me a 30-second safety briefing, and then we were off, making our way down the busy streets of central London.

For several minutes, we negotiated the traffic without incident, cruising past a busy Brexit demonstration under way outside parliament, successfully navigating traffic lights and roadworks along the way.

When a cyclist paused and waved...
body.zh: 伦敦人可以欢呼英国第一辆机器人出租车——优步今天成为第一家推出自动驾驶小型出租车的公司。 最初，它只有 15 辆拥有在该市运营许可证的自动驾驶汽车，每辆汽车都必须配备一名人类安全驾驶员，随时准备在出现问题时接管控制。 Uber 表示，它通过该应用程序对伦敦的客户进行了调查，超过 10 万名客户表示，如果有自动驾驶出租车，他们会选择自动驾驶出租车，尽管他们已经在美国城市运营的无人驾驶出租车出现了故障。 当我成为第一个向安全司机欢呼的英国记者时发现，一切都很顺利，但安全司机确实有一次进行了干预。 目前，英国机器人出租车的票价将与标准 UberX、Uber Electric 或 Uber Comfort 旅程的票价相同，预付费用会显示在应用程序中。 只有在预订行程后，并且附近有一辆自驾车辆可用时，乘坐自驾游才会作为一个选项出现在应用程序中。 Uber 自动驾驶移动和配送全球主管 Sarfraz Maredia 表示，该计划将在几年内分阶段实施。 他说：“我们一直希望消费者能够要求有人乘坐或自动驾驶汽车，而且由于市场不断增长，我们预计 Uber London 将在未来很长一段时间内有人类司机。” 构成 Uber 目前小型车队的福特野马电动汽车配备了英国科技公司 Wayve 的无人驾驶汽车技术，该技术使用人工智能来实时分析周围发生的情况的数据，这些数据由车辆顶部酒吧和其他地方的传感器收集。 这些车辆没有预先编程——它们的行动是根据发生的情况当场决定的。 谷歌旗下自动驾驶汽车公司Waymo和中国科技巨头百度也竞相在英国推出服务，竞争非常激烈。 Wayve 首席执行官亚历克斯·肯德尔 (Alex Kendall) 将开发这项技术描述为“我们这一代人的太空竞赛”，但他补充说，在此过程中存在一些“真正难以解决的问题”。 他说：“随着时间的推移，我们所做的是开创一种全新的自动驾驶方法，使其能够将其引入伦敦这样繁忙而复杂的城市，并在全球范围内推广。” 本周，我通过应用程序叫了一辆自动驾驶优步车，成为第一位乘坐自动驾驶优步车出行的英国记者。 安全司机给我做了 30 秒的安全简报，然后我们就出发了，沿着伦敦市中心繁忙的街道行驶。 在几分钟的时间里，我们顺利通过了交通，驶过议会外正在进行的繁忙的脱欧示威活动，成功地通过了沿途的红绿灯和道路施工。 当一个骑自行车的人停下来挥手时......

reflection.en: Uber's introduction of robotaxis in London, even with safety drivers, marks a significant step in autonomous vehicle technology. As this new venture unfolds, the company and its employees might consider committing their efforts and plans to Yahweh, trusting in His guidance for success and safety in this innovative endeavor. May their work be guided by...
reflection.zh: 优步在伦敦推出机器人出租车，即使配备安全员，也标志着自动驾驶技术的重要一步。随着这项新事业的展开，公司及其员工或许会考虑将他们的努力和计划交托给雅伟，信靠祂的指引，以期在这项创新事业中取得成功和安全。愿他们的工作以智慧为指导，并致力于为公众提供良好服务。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Uber to cut over 3,000 jobs in major global restructuring
title.zh: Uber因重组裁员逾3000人

summary.en: Uber is cutting over 3,000 jobs globally as part of a major restructuring aimed at simplifying management layers and refocusing spending on its core business. The cuts represent about 10% of its workforce and aim to improve decision-making and position the company for future opportunities.
summary.zh: 优步（Uber）正进行大规模重组，在全球范围内裁员超过3000人，旨在简化管理层级并重新聚焦核心业务支出。此次裁员约占其全球员工总数的10%，目的是改进决策流程，使公司能更好地把握未来的机遇。

body.en:
Uber is cutting more than 3,000 jobs worldwide as part of a major overhaul designed to shrink management layers and refocus spending on its core business.

The cuts amount to roughly 10% of its global workforce, bringing staffing back to levels last seen in 2021.

Chief executive Dara Khosrowshahi told staff in a company email that the taxi and delivery firm had expanded quickly but accumulated too many layers and small teams that slowed decision‑making.

He said the reductions would put Uber, which has its global head office in San Francisco, US, in a better position for its "biggest opportunities ahead of us".

The move marks one of Uber's largest restructurings in years and signals a shift towards a leaner operating model.

Shares rose nearly 2% after the announcement, with investors appearing to welcome the proposals.

Cuts affect both managers and non-managers, and Uber said it plans to fold many of its smallest teams into larger groups, however, the firm has not confirmed the locations most affected by job cuts.

Such changes are intended to make Uber "simpler" and "faster," while freeing up money to reinvest in areas it considers central to its future , Khosrowshahi said.

The restructuring comes as Uber steps up investment in autonomous vehicle partnerships and expands its ride‑hailing, delivery, and robotaxi operations .

Uber is also tightening up its office strategy, asking nearly all employees to work in person at designated hubs and limiting remote roles to about 1%.

Unlike many large technology companies that have cut jobs amid heavy spending on artificial intelligence (AI), Uber had avoided major reductions since the pandemic.

The latest changes bring its workforce back to just under 30,000 people, roughly where it stood before its most recent period of expansion.
body.zh: Uber 正在全球范围内裁员 3,000 多人，这是一项重大改革的一部分，旨在缩小管理层规模，并将支出重新集中在核心业务上。 此次裁员约占其全球员工总数的 10%，使员工人数恢复到 2021 年的水平。 首席执行官达拉·科斯罗萨西(Dara Khosrowshahi)在公司电子邮件中告诉员工，这家出租车和送货公司扩张迅速，但积累了太多层级和小团队，导致决策速度变慢。 他表示，此次裁员将使全球总部位于美国旧金山的 Uber 处于更有利的位置，以应对“我们面前的最大机遇”。 此举标志着优步多年来最大的重组之一，并标志着其向更精简的运营模式的转变。 消息公布后，该公司股价上涨近 2%，投资者似乎对这些提议表示欢迎。 裁员影响到经理和非经理，Uber 表示计划将许多最小的团队合并为更大的团队，但该公司尚未确认受裁员影响最严重的地点。 科斯罗萨西表示，这些变化旨在让 Uber“更简单”、“更快”，同时释放资金，用于对其认为对其未来至关重要的领域进行再投资。 此次重组之际，优步加大了对自动驾驶汽车合作伙伴的投资，并扩大了其叫车、送货和自动驾驶出租车业务。 Uber 还收紧了其办公策略，要求几乎所有员工在指定中心亲自工作，并将远程角色限制在 1% 左右。 与许多在人工智能（AI）方面投入巨资而裁员的大型科技公司不同，自疫情大流行以来，Uber 避免了大幅裁员。 最新的变化使其员工人数恢复到不到 30,000 人，与最近一次扩张之前的水平大致相同。

reflection.en: In its drive for efficiency, Uber is streamlining its operations by reducing its workforce. This pursuit of better decision-making and focus echoes the wisdom found in seeking knowledge and understanding, as described in Proverbs. May leaders always seek not just efficiency, but also the well-being of those affected by such significant changes.
reflection.zh: 优步（Uber）在追求效率的过程中，正通过精简人员来优化其运营。这种对更好决策和专注的追求，呼应了《箴言》中所述的寻求知识和理解的智慧。愿领导者在追求效率的同时，也始终顾念那些受重大变革影响的人们的福祉。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。
